+"""Assemble the Crimson Valley scene from its built parts and (optionally) render it.
+
+  blender -b --factory-startup --python scene/assemble.py -- [--render out.png] [--scale 100] [--samples 256]
+          [--parts a,b,c] [--skip x,y] [--out file.blend] [--no-save]
+
+Appends parts/<name>.blend for every part in common.PART_ORDER that is built (or only --parts), runs
+the parts' finalize(scene) hooks, and saves crimson_valley.blend (or --out). Without a "lighting" part
+a plain preview sun is used, without "sky" a plain sky colour."""
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import common  # noqa: E402
+import bpy  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def main():
+    a = common.args_after_dashes()
+    opt = {"--render": "", "--scale": "100", "--samples": "256", "--parts": "", "--skip": "", "--out": common.FINAL_BLEND}
+    flags = set()
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(a):
+        if a[i] in opt:
+            opt[a[i]] = a[i + 1]
+            i += 2
+        else:
+            flags.add(a[i])
+            i += 1
+    only = [p for p in opt["--parts"].split(",") if p]
+    skip = [p for p in opt["--skip"].split(",") if p]
+    t0 = time.time()
+    scene = common.reset_scene()
+    used = []
+    for p in common.PART_ORDER:
+        if (only and p not in only) or p in skip:
+            continue
+        if common.append_part(scene, p) is not None or os.path.exists(common.part_path(p)):
+            used.append(p)
+    for p in used:
+        try:
+            m = common.part_module(p)
+        except ModuleNotFoundError:
+            continue
+        if hasattr(m, "finalize"):
+            m.finalize(scene)
+    if scene.world is None:
+        common.preview_world(scene)
+    if "lighting" not in used:
+        common.preview_sun(scene)
+    print(f"ASSEMBLED {used} in {time.time() - t0:.1f} s: {len(scene.objects)} objects")
+    if "--no-save" not in flags:
+        common.save_blend(os.path.abspath(opt["--out"]))
+    if opt["--render"]:
+        common.render(scene, os.path.abspath(opt["--render"]), scale=int(opt["--scale"]), samples=int(opt["--samples"]))
+
+
+main()

+"""Build one part of the Crimson Valley scene, alone, and (optionally) render it from the camera.
+
+  blender -b --factory-startup --python scene/build_part.py -- <name> [--render out.png] [--scale 50]
+          [--samples 48] [--with sky,planet,...] [--no-save] [--no-sun] [--transparent]
+
+Runs scene/part_<name>.py's build(col) in an empty scene (camera and render settings from common.py),
+saves parts/<name>.blend, and with --render writes a picture of the camera view. --with brings in other
+parts that are already built (their saved parts/<x>.blend), to see this one in context. Without a
+"lighting" part in --with a plain preview sun is added (--no-sun: none), and without the "sky" part a
+plain preview sky colour - both for the picture only, they are not saved into the part.
+--transparent renders on a transparent background (RGBA), to look at the part's own outline."""
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import common  # noqa: E402
+import bpy  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def main():
+    a = common.args_after_dashes()
+    name = a[0]
+    opt = {"--render": "", "--scale": "50", "--samples": "48", "--with": ""}
+    flags = set()
+    i = 1
+    while i < len(a):
+        if a[i] in opt:
+            opt[a[i]] = a[i + 1]
+            i += 2
+        else:
+            flags.add(a[i])
+            i += 1
+    t0 = time.time()
+    scene = common.reset_scene()
+    col = common.new_collection(scene, name)
+    mod = common.part_module(name)
+    mod.build(col)
+    print(f"BUILT part {name}: {len(col.all_objects)} objects in {time.time() - t0:.1f} s")
+    if "--no-save" not in flags:
+        common.save_blend(common.part_path(name))
+    if opt["--render"]:
+        others = [p for p in opt["--with"].split(",") if p and p != name]
+        for p in common.PART_ORDER:
+            if p in others:
+                if common.append_part(scene, p) is None and not os.path.exists(common.part_path(p)):
+                    print("part", p, "is not built yet - left out")
+        mods = [(p, common.part_module(p)) for p in [name] + others if os.path.exists(common.part_path(p)) or p == name]
+        for p, m in mods:
+            if hasattr(m, "finalize"):
+                m.finalize(scene)
+        if scene.world is None:
+            common.preview_world(scene)
+        if "lighting" not in others and name != "lighting" and "--no-sun" not in flags:
+            common.preview_sun(scene)
+        if "--transparent" in flags:
+            scene.render.film_transparent = True
+            scene.render.image_settings.color_mode = "RGBA"
+        common.render(scene, os.path.abspath(opt["--render"]), scale=int(opt["--scale"]), samples=int(opt["--samples"]))
+
+
+main()

@@ -1,0 +1,356 @@ 
+"""Shared Blender helpers of the Crimson Valley scene (import bpy; Blender 5.2).
+
+The scene is built from PARTS. A part is a module scene/part_<name>.py with
+
+    def build(col):      # create the part's objects, link them into the collection `col`
+    def finalize(scene): # optional: runs in the assembled scene, after every part is in (cross-part wiring)
+
+`build_part.py` runs one part in an empty scene and saves parts/<name>.blend; `assemble.py` appends every
+built part into crimson_valley.blend. Parts never reference another part's datablocks: what they share
+goes through files (analysis/, meshes/) - so they can be built and tested alone, in any order.
+
+World units are metres: X right, Y into the picture, Z up; the river is z = 0; the camera stands at
+(0, 0, 20) looking along +Y (see tools/cvlib.py, analysis/camera.json). Datablocks are named "CV_...".
+"""
+import fcntl
+import importlib
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "tools"))
+sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
+import cvlib  # noqa: E402
+
+ANALYSIS = os.path.join(ROOT, "analysis")
+MESHES = os.path.join(ROOT, "meshes")
+PARTS = os.path.join(ROOT, "parts")
+RENDERS = os.path.join(ROOT, "renders")
+REFERENCE = cvlib.REFERENCE
+FINAL_BLEND = os.path.join(ROOT, "crimson_valley.blend")
+W, H = cvlib.W, cvlib.H
+WORLD_NAME = "CV_World"
+COMPOSITOR_NAME = "CV_Compositing"
+CAMERA_NAME = "CV_Camera"
+GPU_LOCK = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".cache", "crimson_valley_tools", "gpu.lock")
+
+# The order parts are assembled in (missing ones are skipped). World and compositor come from the
+# parts named here.
+PART_ORDER = ["sky", "planet", "moons", "clouds", "far", "terrain", "rocks", "water", "vegetation",
+              "city", "waterfalls", "mist", "lighting", "grade"]
+WORLD_PART = "sky"
+COMPOSITOR_PART = "grade"
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- scene
+def cam_model():
+    return cvlib.load_camera()
+
+
+def reset_scene():
+    """An empty file with the scene's camera and render settings."""
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    scene.name = "Crimson Valley"
+    scene.unit_settings.system = "METRIC"
+    make_camera(scene)
+    setup_render(scene)
+    return scene
+
+
+def make_camera(scene):
+    cm = cam_model()
+    cam = bpy.data.cameras.new(CAMERA_NAME)
+    cam.lens = cm.lens_mm
+    cam.sensor_width = cm.sensor_width
+    cam.sensor_fit = "HORIZONTAL"
+    cam.clip_start = 0.5
+    cam.clip_end = 200000.0
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(CAMERA_NAME, cam)
+    ob.location = tuple(cm.pos)
+    ob.rotation_euler = (math.pi / 2 - cm.pitch, 0.0, 0.0)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
+    scene.camera = ob
+    scene.render.resolution_x, scene.render.resolution_y = W, H
+    scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
+    # The reference behind the camera view, to compare in the viewport (not rendered).
+    try:
+        img = bpy.data.images.load(REFERENCE, check_existing=True)
+        img.name = "CV_Reference"
+        cam.show_background_images = True
+        bg = cam.background_images.new()
+        bg.image = img
+        bg.alpha = 0.5
+        bg.display_depth = "FRONT"
+        bg.show_background_image = False       # off by default: toggle in Camera > Background Images
+    except Exception as ex:                     # the picture is a convenience, never a blocker
+        print("reference background not set:", ex)
+    return ob
+
+
+def enable_gpu():
+    """Cycles on the GPU (OptiX), from a factory-settings session."""
+    try:
+        prefs = bpy.context.preferences.addons["cycles"].preferences
+        prefs.compute_device_type = "OPTIX"
+        prefs.get_devices()
+        found = False
+        for d in prefs.devices:
+            d.use = d.type == "OPTIX"
+            found = found or d.use
+        return found
+    except Exception as ex:
+        print("GPU not enabled:", ex)
+        return False
+
+
+def setup_render(scene, engine="CYCLES", samples=96, scale=100):
+    r = scene.render
+    r.engine = engine
+    r.resolution_x, r.resolution_y, r.resolution_percentage = W, H, scale
+    r.image_settings.file_format = "PNG"
+    r.image_settings.color_mode = "RGB"
+    r.film_transparent = False
+    if engine == "CYCLES":
+        c = scene.cycles
+        c.device = "GPU" if enable_gpu() else "CPU"
+        c.samples = samples
+        c.use_adaptive_sampling = True
+        c.adaptive_threshold = 0.02
+        c.use_denoising = True
+        try:
+            c.denoiser = "OPTIX" if c.device == "GPU" else "OPENIMAGEDENOISE"
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        c.max_bounces = 6
+        c.diffuse_bounces = 3
+        c.glossy_bounces = 4
+        c.transmission_bounces = 6
+        c.transparent_max_bounces = 16
+        c.volume_bounces = 1
+        c.caustics_reflective = False
+        c.caustics_refractive = False
+    # "Standard": what a material emits or reflects is what the picture shows (the reference is an
+    # ordinary sRGB picture, so its colours can be matched directly: linear = srgb_to_linear(pixel)).
+    set_view(scene, "Standard", "None")
+
+
+def set_view(scene, transform, look=None, exposure=None, gamma=None):
+    """View transform / look by name; unknown names are reported and left as they were."""
+    vs = scene.view_settings
+    try:
+        vs.view_transform = transform
+    except Exception as ex:
+        print("view transform", transform, "not set:", ex)
+    if look is not None:
+        for name in (look, look.replace("AgX - ", ""), "None"):
+            try:
+                vs.look = name
+                break
+            except Exception:
+                continue
+    if exposure is not None:
+        vs.exposure = exposure
+    if gamma is not None:
+        vs.gamma = gamma
+
+
+def render(scene, path, scale=None, samples=None):
+    """Render the camera view to `path` (PNG). One render at a time across processes (a file lock),
+    so parallel builds share the GPU without running out of memory."""
+    if scale is not None:
+        scene.render.resolution_percentage = scale
+    if samples is not None and scene.render.engine == "CYCLES":
+        scene.cycles.samples = samples
+    scene.render.filepath = path
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(GPU_LOCK), exist_ok=True)
+    t0 = time.time()
+    with open(GPU_LOCK, "w") as lock:
+        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+        t1 = time.time()
+        bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
+        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
+    print(f"RENDERED {path} in {time.time() - t1:.1f} s (waited {t1 - t0:.1f} s for the GPU)")
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- parts
+def part_module(name):
+    return importlib.import_module("part_" + name)
+
+
+def part_path(name):
+    return os.path.join(PARTS, name + ".blend")
+
+
+def new_collection(scene, name):
+    col = bpy.data.collections.new(name)
+    scene.collection.children.link(col)
+    return col
+
+
+def append_part(scene, name):
+    """Bring a built part into the scene: its collection, and (for the world / compositor parts)
+    the world and the compositing node group. Returns the collection or None."""
+    path = part_path(name)
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        return None
+    want_world = name == WORLD_PART
+    want_comp = name == COMPOSITOR_PART
+    with bpy.data.libraries.load(path, link=False) as (src, dst):
+        dst.collections = [c for c in src.collections if c == name]
+        if want_world and WORLD_NAME in src.worlds:
+            dst.worlds = [WORLD_NAME]
+        if want_comp and COMPOSITOR_NAME in src.node_groups:
+            dst.node_groups = [COMPOSITOR_NAME]
+    col = dst.collections[0] if dst.collections else None
+    if col is not None:
+        scene.collection.children.link(col)
+    if want_world and dst.worlds:
+        scene.world = dst.worlds[0]
+    if want_comp and dst.node_groups:
+        try:
+            scene.compositing_node_group = dst.node_groups[0]
+        except Exception as ex:
+            print("compositor not set:", ex)
+    return col
+
+
+def preview_world(scene, color=(0.35, 0.42, 0.55), strength=0.6):
+    """A plain sky colour for looking at a part alone."""
+    w = bpy.data.worlds.new("CV_PreviewWorld")
+    nt = node_tree(w)
+    bg = nt.nodes.get("Background") or nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBackground")
+    bg.inputs["Color"].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
+    bg.inputs["Strength"].default_value = strength
+    out = nt.nodes.get("World Output") or nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputWorld")
+    nt.links.new(bg.outputs["Background"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    scene.world = w
+    return w
+
+
+def preview_sun(scene, azimuth_deg=200.0, elevation_deg=14.0, strength=4.0, color=(1.0, 0.72, 0.5)):
+    """A low warm sun for looking at a part alone. Azimuth: the direction the light comes FROM,
+    degrees clockwise from +Y seen from above (0 = from ahead of the camera, 90 = from the right,
+    180 = from behind the camera, 270 = from the left)."""
+    light = bpy.data.lights.new("CV_PreviewSun", "SUN")
+    light.energy = strength
+    light.color = color
+    light.angle = math.radians(2.0)
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new("CV_PreviewSun", light)
+    scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
+    aim_sun(ob, azimuth_deg, elevation_deg)
+    return ob
+
+
+def aim_sun(ob, azimuth_deg, elevation_deg):
+    """Point a sun lamp so its light comes from the given azimuth / elevation (see preview_sun)."""
+    az, el = math.radians(azimuth_deg), math.radians(elevation_deg)
+    # direction the light travels (from the sun towards the scene)
+    d = (-math.sin(az) * math.cos(el), -math.cos(az) * math.cos(el), -math.sin(el))
+    import mathutils
+    ob.rotation_euler = mathutils.Vector(d).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- datablocks
+def node_tree(idblock):
+    """The node tree of a material / world, with nodes switched on (Blender 5: always on)."""
+    try:
+        if not idblock.node_tree:
+            idblock.use_nodes = True
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    return idblock.node_tree
+
+
+def new_material(name):
+    """A fresh material with an empty node tree: returns (material, nodes, links)."""
+    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
+    nt = node_tree(mat)
+    nt.nodes.clear()
+    return mat, nt.nodes, nt.links
+
+
+def mesh_object(name, verts, faces, col, smooth=True, attributes=None, uvs=None, flat_faces=None):
+    """A mesh object from numpy arrays. verts (N, 3) float; faces (M, 3) or (M, 4) int, or a list of
+    index lists. flat_faces: bool (M,) faces to leave flat-shaded. attributes: {name: (N,) or (N, k) float array} stored per vertex (FLOAT / FLOAT_VECTOR /
+    FLOAT_COLOR for k = 4). uvs: (N, 2) per-vertex UVs written to a UV map "UVMap"."""
+    verts = np.asarray(verts, dtype=np.float32)
+    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
+    if isinstance(faces, np.ndarray) and faces.ndim == 2:
+        k = faces.shape[1]
+        me.vertices.add(len(verts))
+        me.vertices.foreach_set("co", verts.ravel())
+        me.loops.add(faces.size)
+        me.loops.foreach_set("vertex_index", faces.astype(np.int32).ravel())
+        me.polygons.add(len(faces))
+        me.polygons.foreach_set("loop_start", np.arange(0, faces.size, k, dtype=np.int32))
+        me.polygons.foreach_set("loop_total", np.full(len(faces), k, dtype=np.int32))
+        me.update(calc_edges=True)
+    else:
+        me.from_pydata([tuple(map(float, v)) for v in verts], [], [list(map(int, f)) for f in faces])
+        me.update()
+    if smooth and len(me.polygons):
+        sm = np.ones(len(me.polygons), dtype=bool)
+        if flat_faces is not None:               # these faces stay flat: normals split along their edges
+            sm &= ~np.asarray(flat_faces, dtype=bool)
+        me.polygons.foreach_set("use_smooth", sm)
+    for an, arr in (attributes or {}).items():
+        arr = np.asarray(arr, dtype=np.float32)
+        if arr.ndim == 1:
+            at = me.attributes.new(an, "FLOAT", "POINT")
+            at.data.foreach_set("value", arr)
+        elif arr.shape[1] == 3:
+            at = me.attributes.new(an, "FLOAT_VECTOR", "POINT")
+            at.data.foreach_set("vector", arr.ravel())
+        elif arr.shape[1] == 4:
+            at = me.attributes.new(an, "FLOAT_COLOR", "POINT")
+            at.data.foreach_set("color", arr.ravel())
+        elif arr.shape[1] == 2:
+            at = me.attributes.new(an, "FLOAT2", "POINT")
+            at.data.foreach_set("vector", arr.ravel())
+    if uvs is not None:
+        uv = me.uv_layers.new(name="UVMap")
+        li = np.empty(len(me.loops), dtype=np.int32)
+        me.loops.foreach_get("vertex_index", li)
+        uv.data.foreach_set("uv", np.asarray(uvs, dtype=np.float32)[li].ravel())
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
+    col.objects.link(ob)
+    return ob
+
+
+def load_npz_mesh(path):
+    """A mesh saved by the tools: dict with 'verts', 'faces' and any per-vertex attributes."""
+    z = np.load(path)
+    return {k: z[k] for k in z.files}
+
+
+def save_blend(path):
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+    bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=path, compress=True)
+    print("SAVED", path, f"{os.path.getsize(path) / 1e6:.1f} MB")
+
+
+def srgb_to_linear(c):
+    """sRGB 0..1 (or 0..255 ints, or "#rrggbb") -> scene-linear RGB tuple, for node colours."""
+    if isinstance(c, str):
+        c = [int(c.lstrip("#")[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4)]
+    c = [float(x) for x in c[:3]]
+    if max(c) > 1.0:
+        c = [x / 255.0 for x in c]
+    return tuple(x / 12.92 if x <= 0.04045 else ((x + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4 for x in c)
+
+
+def rgba(c, a=1.0):
+    """Node colour (r, g, b, a) in scene-linear from an sRGB colour (see srgb_to_linear)."""
+    return (*srgb_to_linear(c), a)
+
+
+def args_after_dashes():
+    return sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:] if "--" in sys.argv else []

hunks.note: A new module. It makes the camera from the measured model, sets Cycles up on the GPU and appends a part's collection from its file. Parts never share datablocks, only files.

Brings a built part's collection in from parts/<name>.blend, so parts can be built in any order.

files.explanation: A library of rock materials (a first version): presets of procedural rock (strata, fracture blocks, chips, weathered tops, a tone ramp), and modifiers that displace the rock's surface. Part of the Crimson Valley project in external/blender/: a recreation of a reference picture of an alien valley at sunset as a real 3D scene in Blender. It isn't part of the game or its builds.

+ATTR_OFFSET = "rock_off"     # FLOAT_VECTOR, written by the relief modifier: how far it moved each vertex
+ATTR_GEO = "rock_geo"        # FLOAT 0..1, written by the relief modifier: 1 where the relief is real geometry
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ parameters

+    gain=1.0,                 # multiplies every albedo
+    px_scale=1.0,             # the pixel the detail is limited to, in picture pixels (2 = half-size renders)

+    # strata: layers `strata` metres thick, their normal tilted `strata_dip` degrees from vertical

+    block_relief=0.12, block_tilt=0.10, block_rib=0.0, block_crack=0.08, block_crack_w=0.02,
+    # chips: the small fracture network
+    chip=0.5, chip_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), chip_rot=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), chip_random=1.0,
+    chip_relief=0.03, chip_tilt=0.03, chip_rib=0.0, chip_crack=0.02, chip_crack_w=0.008,
+    # grain
+    grain=0.10, grain_bump=0.008, grain_color=0.2,
+    # stains and wetness

+    # lichen specks
+    specks=0.0, speck_size=0.06, speck_color="#b9a274",
+    # what the cover attributes blend to
+    moss_color="#8d8a2e", soil_color="#3c1a14",
+    # shading relief
+    bump=1.0, bump_fine=1.0, bump_on_geo=0.4, facet=0.2, bump_filter=0.1,
+    # geometric relief (the modifier)
+    relief=1.0, relief_max=1.0, relief_chips=True,
+)
+
+PRESETS = {
+    "sandstone": dict(),
+    "slab": dict(dark="#1f1d1c", base="#34312f", alt="#4b3a2c", light="#57534f", top="#3a3b3e", top_amount=0.8,
+                 top_rough=0.4, strata=0.12, strata_relief=0.015, strata_notch=0.01, block=0.9,
+                 block_stretch=(1.3, 1.3, 0.7), block_relief=0.05, block_crack=0.05, block_crack_w=0.012,
+                 chip=0.25, chip_relief=0.012, chip_crack=0.01, grain=0.05, specks=0.25, var_size=3.0,

+    "boulder": dict(dark="#3b2a20", base="#7d5a40", alt="#8e6038", light="#b08e6e", strata=0.0,
+                    block=1.2, block_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 3.0), block_relief=0.10, block_crack=0.08, rim=0.5,
+                    chip=0.3, chip_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 2.0), var_size=4.0),
+    "spire": dict(dark="#3d3835", base="#6e5c50", alt="#86694f", light="#a58a72", strata=0.0,
+                  block=2.4, block_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 9.0), block_relief=0.5, block_tilt=0.3, block_rib=0.5,
+                  block_crack=0.4, block_crack_w=0.15, chip=0.8, chip_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 4.0), chip_relief=0.12,
+                  chip_crack=0.08, chip_crack_w=0.04, grain=0.5, grain_bump=0.03, var_size=25.0, warp_size=30.0,
+                  warp=2.0, relief_max=2.0),
+    "cliff": dict(dark="#2e2a29", base="#55473f", alt="#6d5140", light="#8c725e", strata=1.5, strata_relief=0.2,
+                  strata_notch=0.15, strata_notch_w=0.1, block=2.6, block_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 6.0),
+                  block_relief=0.4, block_tilt=0.25, block_crack=0.3, block_crack_w=0.12, chip=0.9,
+                  chip_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 3.0), chip_relief=0.1, chip_crack=0.06, chip_crack_w=0.04, grain=0.5,
+                  grain_bump=0.03, stains=0.5, stain_size=4.0, var_size=25.0, warp_size=30.0, warp=2.0,
+                  relief_max=2.0),
+    "far": dict(dark="#5a5350", base="#7d6e65", alt="#8f7866", light="#a8937f", strata=0.0, block=5.0,
+                block_stretch=(1.0, 1.0, 8.0), block_relief=0.8, block_tilt=0.5, block_rib=0.8, block_crack=0.6,
+                block_crack_w=0.4, chip=0.0, grain=1.5, grain_bump=0.06, var_size=60.0, warp_size=60.0, warp=4.0,
+                relief_max=3.0),
+}
+
+
+def params(preset="sandstone", **overrides):
+    """The full parameter set of a preset, with overrides (unknown names are an error)."""
+    if preset not in PRESETS:
+        raise KeyError(f"unknown rock preset {preset!r} (have: {', '.join(PRESETS)})")
+    p = dict(DEFAULTS)
+    p.update(PRESETS[preset])
+    for k, v in overrides.items():
+        if k not in DEFAULTS:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown rock parameter {k!r}")
+        p[k] = v
+    p["preset"] = preset
+    return p
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ node graphs
+def _num(v):
+    return isinstance(v, (int, float))
+
+
+def _sock(sockets, identifier):
+    for s in sockets:
+        if s.identifier == identifier:
+            return s
+    raise KeyError(identifier)
+
+
+class G:
+    """Builds a node graph in a shader or geometry node tree. Every method returns an output socket -
+    or a plain number when all its inputs were numbers (constants are folded)."""
+    FOLD = {"ADD": lambda a, b: a + b, "SUBTRACT": lambda a, b: a - b, "MULTIPLY": lambda a, b: a * b,
+            "DIVIDE": lambda a, b: a / b if b else 0.0, "MAXIMUM": max, "MINIMUM": min}
+
+    def __init__(self, tree):
+        self.t = tree
+        self.k = 0
+
+    def node(self, kind, **props):
+        n = self.t.nodes.new(kind)
+        for a, v in props.items():
+            setattr(n, a, v)
+        n.location = (220 * (self.k // 8), -170 * (self.k % 8))
+        self.k += 1
+        return n
+
+    def put(self, sock, v):
+        if v is None:
+            return
+        if isinstance(v, bpy.types.NodeSocket):
+            self.t.links.new(v, sock)
+        elif sock.type == "VECTOR" and _num(v):
+            sock.default_value = (v, v, v)
+        elif sock.type == "RGBA" and len(v) == 3:
+            sock.default_value = (*v, 1.0)
+        else:
+            sock.default_value = v
+
+    # --- scalars
+    def math(self, op, a, b=None, c=None, clamp=False):
+        if op in self.FOLD and _num(a) and _num(b):
+            return self.FOLD[op](a, b)
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeMath", operation=op, use_clamp=clamp)
+        for i, v in enumerate((a, b, c)):
+            self.put(n.inputs[i], v)
+        return n.outputs[0]
+
+    def add(self, a, b):
+        if _num(a) and a == 0:
+            return b
+        if _num(b) and b == 0:
+            return a
+        return self.math("ADD", a, b)
+
+    def sub(self, a, b):
+        if _num(b) and b == 0:
+            return a
+        return self.math("SUBTRACT", a, b)
+
+    def mul(self, a, b):
+        for x, y in ((a, b), (b, a)):
+            if _num(x) and x == 1:
+                return y
+            if _num(x) and x == 0:
+                return 0.0
+        return self.math("MULTIPLY", a, b)
+
+    def div(self, a, b):
+        return self.math("DIVIDE", a, b)
+
+    def maxi(self, a, b):
+        return self.math("MAXIMUM", a, b)
+
+    def mini(self, a, b):
+        return self.math("MINIMUM", a, b)
+
+    def clamp01(self, a):
+        if _num(a):
+            return min(1.0, max(0.0, a))
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeClamp")
+        self.put(n.inputs[0], a)
+        return n.outputs[0]
+
+    def ramp(self, x, a, b, c=0.0, d=1.0, kind="SMOOTHSTEP"):
+        """x from a..b mapped to c..d, clamped (a > b is fine: a falling ramp)."""
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeMapRange", interpolation_type=kind, clamp=True)
+        for i, v in enumerate((x, a, b, c, d)):
+            self.put(n.inputs[i], v)
+        return n.outputs[0]
+
+    def lerp(self, a, b, t):
+        if _num(t):
+            if _num(a) and _num(b):
+                return a + (b - a) * t
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeMix", data_type="FLOAT", clamp_factor=True)
+        self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "Factor_Float"), t)
+        self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "A_Float"), a)
+        self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "B_Float"), b)
+        return _sock(n.outputs, "Result_Float")
+
+    # --- vectors
+    def vmath(self, op, a, b=None, scale=None):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeVectorMath", operation=op)
+        self.put(n.inputs[0], a)
+        if b is not None:
+            self.put(n.inputs[1], b)
+        if scale is not None:
+            self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "Scale"), scale)
+        return n.outputs[1] if op in ("DOT_PRODUCT", "LENGTH", "DISTANCE") else n.outputs[0]
+
+    def sep(self, v):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
+        self.put(n.inputs[0], v)
+        return n.outputs[0], n.outputs[1], n.outputs[2]
+
+    def combine(self, x, y, z):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
+        for i, v in enumerate((x, y, z)):
+            self.put(n.inputs[i], v)
+        return n.outputs[0]
+
+    # --- colours
+    def mix(self, fac, a, b, blend="MIX"):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeMix", data_type="RGBA", blend_type=blend, clamp_factor=True)
+        self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "Factor_Float"), fac)
+        self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "A_Color"), a)
+        self.put(_sock(n.inputs, "B_Color"), b)
+        return _sock(n.outputs, "Result_Color")
+
+    def color_ramp(self, fac, stops):
+        """stops: [(position, (r, g, b, a)), ...]"""
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
+        el = n.color_ramp.elements
+        while len(el) < len(stops):
+            el.new(0.5)
+        for e, (pos, c) in zip(el, sorted(stops)):
+            e.position = pos
+            e.color = c
+        self.put(n.inputs[0], fac)
+        return n.outputs[0]
+
+    # --- textures
+    def noise(self, vec=None, scale=1.0, detail=2.0, rough=0.5, lac=2.0, distortion=0.0, dims="3D",
+              kind="FBM", w=None, color=False):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", noise_dimensions=dims, noise_type=kind, normalize=True)
+        if vec is not None:
+            self.put(n.inputs["Vector"], vec)
+        if w is not None:
+            self.put(n.inputs["W"], w)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Scale"], scale)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Detail"], detail)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Roughness"], rough)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Lacunarity"], lac)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Distortion"], distortion)
+        return n.outputs[1] if color else n.outputs[0]
+
+    def voronoi(self, vec=None, feature="F1", dims="3D", randomness=1.0, w=None):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi", voronoi_dimensions=dims, feature=feature)
+        if vec is not None:
+            self.put(n.inputs["Vector"], vec)
+        if w is not None:
+            self.put(n.inputs["W"], w)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Scale"], 1.0)
+        self.put(n.inputs["Randomness"], randomness)
+        return n
+
+    def attr(self, name, out="Fac"):
+        n = self.node("ShaderNodeAttribute", attribute_type="GEOMETRY", attribute_name=name)
+        return _sock(n.outputs, out)
+
+
+def _axes(rot_deg):
+    """The three axes of a frame turned by XYZ Euler angles (degrees)."""
+    from mathutils import Euler
+    m = Euler([math.radians(a) for a in rot_deg], "XYZ").to_matrix()
+    return [tuple(m.col[i]) for i in range(3)]
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the pattern
+class Pattern:
+    """The rock's structure as functions of position, shared by the material (colour, bump) and the relief
+    modifier (geometry): strata, two fracture networks, each fading out where its features would be
+    smaller than a few pixels (px: the size of a pixel at this point, in metres)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, g, P, px, p, geo=False):
+        self.g, self.px, self.p, self.geo = g, px, p, geo
+        self.S = S = p["scale"]
+        # features this many pixels across are left out / drawn in full; cracks are at least this wide
+        self.lo, self.hi, self.crack_px = (3.0, 8.0, 1.5) if geo else (2.0, 5.0, 0.7)
+        k = p["seed"]
+        if k:
+            P = g.vmath("ADD", P, (37.7 * k, -21.3 * k, 11.9 * k))
+        self.P = P
+        if p["warp"] > 0:
+            c = g.noise(P, scale=1.0 / (p["warp_size"] * S), detail=1.0, color=True)
+            w = g.vmath("SCALE", g.vmath("SUBTRACT", c, (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)), scale=2.0 * p["warp"] * S)
+            self.Pw = g.vmath("ADD", P, w)
+        else:
+            self.Pw = P
+        self._cache = {}
+
+    def fade(self, size, lo=None, hi=None):
+        """0 where a feature of `size` metres is under lo pixels, 1 where it is over hi."""
+        return self.g.ramp(self.px, size / (lo or self.lo), size / (hi or self.hi))
+
+    # --- strata
+    def strata(self):
+        if "strata" in self._cache:
+            return self._cache["strata"]
+        g, p = self.g, self.p
+        th = p["strata"] * self.S
+        dip, az = math.radians(p["strata_dip"]), math.radians(p["strata_az"])
+        n = (math.sin(dip) * math.sin(az), math.sin(dip) * math.cos(az), math.cos(dip))
+        s = g.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", self.Pw, tuple(c / th for c in n))
+        f1 = g.voronoi(w=s, dims="1D", feature="F1")
+        ed = g.voronoi(w=s, dims="1D", feature="DISTANCE_TO_EDGE")
+        st = dict(s=s, rand=g.sep(f1.outputs["Color"]), edge=g.mul(ed.outputs["Distance"], th), th=th,
+                  fade=self.fade(th))
+        self._cache["strata"] = st
+        return st
+
+    def strata_height(self):
+        """Layers standing out or back, with a parting between them (metres)."""
+        g, p, S = self.g, self.p, self.S
+        st = self.strata()
+        h = g.mul(g.sub(st["rand"][0], 0.5), 2.0 * p["strata_relief"] * S)
+        w = g.maxi(p["strata_notch_w"] * S, g.mul(self.px, self.crack_px))
+        st["crack"] = g.ramp(st["edge"], 0.0, w, 1.0, 0.0)
+        h = g.sub(h, g.mul(st["crack"], p["strata_notch"] * S))
+        return g.mul(h, st["fade"])
+
+    # --- fracture networks
+    def cells(self, k):
+        if k in self._cache:
+            return self._cache[k]
+        g, p = self.g, self.p
+        size = p[k] * self.S
+        st = p[k + "_stretch"]
+        inv = [1.0 / (size * c) for c in st]
+        if any(p[k + "_rot"]):
+            ax = _axes(p[k + "_rot"])
+            q = g.combine(*[g.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", self.Pw, tuple(a * inv[i] for a in ax[i])) for i in range(3)])
+        else:
+            q = g.vmath("MULTIPLY", self.Pw, tuple(inv))
+        if k != "block":
+            q = g.vmath("ADD", q, (5.2, 1.3, 8.1))
+        f1 = g.voronoi(q, feature="F1", randomness=p[k + "_random"])
+        ed = g.voronoi(q, feature="DISTANCE_TO_EDGE", randomness=p[k + "_random"])
+        smin = size * min(st)
+        c = dict(q=q, d1=f1.outputs["Distance"], col=f1.outputs["Color"], rand=g.sep(f1.outputs["Color"]),
+                 pos=f1.outputs["Position"], edge=g.mul(ed.outputs["Distance"], smin), size=smin,
+                 fade=self.fade(smin))
+        w = g.maxi(p[k + "_crack_w"] * self.S, g.mul(self.px, self.crack_px))
+        c["w"] = w
+        c["crack"] = g.ramp(c["edge"], 0.0, w, 1.0, 0.0)
+        self._cache[k] = c
+        return c
+
+    def cells_height(self, k):
+        """Blocks standing out or back, tilted, rounded, with cracks between them (metres)."""
+        g, p, S = self.g, self.p, self.S
+        c = self.cells(k)
+        h = g.mul(g.sub(c["rand"][0], 0.5), 2.0 * p[k + "_relief"] * S)
+        if p[k + "_tilt"]:
+            lv = g.vmath("SUBTRACT", c["q"], c["pos"])
+            tv = g.vmath("SUBTRACT", c["col"], (0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+            h = g.add(h, g.mul(g.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", lv, tv), 4.0 * p[k + "_tilt"] * S))
+        if p[k + "_rib"]:
+            h = g.add(h, g.ramp(c["d1"], 0.0, 0.8, p[k + "_rib"] * S, 0.0))
+        h = g.sub(h, g.mul(c["crack"], p[k + "_crack"] * S))
+        return g.mul(h, c["fade"])
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the material
+def rock_material(name, preset="sandstone", **overrides):
+    """A procedural Cycles rock material (see the module docstring)."""
+    p = params(preset, **overrides)
+    S = p["scale"]
+    mat, nodes, links = common.new_material(name)
+    mat["cv_rock"] = json.dumps({"preset": preset, "overrides": overrides})
+    g = G(mat.node_tree)
+    f_px = float(common.cam_model().f)
+
+    tc = g.node("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    geo = g.node("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    P = g.vmath("SUBTRACT", tc.outputs["Object"], g.attr(ATTR_OFFSET, "Vector"))
+    if p["dist_from"] == "attribute":
+        dist = g.attr("dist")
+    else:
+        dist = g.node("ShaderNodeCameraData").outputs["View Distance"]
+    px = g.maxi(g.mul(dist, p["px_scale"] / f_px), 1e-4)
+    pat = Pattern(g, P, px, p)
+    N = geo.outputs["Normal"]
+    up = g.sep(N)[2]
+    geo_w = g.attr(ATTR_GEO)
+
+    def col(c):
+        r, gr, b = common.srgb_to_linear(c)
+        k = p["gain"]
+        return (min(1.0, r * k), min(1.0, gr * k), min(1.0, b * k), 1.0)
+
+    # ---- structure
+    h_mid, h_fine = 0.0, 0.0
+    tone = 0.5
+    dark = 0.0                                   # cracks, 0..1
+    var = g.noise(P, scale=1.0 / (p["var_size"] * S), detail=3.0, rough=0.55, color=True)
+    vr, vg, vb = g.sep(var)
+    tone = g.add(tone, g.mul(g.sub(vr, 0.5), 2.0 * p["tone_noise"]))
+    Nf = N
+    if p["strata"] > 0:
+        st = pat.strata()
+        h_mid = g.add(h_mid, pat.strata_height())
+        tone = g.add(tone, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(st["rand"][1], 0.5), p["tone_strata"]), st["fade"]))
+        dark = g.add(dark, g.mul(g.mul(st["crack"], st["fade"]), 0.6))
+        if p["lamination"]:
+            lam = g.noise(w=g.mul(st["s"], 7.0), dims="1D", detail=2.0, rough=0.6)
+            lf = pat.fade(st["th"] / 7.0)
+            tone = g.add(tone, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(lam, 0.5), p["lamination"]), lf))
+            h_fine = g.add(h_fine, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(lam, 0.5), 0.25 * p["strata_relief"] * S), lf))
+    rim = 0.0
+    for k in ("block", "chip"):
+        if p[k] <= 0:
+            continue
+        c = pat.cells(k)
+        hk = pat.cells_height(k)
+        if k == "block":
+            h_mid = g.add(h_mid, hk)
+            tone = g.add(tone, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(c["rand"][1], 0.5), p["tone_blocks"]), c["fade"]))
+        else:
+            h_fine = g.add(h_fine, hk)
+            tone = g.add(tone, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(c["rand"][1], 0.5), 0.4 * p["tone_blocks"]), c["fade"]))
+        dark = g.add(dark, g.mul(g.mul(c["crack"], c["fade"]), 1.0 if k == "block" else 0.6))
+        if p["rim"]:
+            band = g.mul(g.ramp(c["edge"], c["w"], g.mul(c["w"], 3.5), 1.0, 0.0), g.sub(1.0, c["crack"]))
+            rim = g.add(rim, g.mul(g.mul(band, c["fade"]), 1.0 if k == "block" else 0.5))
+        if p["facet"]:
+            tv = g.vmath("SUBTRACT", c["col"], (0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+            amount = g.mul(c["fade"], 2.0 * p["facet"] * (1.0 if k == "block" else 0.5))
+            Nf = g.vmath("ADD", Nf, g.vmath("SCALE", tv, scale=amount))
+    if Nf is not N:
+        Nf = g.vmath("NORMALIZE", Nf)
+
+    # grain: fine noise whose finest octave stays above the pixel size
+    gs = p["grain"] * S
+    detail = g.math("LOGARITHM", g.div(gs / 2.5, px), 2.0)
+    n = g.node("ShaderNodeClamp")
+    g.put(n.inputs[0], detail)
+    n.inputs[1].default_value, n.inputs[2].default_value = 0.0, 6.0
+    grain = g.noise(P, scale=1.0 / gs, detail=n.outputs[0], rough=0.6)
+    gf = pat.fade(gs, 1.2, 3.0)
+    h_fine = g.add(h_fine, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(grain, 0.5), 2.0 * p["grain_bump"] * S), gf))
+
+    # ---- colour
+    c = g.color_ramp(g.clamp01(tone), [(p["ramp"][0], col(p["dark"])), (p["ramp"][1], col(p["base"])),
+                                       (p["ramp"][2], col(p["alt"])), (p["ramp"][3], col(p["light"]))])
+    value = g.add(1.0, g.mul(g.sub(vg, 0.5), 2.0 * p["var"]))
+    value = g.mul(value, g.add(1.0, g.mul(g.mul(g.sub(grain, 0.5), 2.0 * p["grain_color"]), gf)))
+    if p["rim"]:
+        c = g.mix(g.mul(g.clamp01(rim), p["rim"]), c, col(p["light"]))
+    value = g.mul(value, g.sub(1.0, g.mul(g.clamp01(dark), p["crack_dark"])))
+    rough = p["rough"]
+    if p["top_amount"]:
+        tm = g.mul(g.ramp(g.add(up, g.mul(g.sub(vb, 0.5), 0.6)), 0.35, 0.75), p["top_amount"])
+        c = g.mix(tm, c, col(p["top"]))
+        rough = g.lerp(rough, p["top_rough"], tm)
+    if p["stains"]:
+        sv = g.vmath("MULTIPLY", P, tuple(1.0 / (p["stain_size"] * S * k) for k in (1.0, 1.0, 12.0)))
+        sn = g.noise(sv, scale=1.0, detail=3.0, rough=0.6)
+        sm = g.mul(g.mul(g.ramp(sn, 0.45, 0.7), g.ramp(up, 0.9, 0.3)), p["stains"])
+        value = g.mul(value, g.sub(1.0, g.mul(sm, 0.65)))
+        rough = g.sub(rough, g.mul(sm, 0.25 * 1.0))
+    wet = g.clamp01(g.add(p["wet"], g.attr("wet")))
+    value = g.mul(value, g.sub(1.0, g.mul(wet, 0.5)))
+    rough = g.lerp(rough, 0.15, wet)
+    c = g.vmath("SCALE", c, scale=value)
+    if p["specks"]:
+        q = g.vmath("SCALE", P, scale=1.0 / (p["speck_size"] * S * 3.0))
+        v = g.voronoi(q, feature="F1")
+        sr = g.sep(v.outputs["Color"])
+        dot = g.mul(g.ramp(v.outputs["Distance"], 0.22, 0.34, 1.0, 0.0), g.ramp(sr[0], 1.0 - p["specks"], 1.02 - p["specks"]))
+        dot = g.mul(dot, pat.fade(p["speck_size"] * S, 0.8, 2.0))
+        c = g.mix(dot, c, col(p["speck_color"]))
+    # plant cover from the picture's masks
+    veg = g.attr("veg")
+    soil = g.clamp01(g.mul(g.mul(veg, g.add(0.5, vb)), g.ramp(up, -0.3, 0.5, 0.35, 1.0)))
+    c = g.mix(soil, c, col(p["soil_color"]))
+    moss = g.clamp01(g.mul(g.mul(g.attr("moss"), g.add(0.4, g.mul(vg, 1.2))), g.ramp(up, 0.05, 0.55)))
+    c = g.mix(moss, c, col(p["moss_color"]))
+    rough = g.lerp(rough, 0.95, g.maxi(soil, moss))
+
+    # ---- relief in the shading
+    b1 = g.node("ShaderNodeBump")
+    g.put(b1.inputs["Strength"], g.lerp(1.0, p["bump_on_geo"], geo_w))
+    b1.inputs["Distance"].default_value = p["bump"]
+    b1.inputs["Filter Width"].default_value = p["bump_filter"]
+    g.put(b1.inputs["Height"], h_mid)
+    g.put(b1.inputs["Normal"], Nf)
+    b2 = g.node("ShaderNodeBump")
+    b2.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 1.0
+    b2.inputs["Distance"].default_value = p["bump_fine"]
+    b2.inputs["Filter Width"].default_value = p["bump_filter"]
+    g.put(b2.inputs["Height"], h_fine)
+    g.put(b2.inputs["Normal"], b1.outputs["Normal"])
+
+    bsdf = g.node("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    g.put(bsdf.inputs["Base Color"], c)
+    g.put(bsdf.inputs["Roughness"], rough)
+    bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = p["spec"]
+    g.put(bsdf.inputs["Normal"], b2.outputs["Normal"])
+    out = g.node("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    links.new(bsdf.outputs["BSDF"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the relief
+def relief_group(preset="sandstone", **overrides):
+    """The geometry-node group that turns the pattern's mid-scale relief into real geometry."""
+    p = params(preset, **overrides)
+    S = p["scale"]
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    tree = bpy.data.node_groups.new("CV_RockRelief_" + preset, "GeometryNodeTree")
+    tree.interface.new_socket(name="Geometry", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
+    tree.interface.new_socket(name="Geometry", in_out="OUTPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
+    s_cam = tree.interface.new_socket(name="Camera", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketVector")
+    s_cam.default_value = tuple(float(v) for v in cm.pos)
+    s_str = tree.interface.new_socket(name="Strength", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketFloat")
+    s_str.default_value = 1.0
+    s_pix = tree.interface.new_socket(name="Pixel", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketFloat")
+    s_pix.default_value = p["px_scale"] / float(cm.f)
+    g = G(tree)
+    gin = g.node("NodeGroupInput")
+    gout = g.node("NodeGroupOutput")
+    P = g.node("GeometryNodeInputPosition").outputs[0]
+    N = g.node("GeometryNodeInputNormal").outputs["Normal"]
+    ray = g.vmath("SUBTRACT", P, gin.outputs["Camera"])
+    dist = g.vmath("LENGTH", ray)
+    rd = g.vmath("NORMALIZE", ray)
+    px = g.maxi(g.mul(dist, gin.outputs["Pixel"]), 1e-4)
+    pat = Pattern(g, P, px, p, geo=True)
+    h = 0.0
+    if p["strata"] > 0:
+        h = g.add(h, pat.strata_height())
+    if p["block"] > 0:
+        h = g.add(h, pat.cells_height("block"))
+    if p["chip"] > 0 and p["relief_chips"]:
+        h = g.add(h, pat.cells_height("chip"))
+    facing = g.math("ABSOLUTE", g.vmath("DOT_PRODUCT", N, rd))
+    w = g.ramp(facing, 0.03, 0.3)
+    amount = g.mul(g.mul(h, g.mul(w, gin.outputs["Strength"])), p["relief"])
+    amount = g.div(amount, g.maxi(facing, 0.45))
+    lim = p["relief_max"] * S
+    n = g.node("ShaderNodeClamp")
+    g.put(n.inputs[0], amount)
+    n.inputs[1].default_value, n.inputs[2].default_value = -lim, lim
+    off = g.vmath("SCALE", rd, scale=g.mul(n.outputs[0], -1.0))
+    sp = g.node("GeometryNodeSetPosition")
+    tree.links.new(gin.outputs["Geometry"], sp.inputs["Geometry"])
+    g.put(sp.inputs["Offset"], off)
+    s1 = g.node("GeometryNodeStoreNamedAttribute", data_type="FLOAT_VECTOR", domain="POINT")
+    tree.links.new(sp.outputs["Geometry"], s1.inputs["Geometry"])
+    s1.inputs["Name"].default_value = ATTR_OFFSET
+    g.put(s1.inputs["Value"], off)
+    s2 = g.node("GeometryNodeStoreNamedAttribute", data_type="FLOAT", domain="POINT")
+    tree.links.new(s1.outputs["Geometry"], s2.inputs["Geometry"])
+    s2.inputs["Name"].default_value = ATTR_GEO
+    g.put(s2.inputs["Value"], w)
+    tree.links.new(s2.outputs["Geometry"], gout.inputs[0])
+    tree["cv_rock"] = json.dumps({"preset": preset, "overrides": overrides})
+    return tree, s_cam, s_str
+
+
+def displace_modifiers(ob, preset=None, strength=1.0, **overrides):
+    """Add the relief modifier of a preset to a mesh object."""
+    if preset is None:
+        info = json.loads(ob.active_material["cv_rock"])
+        preset, overrides = info["preset"], {**info["overrides"], **overrides}
+    tree, s_cam, s_str = relief_group(preset, **overrides)
+    m = ob.modifiers.new("CV_RockRelief", "NODES")
+    m.node_group = tree
+    cam = ob.matrix_world.inverted() @ __import__("mathutils").Vector(tuple(float(v) for v in common.cam_model().pos))
+    m[s_cam.identifier] = tuple(cam)
+    m[s_str.identifier] = float(strength)
+    return m

files.explanation: Renders the scene from other viewpoints (the sides, above, from the river bank) to check that it holds up as a real 3D scene and not only from the picture's camera. Part of the Crimson Valley project in external/blender/: a recreation of a reference picture of an alien valley at sunset as a real 3D scene in Blender. It isn't part of the game or its builds.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,63 @@ 
+"""Look at the scene (or some of its parts) from other viewpoints, to check it holds up as 3D.
+
+  blender -b --factory-startup --python scene/orbit.py -- <out prefix> [--parts a,b,c] [--blend file.blend]
+          [--views right,high,top,left,close] [--scale 50] [--samples 32]
+
+Assembles the given parts (default: all built ones; or opens --blend) and renders each view to
+<out prefix>_<view>.png. Views: right / left (the camera moved 40 m sideways and turned back to the
+valley), high (a hill-top view from behind and above), top (straight down on the valley), close (from
+the river bank looking back at the hill the camera stands on)."""
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import common  # noqa: E402
+import bpy  # noqa: E402
+import mathutils  # noqa: E402
+
+VIEWS = {   # name: (camera position, target, lens mm)
+    "right": ((45.0, -5.0, 26.0), (10.0, 160.0, 12.0), 24.0),
+    "left": ((-45.0, 0.0, 30.0), (30.0, 160.0, 12.0), 24.0),
+    "high": ((20.0, -120.0, 110.0), (20.0, 170.0, 5.0), 28.0),
+    "top": ((20.0, 150.0, 520.0), (20.0, 150.5, 0.0), 35.0),
+    "close": ((60.0, 95.0, 6.0), (-20.0, 20.0, 18.0), 24.0),
+}
+
+
+def main():
+    a = common.args_after_dashes()
+    prefix = a[0]
+    opt = {"--parts": "", "--blend": "", "--views": "right,high,top", "--scale": "50", "--samples": "32"}
+    i = 1
+    while i < len(a):
+        opt[a[i]] = a[i + 1]
+        i += 2
+    if opt["--blend"]:
+        bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=os.path.abspath(opt["--blend"]))
+        scene = bpy.context.scene
+        common.enable_gpu()
+        scene.cycles.device = "GPU"
+    else:
+        scene = common.reset_scene()
+        only = [p for p in opt["--parts"].split(",") if p]
+        used = [p for p in common.PART_ORDER if (not only or p in only) and common.append_part(scene, p) is not None]
+        for p in used:
+            m = common.part_module(p)
+            if hasattr(m, "finalize"):
+                m.finalize(scene)
+        if scene.world is None:
+            common.preview_world(scene)
+        if "lighting" not in used:
+            common.preview_sun(scene)
+    cam = scene.camera
+    for name in opt["--views"].split(","):
+        pos, target, lens = VIEWS[name]
+        cam.location = pos
+        d = mathutils.Vector(target) - mathutils.Vector(pos)
+        cam.rotation_euler = d.to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
+        cam.data.lens = lens
+        common.render(scene, os.path.abspath(f"{prefix}_{name}.png"), scale=int(opt["--scale"]), samples=int(opt["--samples"]))
+
+
+main()

@@ -1,0 +1,35 @@ 
+"""A check of the camera, not part of the scene: glowing balls at known picture positions.
+
+  blender -b --factory-startup --python scene/build_part.py -- camcheck --no-save --no-sun --render renders/camcheck.png --scale 100 --samples 4
+
+Each ball is put where cvlib says a picture point lies in the world; tools/camcheck_verify.py then
+finds the balls in the render and reports how many pixels off they are (it should be under one)."""
+import bpy
+
+import common
+
+POINTS = [(100.5, 100.5, 50.0), (836.0, 470.5, 80.0), (1500.5, 800.5, 45.0), (300.5, 880.5, 15.6),
+          (1560.5, 60.5, 198.0), (836.0, 432.0, 3000.0), (1150.5, 620.5, 118.0), (50.5, 900.5, 30.0)]
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    mat, nodes, links = common.new_material("CV_CamCheck")
+    em = nodes.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
+    em.inputs["Color"].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
+    em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 5.0
+    out = nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    links.new(em.outputs["Emission"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    for k, (u, v, z) in enumerate(POINTS):
+        p = cm.unproject(u, v, z)
+        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=6.0 * z / cm.f, location=tuple(p), segments=24, ring_count=12)
+        ob = bpy.context.active_object
+        ob.name = f"CV_CamCheck_{k}"
+        for c in list(ob.users_collection):
+            c.objects.unlink(ob)
+        col.objects.link(ob)
+        ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+    w = bpy.data.worlds.new("CV_Black")
+    nt = common.node_tree(w)
+    nt.nodes["Background"].inputs["Color"].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
+    bpy.context.scene.world = w

@@ -1,0 +1,105 @@ 
+"""The city on the arch and the cliffs: part "city".
+
+  tools/cv part city --with sky,clouds,rocks --render renders/city/a.png
+
+Towers, a dome and galleries measured off the picture (base and top in picture pixels, width in
+pixels; STRUCTURES below) and stood on the rock: each one's distance is the depth of the rock just
+under its base (analysis/depth.npy), its height and width the pixel sizes times depth / f. Towers are
+tapered shafts with a spire, the dome a half sphere on a drum with a mast, galleries long low blocks.
+The material is dark teal-grey stone with a procedural grid of warm lit windows (emission)."""
+import math
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+# kind, base u, base v, top v, width px
+STRUCTURES = [
+    ("tower", 1283, 289, 205, 15), ("tower", 1300, 290, 186, 12), ("tower", 1326, 289, 160, 11),
+    ("tower", 1341, 290, 214, 10), ("tower", 1266, 291, 236, 12), ("tower", 1313, 290, 226, 16),
+    ("dome", 1226, 291, 262, 34), ("block", 1193, 294, 276, 34), ("block", 1250, 293, 272, 30),
+    ("tower", 1440, 301, 214, 10), ("tower", 1462, 301, 236, 9), ("tower", 1421, 302, 250, 10),
+    ("tower", 1480, 302, 258, 8), ("block", 1385, 303, 280, 70), ("block", 1505, 306, 286, 90),
+    ("mast", 1597, 82, 20, 5), ("mast", 1650, 182, 132, 6), ("mast", 1337, 215, 190, 3),
+]
+
+
+def material():
+    mat, N, L = common.new_material("CV_City")
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    bsdf = N.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = common.rgba("#3c4648")
+    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.5
+    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = 0.3
+    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
+    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (1.6, 1.6, 0.9)
+    L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
+    br = N.new("ShaderNodeTexBrick")
+    br.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 1.0
+    br.inputs["Mortar Size"].default_value = 0.35
+    br.inputs["Color1"].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
+    br.inputs["Color2"].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
+    br.inputs["Mortar"].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], br.inputs["Vector"])
+    wn = N.new("ShaderNodeTexWhiteNoise")
+    sn = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath"); sn.operation = "SNAP"
+    sn.inputs[1].default_value = (0.31, 0.31, 0.55)
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], sn.inputs[0])
+    L.new(sn.outputs[0], wn.inputs["Vector"])
+    lit = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); lit.operation = "GREATER_THAN"; lit.inputs[1].default_value = 0.62
+    L.new(wn.outputs["Value"], lit.inputs[0])
+    m = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(lit.outputs[0], m.inputs[0]); L.new(br.outputs["Fac"], m.inputs[1])
+    inv = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); inv.operation = "SUBTRACT"; inv.inputs[0].default_value = 1.0
+    L.new(br.outputs["Fac"], inv.inputs[1])
+    m2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m2.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(lit.outputs[0], m2.inputs[0]); L.new(inv.outputs[0], m2.inputs[1])
+    bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = common.rgba("#ffcf80")
+    st = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); st.operation = "MULTIPLY"; st.inputs[1].default_value = 6.0
+    L.new(m2.outputs[0], st.inputs[0])
+    L.new(st.outputs[0], bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"])
+    L.new(bsdf.outputs["BSDF"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat
+
+
+def add(col, mat, name, prim, **kw):
+    getattr(bpy.ops.mesh, prim)(**kw)
+    ob = bpy.context.active_object
+    ob.name = name
+    for c in list(ob.users_collection):
+        c.objects.unlink(ob)
+    col.objects.link(ob)
+    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+    return ob
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    z = np.load(common.ANALYSIS + "/depth.npy")
+    mat = material()
+    for k, (kind, u, vb, vt, wpx) in enumerate(STRUCTURES):
+        patch = z[vb + 2:vb + 10, max(u - wpx // 2, 0):u + wpx // 2 + 1]
+        patch = patch[patch > 0]
+        if not len(patch):
+            continue
+        d = float(np.median(patch))
+        base = cm.unproject(np.array(float(u)), np.array(float(vb) + 4), np.array(d))
+        h = (vb - vt) * d / cm.f
+        w = wpx * d / cm.f
+        loc = lambda zc: (base[0], base[1], base[2] + zc)
+        n = f"CV_City_{k:02d}_{kind}"
+        if kind == "tower":
+            add(col, mat, n, "primitive_cone_add", vertices=10, radius1=w / 2, radius2=w * 0.3, depth=h * 0.72, location=loc(h * 0.36 - 1))
+            add(col, mat, n + "_spire", "primitive_cone_add", vertices=10, radius1=w * 0.33, radius2=0.0, depth=h * 0.3, location=loc(h * 0.85))
+            add(col, mat, n + "_ring", "primitive_cylinder_add", vertices=10, radius=w * 0.42, depth=h * 0.04, location=loc(h * 0.70))
+        elif kind == "dome":
+            add(col, mat, n, "primitive_cylinder_add", vertices=16, radius=w / 2, depth=h * 0.5, location=loc(h * 0.25 - 1))
+            add(col, mat, n + "_cap", "primitive_uv_sphere_add", segments=16, ring_count=8, radius=w * 0.46, location=loc(h * 0.5))
+            add(col, mat, n + "_mast", "primitive_cone_add", vertices=6, radius1=w * 0.04, radius2=0.0, depth=h * 0.6, location=loc(h * 1.05))
+        elif kind == "block":
+            ob = add(col, mat, n, "primitive_cube_add", size=1.0, location=loc(h * 0.5 - 1))
+            ob.scale = (w, w * 0.5, h + 2)
+        else:
+            add(col, mat, n, "primitive_cone_add", vertices=6, radius1=w / 2, radius2=0.0, depth=h + 2, location=loc(h * 0.5 - 1))

@@ -1,0 +1,125 @@ 
+"""The clouds of the Crimson Valley scene: part "clouds".
+
+  tools/cv part clouds --with sky,planet,moons --render renders/clouds/a.png --no-sun
+
+CV_Clouds is a card 20 km in front of the camera (in front of the planet at 60 km, behind the far
+mountains at 9 km), parallel to the picture plane and larger than the frame. Its material is self-lit
+(emission) and takes the cloud masses, the glow and their colours from the layout guide
+analysis/cloud_guide.png (tools/make_cloud_guide.py: the picture's sky at quarter size, blurred, with
+the land, planet and moons filled in) - and makes the detail itself: the guide is looked up through
+two scales of noise (billows and wisps), and a finer noise brightens and darkens the cloud bodies.
+The guide's alpha is the cloud cover over the planet: clear over its disc, closing where its lower
+limb sinks into the haze. Past the frame the card fades out to the world's clear sky.
+Ray visibility: camera and glossy (the river mirrors it); it casts no shadow and lights nothing."""
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+DIST = 20000.0
+U0, U1, V0, V1 = -700.0, 2372.0, -500.0, 520.0      # the card, in picture pixels (the guide covers rows 0-520)
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    nu, nv = 48, 16
+    uu, vv = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(U0, U1, nu + 1), np.linspace(V0, V1, nv + 1))
+    pts = cm.unproject(uu.ravel(), vv.ravel(), np.full(uu.size, DIST))
+    idx = np.arange(uu.size).reshape(nv + 1, nu + 1)
+    faces = np.stack([idx[:-1, :-1], idx[1:, :-1], idx[1:, 1:], idx[:-1, 1:]], -1).reshape(-1, 4)
+    uvs = np.stack([uu.ravel() / common.W, 1 - vv.ravel() / 520.0], 1)      # guide UV: rows 0-520
+    ob = common.mesh_object("CV_Clouds", pts, faces.astype(np.int32), col, smooth=False, uvs=uvs)
+    ob.visible_diffuse = False
+    ob.visible_shadow = False
+    ob.visible_transmission = False
+    ob.visible_volume_scatter = False
+
+    mat, N, L = common.new_material("CV_Clouds")
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    uv = N.new("ShaderNodeUVMap")
+    uv.uv_map = "UVMap"
+    # warp: billows (large) and wisps (small), in guide UV units
+    def noise(scale, detail, rough):
+        n = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
+        n.noise_type = "FBM"
+        n.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale
+        n.inputs["Detail"].default_value = detail
+        n.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
+        return n
+    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
+    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (1.0, 0.31, 1.0)       # the guide is 3.2 times wider than tall
+    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
+    n1, n2 = noise(14.0, 6.0, 0.6), noise(70.0, 5.0, 0.65)
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], n1.inputs["Vector"])
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], n2.inputs["Vector"])
+    def offset(n, amount):
+        sub = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+        sub.operation = "SUBTRACT"
+        sub.inputs[1].default_value = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
+        L.new(n.outputs["Color"], sub.inputs[0])
+        sc = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+        sc.operation = "SCALE"
+        sc.inputs["Scale"].default_value = amount
+        L.new(sub.outputs[0], sc.inputs[0])
+        return sc
+    o1, o2 = offset(n1, 0.012), offset(n2, 0.006)
+    add1 = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], add1.inputs[0])
+    L.new(o1.outputs[0], add1.inputs[1])
+    add2 = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+    L.new(add1.outputs[0], add2.inputs[0])
+    L.new(o2.outputs[0], add2.inputs[1])
+    img = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(common.ANALYSIS, "cloud_guide.png"))
+    img.name = "CV_CloudGuide"
+    img.pack()
+    tex = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage")
+    tex.image = img
+    tex.interpolation = "Cubic"
+    tex.extension = "EXTEND"
+    L.new(add2.outputs[0], tex.inputs["Vector"])
+    texa = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage")              # the cover over the planet: not warped
+    texa.image = img
+    texa.interpolation = "Cubic"
+    texa.extension = "EXTEND"
+    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], texa.inputs["Vector"])
+    # body detail: contrast by a fine noise, stronger where the guide is bright (lit cloud)
+    n3 = noise(160.0, 6.0, 0.7)
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], n3.inputs["Vector"])
+    gain = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    gain.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.25
+    gain.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.75
+    gain.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.86
+    gain.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 1.16
+    L.new(n3.outputs["Fac"], gain.inputs["Value"])
+    mul = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+    mul.operation = "SCALE"
+    L.new(tex.outputs["Color"], mul.inputs[0])
+    L.new(gain.outputs["Result"], mul.inputs["Scale"])
+    em = N.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
+    L.new(mul.outputs[0], em.inputs["Color"])
+    # fade out past the frame (guide UV outside 0..1 by more than a margin)
+    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
+    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], sep.inputs[0])
+    def edge(sock, lo, hi):
+        a = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+        a.inputs["From Min"].default_value = lo
+        a.inputs["From Max"].default_value = hi
+        L.new(sock, a.inputs["Value"])
+        return a
+    fx0, fx1 = edge(sep.outputs["X"], -0.40, -0.05), edge(sep.outputs["X"], 1.40, 1.05)
+    fy1 = edge(sep.outputs["Y"], 1.95, 1.3)
+    m1 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m1.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(fx0.outputs["Result"], m1.inputs[0]); L.new(fx1.outputs["Result"], m1.inputs[1])
+    m2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m2.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(m1.outputs[0], m2.inputs[0]); L.new(fy1.outputs["Result"], m2.inputs[1])
+    m3 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m3.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(m2.outputs[0], m3.inputs[0]); L.new(texa.outputs["Alpha"], m3.inputs[1])
+    tr = N.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
+    mix = N.new("ShaderNodeMixShader")
+    L.new(m3.outputs[0], mix.inputs["Fac"])
+    L.new(tr.outputs[0], mix.inputs[1])
+    L.new(em.outputs[0], mix.inputs[2])
+    L.new(mix.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    ob.data.materials.append(mat)

@@ -1,0 +1,50 @@ 
+"""The lights of the Crimson Valley scene: part "lighting".
+
+  tools/cv part lighting --with sky,clouds,planet,moons,terrain,rocks,water --render renders/lighting/a.png
+
+The picture's light is a painter's, not one sun: the hill the camera stands on (the left arch, its
+wall, the slabs and boulders) is lit warm from behind the camera's right shoulder, while the spires,
+ridges, arch and towers across the valley are lit from the left. So there are two low warm suns, each
+linked (light linking) to the rocks it lights:
+  CV_Sun_Near    from the right, low (azimuth 118, elevation 9)  -> near_hill, outcrop
+  CV_Sun_Valley  from the left (azimuth 240, elevation 24)      -> everything else
+The sky (CV_World) is the cool fill. Azimuth: where the light comes from, degrees clockwise seen from
+above, 0 = ahead of the camera, 90 = its right, 180 = behind it, 270 = its left."""
+import math
+
+import bpy
+
+import common
+
+NEAR = ("near_hill", "outcrop")
+SUNS = {"CV_Sun_Near": dict(az=118.0, el=9.0, strength=3.6, color=(1.0, 0.62, 0.36)),
+        "CV_Sun_Valley": dict(az=240.0, el=24.0, strength=4.2, color=(1.0, 0.66, 0.42))}
+
+
+def build(col):
+    for name, s in SUNS.items():
+        light = bpy.data.lights.new(name, "SUN")
+        light.energy = s["strength"]
+        light.color = s["color"]
+        light.angle = math.radians(3.0)
+        ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, light)
+        col.objects.link(ob)
+        common.aim_sun(ob, s["az"], s["el"])
+
+
+def finalize(scene):
+    near = bpy.data.collections.get("CV_Lit_Near") or bpy.data.collections.new("CV_Lit_Near")
+    valley = bpy.data.collections.get("CV_Lit_Valley") or bpy.data.collections.new("CV_Lit_Valley")
+    for ob in scene.objects:
+        if ob.type != "MESH" or ob.name.startswith(("CV_Clouds", "CV_Planet", "CV_Moon", "CV_Haze", "CV_Fog")):
+            continue
+        # plants and the terrain take both suns (they are spread over both sides)
+        both = ob.name.startswith(("CV_Veg", "CV_Terrain"))
+        is_near = ob.get("cv_group") in NEAR
+        for target in ([near, valley] if both else [near if is_near else valley]):
+            if ob.name not in target.objects:
+                target.objects.link(ob)
+    a, b = scene.objects.get("CV_Sun_Near"), scene.objects.get("CV_Sun_Valley")
+    if a and b:
+        a.light_linking.receiver_collection = near
+        b.light_linking.receiver_collection = valley

+"""Haze and mist: part "mist".
+
+  tools/cv part mist --with sky,clouds,planet,terrain,rocks,water,lighting --render renders/mist/a.png
+
+CV_Haze is the air: one low slab (50 m) of thin, even scattering over the whole valley, lit by the sky only, so things fade with
+distance into the sky's light as in the picture (the far spires almost gone, the near hill clear).
+CV_Fog_* are the mist banks: boxes of denser, noise-broken fog lying low between the ridges left of
+centre, over the far plain and at the feet of the waterfalls. They are placed from picture points
+(BANKS: a picture point on the ground at the bank's centre, its size in metres)."""
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+HAZE = 0.0015            # scattering per metre
+# picture u, v of the bank's middle, size x, y (along the view), z in metres, density
+BANKS = [(470, 470, 170, 120, 30, 0.07), (330, 420, 260, 200, 45, 0.04), (640, 520, 90, 60, 16, 0.07),
+         (820, 452, 500, 500, 24, 0.018), (1150, 470, 260, 160, 18, 0.03), (1420, 432, 130, 60, 22, 0.07),
+         (1560, 770, 34, 26, 14, 0.16), (1425, 705, 20, 16, 9, 0.14), (1300, 520, 30, 20, 9, 0.08)]
+
+
+def volume(name, density, color, noise=0.0, scale=0.03):
+    mat, N, L = common.new_material(name)
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    vol = N.new("ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled")
+    vol.inputs["Color"].default_value = common.rgba(color)
+    vol.inputs["Density"].default_value = density
+    vol.inputs["Anisotropy"].default_value = 0.3
+    if noise:
+        tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+        no = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise"); no.noise_type = "FBM"
+        no.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale; no.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 5.0
+        L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], no.inputs["Vector"])
+        # soft box: fade to the sides and upwards (Generated runs 0..1 across the box)
+        sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ"); L.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], sep.inputs[0])
+        def bell(sock):
+            a = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); a.operation = "PINGPONG"; a.inputs[1].default_value = 0.5
+            L.new(sock, a.inputs[0])
+            b = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); b.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"; b.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.4
+            L.new(a.outputs[0], b.inputs["Value"])
+            return b
+        bx, by = bell(sep.outputs["X"]), bell(sep.outputs["Y"])
+        up = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); up.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
+        up.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 1.0; up.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.15
+        L.new(sep.outputs["Z"], up.inputs["Value"])
+        cut = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+        cut.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.38; cut.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.68
+        L.new(no.outputs["Fac"], cut.inputs["Value"])
+        m = cut
+        for other in (bx, by, up):
+            mm = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mm.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+            L.new(m.outputs[0], mm.inputs[0]); L.new(other.outputs[0], mm.inputs[1])
+            m = mm
+        ds = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); ds.operation = "MULTIPLY"; ds.inputs[1].default_value = density
+        L.new(m.outputs[0], ds.inputs[0])
+        L.new(ds.outputs[0], vol.inputs["Density"])
+    L.new(vol.outputs["Volume"], out.inputs["Volume"])
+    return mat
+
+
+def box(col, name, centre, size, mat):
+    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, location=centre)
+    ob = bpy.context.active_object
+    ob.name = name
+    ob.scale = size
+    for c in list(ob.users_collection):
+        c.objects.unlink(ob)
+    col.objects.link(ob)
+    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+    ob.display_type = "WIRE"
+    ob.visible_shadow = False
+    return ob
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    box(col, "CV_Haze", (0.0, 4500.0, 24.0), (12000.0, 9400.0, 50.0), volume("CV_Haze", HAZE, "#e9d6d6"))
+    for k, (u, v, sx, sy, sz, dens) in enumerate(BANKS):
+        d = float(cm.ground_z(np.array(float(v)), 0.0))
+        p = cm.unproject(np.array(float(u)), np.array(float(v)), np.array(d))
+        box(col, f"CV_Fog_{k + 1}", (p[0], p[1], sz / 2 - 0.5), (sx, sy, sz), volume(f"CV_Fog_{k + 1}", dens, "#f2e6e4", noise=1.0, scale=4.0 / max(sx, sy) * 8))

+"""The two moons of the Crimson Valley scene: part "moons".
+
+  tools/cv part moons --with sky,clouds,planet --render renders/moons/a.png --no-sun
+
+CV_Moon_1 / CV_Moon_2: true spheres 50 km away, placed from the discs measured in the picture
+(analysis/planet.json). Like the planet they add their light to the sky behind (so the unlit side is
+sky-coloured haze, as in the picture) and are lit in the shader from a fixed direction (from the left
+and above); the surface is a grey-tan mottle with soft craters (noise and Voronoi)."""
+import json
+import math
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+DIST = 50000.0
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    with open(os.path.join(common.ANALYSIS, "planet.json")) as fh:
+        moons = json.load(fh)["moons"]
+    light = -cm.right * 0.62 + cm.up * 0.42 - cm.fwd * 0.66
+    light /= np.linalg.norm(light)
+    mat, N, L = common.new_material("CV_Moon")
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    geo = N.new("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    n1 = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise"); n1.noise_type = "FBM"
+    n1.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 2.2; n1.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 6.0
+    L.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], n1.inputs["Vector"])
+    vo = N.new("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi"); vo.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 7.0
+    L.new(tc.outputs["Generated"], vo.inputs["Vector"])
+    crater = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    crater.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.0; crater.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.35
+    crater.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.78; crater.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 1.0
+    L.new(vo.outputs["Distance"], crater.inputs["Value"])
+    ramp = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
+    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 0.3; ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = common.rgba("#6e6468")
+    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = 0.7; ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = common.rgba("#b9aba6")
+    L.new(n1.outputs["Fac"], ramp.inputs["Fac"])
+    dot = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath"); dot.operation = "DOT_PRODUCT"
+    dot.inputs[1].default_value = tuple(light)
+    L.new(geo.outputs["Normal"], dot.inputs[0])
+    day = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); day.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
+    day.inputs["From Min"].default_value = -0.35; day.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.6
+    L.new(dot.outputs["Value"], day.inputs["Value"])
+    m = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(day.outputs["Result"], m.inputs[0]); L.new(crater.outputs["Result"], m.inputs[1])
+    sc = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath"); sc.operation = "SCALE"
+    L.new(ramp.outputs["Color"], sc.inputs[0]); L.new(m.outputs[0], sc.inputs["Scale"])
+    em = N.new("ShaderNodeEmission"); em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.95
+    L.new(sc.outputs[0], em.inputs["Color"])
+    tr = N.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
+    vis = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    vis.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.35
+    vis.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 0.95
+    L.new(day.outputs["Result"], vis.inputs["Value"])
+    add = N.new("ShaderNodeMixShader")
+    L.new(vis.outputs["Result"], add.inputs["Fac"])
+    L.new(tr.outputs[0], add.inputs[1]); L.new(em.outputs[0], add.inputs[2])
+    L.new(add.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    for k, mo in enumerate(moons):
+        cu, cv = mo["sphere"]["centre_px"]
+        ang = math.radians(mo["sphere"]["angular_radius_deg"])
+        d = cm.rays(np.array(cu), np.array(cv)); d = d / np.linalg.norm(d)
+        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=DIST * math.sin(ang), location=tuple(cm.pos + d * DIST), segments=64, ring_count=32)
+        ob = bpy.context.active_object
+        ob.name = f"CV_Moon_{k + 1}"
+        for c in list(ob.users_collection):
+            c.objects.unlink(ob)

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,137 @@ 
+"""The gas giant of the Crimson Valley scene: part "planet".
+
+  tools/cv part planet --with sky,clouds,moons --render renders/planet/a.png --no-sun
+
+CV_Planet is a true sphere 60 km away, placed from the limb measured in the picture
+(analysis/planet.json, tools/measure_planet.py: the sphere fit lands on the picture's limb within
+about 1 px). Its material mixes its own light with the sky behind it by how lit it is, so where the
+planet is dark you see sky - as in the picture, where the disc fades into the blue on the left. The
+shader does its own lighting from a fixed direction (lit from the lower right, towards the sunset),
+with a bright atmospheric rim; the bands are a colour ramp over latitude about an axis tilted as the
+picture's bands are, stirred by noise (wavy edges, festoons, fine streaks)."""
+import json
+import math
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+DIST = 60000.0
+BANDS = [(0.00, "#2a2c44"), (0.20, "#3a3048"), (0.30, "#5a2638"), (0.36, "#9a5a58"), (0.42, "#4a1626"),
+         (0.50, "#b06858"), (0.56, "#5c1a24"), (0.62, "#c88a74"), (0.68, "#74222a"), (0.74, "#d8a080"),
+         (0.80, "#8a3028"), (0.86, "#e0b090"), (0.92, "#a04c36"), (1.00, "#f0c8a0")]
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    with open(os.path.join(common.ANALYSIS, "planet.json")) as fh:
+        P = json.load(fh)["planet"]
+    cu, cv = P["sphere"]["centre_px"]
+    ang = math.radians(P["sphere"]["angular_radius_deg"])
+    d = cm.rays(np.array(cu), np.array(cv))
+    d = d / np.linalg.norm(d)
+    centre = cm.pos + d * DIST
+    radius = DIST * math.sin(ang)
+    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=radius, location=tuple(centre), segments=192, ring_count=96)
+    ob = bpy.context.active_object
+    ob.name = "CV_Planet"
+    for c in list(ob.users_collection):
+        c.objects.unlink(ob)
+    col.objects.link(ob)
+    bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
+    for flag in ("visible_diffuse", "visible_shadow", "visible_transmission", "visible_volume_scatter"):
+        setattr(ob, flag, False)
+    # screen axes at the planet, in world space
+    right, up = cm.right, cm.up
+    axis = right * math.cos(math.radians(32)) + up * math.sin(math.radians(32)) - d * 0.45
+    axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
+    light = right * 0.86 - up * 0.42 - d * 0.28
+    light /= np.linalg.norm(light)
+
+    mat, N, L = common.new_material("CV_Planet")
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    geo = N.new("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    def dot(v):
+        n = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+        n.operation = "DOT_PRODUCT"
+        n.inputs[1].default_value = tuple(v)
+        L.new(geo.outputs["Normal"], n.inputs[0])
+        return n
+    lat = dot(axis)
+    # turbulence of the bands
+    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    def noise(scale, detail, rough, stretch):
+        mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
+        mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = stretch
+        L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
+        n = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
+        n.noise_type = "FBM"
+        n.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale / radius
+        n.inputs["Detail"].default_value = detail
+        n.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
+        L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], n.inputs["Vector"])
+        return n
+    n1 = noise(5.0, 5.0, 0.6, (1, 1, 1))
+    n2 = noise(22.0, 6.0, 0.65, (1, 1, 1))
+    def lin(sock, a, b):
+        m = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); m.operation = "MULTIPLY_ADD"
+        m.inputs[1].default_value = a; m.inputs[2].default_value = b
+        L.new(sock, m.inputs[0])
+        return m
+    t0 = lin(lat.outputs["Value"], 0.5, 0.5)                      # 0..1 from one pole to the other
+    w1 = lin(n1.outputs["Fac"], 0.05, -0.025)
+    w2 = lin(n2.outputs["Fac"], 0.03, -0.015)
+    s1 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); L.new(t0.outputs[0], s1.inputs[0]); L.new(w1.outputs[0], s1.inputs[1])
+    s2 = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); L.new(s1.outputs[0], s2.inputs[0]); L.new(w2.outputs[0], s2.inputs[1])
+    ramp = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
+    cr = ramp.color_ramp
+    while len(cr.elements) < len(BANDS):
+        cr.elements.new(0.5)
+    for el, (p, c) in zip(cr.elements, BANDS):
+        el.position = p
+        el.color = common.rgba(c)
+    L.new(s2.outputs[0], ramp.inputs["Fac"])
+    # fine streaks along the bands
+    n3 = noise(60.0, 4.0, 0.7, (1, 1, 1))
+    streak = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    streak.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.8
+    streak.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 1.2
+    L.new(n3.outputs["Fac"], streak.inputs["Value"])
+    # lighting: day side, soft terminator, bright rim
+    nl = dot(light)
+    day = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    day.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
+    day.inputs["From Min"].default_value = -0.30
+    day.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.80
+    L.new(nl.outputs["Value"], day.inputs["Value"])
+    lw = N.new("ShaderNodeLayerWeight")
+    lw.inputs["Blend"].default_value = 0.12
+    rim = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); rim.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(lw.outputs["Facing"], rim.inputs[0]); L.new(day.outputs["Result"], rim.inputs[1])
+    col1 = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath"); col1.operation = "SCALE"
+    L.new(ramp.outputs["Color"], col1.inputs[0]); L.new(streak.outputs["Result"], col1.inputs["Scale"])
+    shade = lin(day.outputs["Result"], 0.55, 0.45)
+    col2 = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath"); col2.operation = "SCALE"
+    L.new(col1.outputs[0], col2.inputs[0]); L.new(shade.outputs[0], col2.inputs["Scale"])
+    rimc = N.new("ShaderNodeMix"); rimc.data_type = "RGBA"; rimc.blend_type = "ADD"
+    rimc.inputs[7].default_value = common.rgba("#ffb080")
+    rs = lin(rim.outputs[0], 0.35, 0.0)
+    L.new(rs.outputs[0], rimc.inputs[0]); L.new(col2.outputs[0], rimc.inputs[6])
+    em = N.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
+    em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 1.15
+    L.new(rimc.outputs[2], em.inputs["Color"])
+    # where the planet is dark you see the sky behind it: mix by how lit it is
+    tr = N.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
+    vis = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    vis.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.0
+    vis.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.55
+    vis.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.12
+    vis.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 0.93
+    L.new(day.outputs["Result"], vis.inputs["Value"])
+    mixs = N.new("ShaderNodeMixShader")
+    L.new(vis.outputs["Result"], mixs.inputs["Fac"])
+    L.new(tr.outputs[0], mixs.inputs[1]); L.new(em.outputs[0], mixs.inputs[2])
+    L.new(mixs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
