@@ -1,0 +1,652 @@ 
+"""The plant prototype library of the Crimson Valley scene: part "plants".
+
+  tools/cv part plants
+
+Builds parts/plants.blend: the red vegetation of the picture as small real meshes (leaf blades and
+leaf cards as polygons, no image textures), each variant its own object at the origin, base at
+z = 0, +Z up, in metres. Nothing here is placed in the valley: the vegetation scatter instances
+these by the tens of thousands. So the part's own render is empty - the child collections are
+hidden (hide_render, hide_viewport) and only show through an instancer.
+
+What the picture shows, and the prototypes made from it (collection: variants):
+  CV_Plants_Fern    A B C D   the spiky plants at the bottom left (x 0-80, y 700-770): rosettes of
+                              radiating pointed blades, bright orange-red where lit - a broad-leaved
+                              one like the picture's (A), a stiff narrow-leaved burst (B), arching
+                              pinnate fronds (C), a small young rosette (D).
+  CV_Plants_Shrub   A B C D   the bushy scarlet clumps next to them (x 100-400, y 700-790): a dome of
+                              feathery sprigs (A), a clump of small-leaved tufts (B), branching fleshy
+                              coral-like stems (C), a small low clump (D).
+  CV_Plants_Carpet  A B C D   the red carpet of the left slope and the valley floor (x 0-450,
+                              y 480-640): low mats - a dark cushion carrying rosettes of small pointed
+                              leaves - round (A), flat and creeping (B), a taller grassy clump (C),
+                              a long three-lobed mat (D). Made to be massed and seen from 30-300 m.
+  CV_Plants_Bush    A B C     the rounded dark-red bushes and small trees by the river at the right
+                              (x 1540-1672, y 760-860) and along the bottom edge: a trunk, a few
+                              branches and a crown of leafy puffs (each a dark core under leaf cards).
+  CV_Plants_Moss    A B C     the yellow-green tufts on rock tops (x 540-650, y 595-640): a cushion
+                              with short blades (A), a grass tuft (B), a flat creeping patch (C).
+
+Sizes come from the picture: every category has a RULER - a region of the picture where its plants
+are, and the metres one picture pixel spanned there when the plants were authored. At build time the
+depth map (analysis/depth.npy) is read in that region again and the plants are scaled by the ratio,
+so a recalibration of the scene resizes the plants with everything else.
+
+Each mesh carries one colour attribute, "cv_leaf" (per vertex): R = height in the plant (0 at the
+base and in the heart, 1 at the leaf tips), G = a random number per leaf, B = 1 on woody stems.
+Two materials use it, CV_Foliage_Red and CV_Foliage_Moss (foliage_material): the leaf colour is picked
+from a ramp (crimson > scarlet > orange) by a random number per instance (Object Info > Random), the
+random number per leaf and a slow noise over the world (drifts of one tint); it is darker toward the
+base, a few leaves are pale gold, and part of the light goes through the leaf (a Translucent BSDF
+mixed in), so back-lit leaves glow. No image textures.
+
+For the scatter
+  import part_plants
+  part_plants.build(col)            # in the scatter's own part: the library under its collection
+  part_plants.prototypes()          # {"fern": ["CV_Plants_Fern_A", ...], "shrub": ..., "carpet": ...,
+                                    #  "bush": ..., "moss": ...}
+  part_plants.COLLECTIONS           # {"fern": "CV_Plants_Fern", ...}
+(or append the collections from parts/plants.blend). In geometry nodes: Collection Info (Separate
+Children and Reset Children on) > Instance on Points (Pick Instance on, Instance Index = a random
+integer, Rotation = a random turn about Z, Scale 0.7-1.3). Hidden collections still instance. Keep
+them instances (do not realize): Object Info > Random then differs per instance, which is where the
+plant-to-plant colour variation comes from. Every object has custom properties cv_width, cv_height
+(metres) and cv_tris. Guide densities for a closed cover: carpets 5-7 per square metre, with shrubs
+0.3-0.6 and, close to the camera only, ferns 0.05-0.1; bushes singly or in groups of 2-5 at the
+water; moss 4-8 per square metre in patches on rock tops. The meshes reach a little under z = 0
+(a skirt of a few centimetres), so they do not float on sloping ground.
+"""
+import math
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+SEED = 20261115
+GOLDEN = math.radians(137.508)
+ATTR = "cv_leaf"
+RED, MOSS = "CV_Foliage_Red", "CV_Foliage_Moss"
+
+COLLECTIONS = {"fern": "CV_Plants_Fern", "shrub": "CV_Plants_Shrub", "carpet": "CV_Plants_Carpet",
+               "bush": "CV_Plants_Bush", "moss": "CV_Plants_Moss"}
+VARIANTS = {"fern": "ABCD", "shrub": "ABCD", "carpet": "ABCD", "bush": "ABC", "moss": "ABC"}
+
+# Where each kind of plant is in the picture (x0, y0, x1, y1) and the metres per picture pixel there
+# when the sizes below were chosen (depth / focal length). See scale_factors().
+RULERS = {"fern": ((0, 700, 80, 770), 0.0176), "shrub": ((180, 725, 400, 785), 0.0203),
+          "carpet": ((0, 530, 250, 600), 0.0293), "bush": ((1540, 760, 1672, 860), 0.0484),
+          "moss": ((540, 595, 650, 640), 0.0281)}
+
+# Leaf colours (albedo, as sRGB): the ramp runs from the darkest crimson plants to the orange ones.
+RED_RAMP = ((0.00, "#7a0c1e"), (0.30, "#b01018"), (0.55, "#cf2414"), (0.80, "#de4a16"), (1.00, "#e87a22"))
+RED_ACCENT = "#f0b45a"        # the few pale gold leaves
+RED_BARK = "#2e1a16"
+MOSS_RAMP = ((0.00, "#5c5a1c"), (0.35, "#8f8a2a"), (0.65, "#b9a83a"), (1.00, "#d8bc4c"))
+MOSS_ACCENT = "#ecd98a"
+MOSS_BARK = "#3a3018"
+
+
+def prototypes():
+    """{category: [object names]} of the library (the names build() gives; no Blender data needed)."""
+    return {cat: [f"{COLLECTIONS[cat]}_{v}" for v in VARIANTS[cat]] for cat in COLLECTIONS}
+
+
+def scale_factors():
+    """{category: factor}: how much bigger a picture pixel is at each category's ruler now than when
+    the plants were authored (1.0 when the analysis is missing)."""
+    out = {cat: 1.0 for cat in RULERS}
+    try:
+        depth = np.load(os.path.join(common.ANALYSIS, "depth.npy"), mmap_mode="r")
+        f = common.cam_model().f
+    except Exception as ex:
+        print("plants: no depth map, sizes as authored:", ex)
+        return out
+    for cat, ((x0, y0, x1, y1), mpp) in RULERS.items():
+        d = np.asarray(depth[y0:y1, x0:x1], dtype=np.float64)
+        d = d[d > 0]
+        if d.size:
+            out[cat] = float(np.median(d)) / f / mpp
+    return out
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ geometry
+class Mesh:
+    """Triangles with the cv_leaf attribute, gathered piece by piece."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.v, self.f, self.a = [], [], []
+        self.n = 0
+
+    def add(self, verts, tris, h, rnd=0.5, wood=0.0):
+        verts = np.asarray(verts, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 3)
+        k = len(verts)
+        a = np.empty((k, 4))
+        a[:, 0] = np.clip(h, 0.0, 1.0)
+        a[:, 1] = rnd
+        a[:, 2] = wood
+        a[:, 3] = 1.0
+        self.v.append(verts)
+        self.f.append(np.asarray(tris, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 3) + self.n)
+        self.a.append(a)
+        self.n += k
+
+    @property
+    def tris(self):
+        return sum(len(f) for f in self.f)
+
+    def object(self, name, col, mat, scale=1.0, floor=-0.04):
+        v = np.concatenate(self.v) * scale
+        v[:, 2] = np.maximum(v[:, 2], floor * scale)
+        ob = common.mesh_object(name, v, np.concatenate(self.f), col, smooth=True,
+                                attributes={ATTR: np.concatenate(self.a)})
+        ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+        ext = v.max(0) - v.min(0)
+        ob["cv_width"] = float(max(ext[0], ext[1]))
+        ob["cv_height"] = float(v[:, 2].max())
+        ob["cv_tris"] = int(self.tris)
+        return ob
+
+
+def _unit(v):
+    v = np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float64)
+    return v / max(float(np.linalg.norm(v)), 1e-9)
+
+
+def _perp(axis):
+    """Two unit vectors square to `axis` (and to each other)."""
+    axis = _unit(axis)
+    a = _unit(np.cross(axis, (0.0, 0.0, 1.0) if abs(axis[2]) < 0.9 else (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)))
+    return a, np.cross(axis, a)
+
+
+def _profile(t, shape):
+    """Half-width of a leaf along its length t = 0..1, as a fraction of the full width."""
+    t = np.clip(t, 0.0, 1.0)
+    if shape == "strap":        # broad for most of its length, then a point (bromeliad, agave)
+        return (1.0 - t ** 2.5) ** 0.8 * (0.7 + 0.3 * np.minimum(t / 0.25, 1.0))
+    if shape == "lance":        # widest a third of the way along
+        return np.maximum(np.sin(np.pi * t ** 0.7) ** 0.9, 0.3 * (1.0 - t))
+    return (1.0 - t) ** 0.6     # needle
+
+
+def _spine(base, yaw, elev, droop, length, n, power=1.4, bend=0.0):
+    """The centre line of a leaf or twig: n + 1 points from `base`, leaving at `elev` radians above
+    the horizontal towards `yaw` and drooping by `droop` radians over its length (bend: a sideways
+    curl). Returns points, and per point the forward / side / up vectors and t = 0..1."""
+    t = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n + 1)
+    a = elev - droop * t ** power
+    y = yaw + bend * t
+    fwd = np.stack([np.cos(a) * np.cos(y), np.cos(a) * np.sin(y), np.sin(a)], 1)
+    side = np.stack([-np.sin(y), np.cos(y), np.zeros_like(y)], 1)
+    up = np.cross(fwd, side)
+    step = 0.5 * (fwd[:-1] + fwd[1:]) * (length / n)
+    pts = np.asarray(base, dtype=np.float64) + np.concatenate([np.zeros((1, 3)), np.cumsum(step, 0)])
+    return pts, fwd, side, up, t
+
+
+def _at(sp, tt):
+    """Point and frame of a spine at parameter tt (linear between its points)."""
+    pts, fwd, side, up, t = sp
+    x = min(max(tt, 0.0), 1.0) * (len(t) - 1)
+    i = min(int(x), len(t) - 2)
+    w = x - i
+    return tuple(q[i] * (1.0 - w) + q[i + 1] * w for q in (pts, fwd, side, up))
+
+
+def blade(m, base, yaw, elev, droop, length, width, n=5, fold=0.5, roll=0.0, shape="strap",
+          h=(0.1, 1.0), rnd=0.5, power=1.4, bend=0.0):
+    """A long leaf folded along its midrib (a V in section): 4 triangles per segment, 2 at the tip."""
+    sp = _spine(base, yaw, elev, droop, length, n, power, bend)
+    p, _, side, up, t = sp
+    if roll:
+        c, s = math.cos(roll), math.sin(roll)
+        side, up = side * c + up * s, up * c - side * s
+    w = (0.5 * width * _profile(t, shape))[:, None]
+    lift = up * w * math.sin(fold)
+    left = p + side * w * math.cos(fold) + lift
+    right = p - side * w * math.cos(fold) + lift
+    verts = np.concatenate([left[:-1], p[:-1], right[:-1], p[-1:]])
+    tris = []
+    for i in range(n - 1):
+        a, b, c = i, n + i, 2 * n + i
+        tris += [(a, b, b + 1), (a, b + 1, a + 1), (b, c, c + 1), (b, c + 1, b + 1)]
+    tris += [(n - 1, 2 * n - 1, 3 * n), (2 * n - 1, 3 * n - 1, 3 * n)]
+    hh = h[0] + (h[1] - h[0]) * t ** 0.8
+    m.add(verts, tris, np.concatenate([hh[:-1], hh[:-1], hh[:-1], hh[-1:]]), rnd)
+    return sp
+
+
+def ribbon(m, sp, width, h=(0.1, 1.0), rnd=0.5, wood=0.0, t0=0.0):
+    """A flat tapering strip along a spine (a stalk, a grass blade): 2 triangles per segment, 1 at the tip."""
+    p, _, side, _, t = sp
+    n = len(t) - 1
+    w = (0.5 * width * (1.0 - 0.8 * t))[:, None]
+    verts = np.concatenate([p[:-1] + side[:-1] * w[:-1], p[:-1] - side[:-1] * w[:-1], p[-1:]])
+    tris = []
+    for i in range(n - 1):
+        tris += [(i, n + i, n + i + 1), (i, n + i + 1, i + 1)]
+    tris += [(n - 1, 2 * n - 1, 2 * n)]
+    hh = h[0] + (h[1] - h[0]) * (t0 + (1.0 - t0) * t)
+    m.add(verts, tris, np.concatenate([hh[:-1], hh[:-1], hh[-1:]]), rnd, wood)
+
+
+def frond(m, rng, base, yaw, elev, droop, length, width, pairs=10, n=5, sweep=0.45, vee=0.25,
+          stalk=0.12, gap=0.25, h=(0.15, 1.0), rnd=0.5, rachis=0.02, power=1.3, bend=0.0):
+    """A pinnate leaf (fern frond, heather sprig): a thin rachis with a pointed leaflet - one triangle -
+    on each side of it per pair, longest a third of the way along. Returns its spine."""
+    sp = _spine(base, yaw, elev, droop, length, n, power, bend)
+    if rachis > 0.0:
+        ribbon(m, sp, rachis, h, rnd)
+    edges = np.linspace(stalk, 1.0, pairs + 1)
+    for j in range(pairs):
+        ta, tb = edges[j], edges[j + 1]
+        tm = 0.5 * (ta + tb)
+        u = (tm - stalk) / (1.0 - stalk)
+        ll = 0.5 * width * float(np.sin(np.pi * u ** 0.6) ** 0.8 + 0.12) * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.12)
+        pa = _at(sp, ta)[0]
+        pb = _at(sp, ta + (tb - ta) * (1.0 - gap))[0]
+        pm, fwd, side, up = _at(sp, tm)
+        hm = h[0] + (h[1] - h[0]) * tm
+        for sgn in (1.0, -1.0):
+            apex = pm + side * (sgn * ll * math.cos(vee)) + up * (ll * math.sin(vee) + rng.normal(0, 0.1) * ll) \
+                + fwd * (ll * sweep)
+            tri = (pa, pb, apex) if sgn > 0 else (pb, pa, apex)
+            m.add(tri, [(0, 1, 2)], (hm - 0.1, hm - 0.1, min(1.0, hm + 0.25)), (rnd + 0.37 * j * sgn) % 1.0 if rng.random() < 0.3 else rnd)
+    return sp
+
+
+def leaf(m, base, d, nrm, length, width, h=(0.5, 1.0), rnd=0.5):
+    """One small pointed leaf: a triangle from a `width` wide foot at `base` to its tip along d,
+    lying in the plane whose normal is (about) nrm."""
+    d = _unit(d)
+    b = _unit(np.cross(d, nrm)) * (0.5 * width)
+    base = np.asarray(base, dtype=np.float64)
+    m.add((base - b, base + b, base + d * length), [(0, 1, 2)], (h[0], h[0], h[1]), rnd)
+
+
+def whorl(m, rng, centre, axis, count, length, width, spread=1.0, h=(0.4, 1.0), rnd=None):
+    """A tuft: `count` leaves around an axis, opened by `spread` radians from it."""
+    axis = _unit(axis)
+    a, b = _perp(axis)
+    centre = np.asarray(centre, dtype=np.float64)
+    turn = rng.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
+    for j in range(count):
+        ang = turn + 2 * math.pi * j / count + rng.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)
+        radial = a * math.cos(ang) + b * math.sin(ang)
+        tilt = max(0.1, spread + rng.normal(0, 0.22))
+        d = axis * math.cos(tilt) + radial * math.sin(tilt)
+        nrm = axis * math.sin(tilt) - radial * math.cos(tilt)
+        leaf(m, centre, d, nrm, length * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.15), width * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.15), h,
+             rng.random() if rnd is None else rnd)
+
+
+def dome(m, rng, centre, rx, ry, height, n=6, rings=2, jitter=0.15, h=(0.05, 0.3), rnd=0.5, sink=0.04):
+    """A low-poly mound (the dark body under the leaves of a mat): `rings` bands of n segments and a cap."""
+    centre = np.asarray(centre, dtype=np.float64)
+    verts, hs = [], []
+    for i in range(rings):
+        phi = 0.5 * math.pi * i / rings
+        for j in range(n):
+            ang = 2 * math.pi * (j + 0.5 * i) / n
+            k = math.cos(phi) * (1.0 + rng.uniform(-jitter, jitter))
+            z = height * math.sin(phi) * (1.0 + rng.uniform(-jitter, jitter)) - (sink if i == 0 else 0.0)
+            verts.append(centre + (rx * k * math.cos(ang), ry * k * math.sin(ang), z))
+            hs.append(h[0] + (h[1] - h[0]) * i / rings)
+    verts.append(centre + (0.0, 0.0, height))
+    hs.append(h[1])
+    tris = []
+    for i in range(rings - 1):
+        for j in range(n):
+            a, a1 = i * n + j, i * n + (j + 1) % n
+            b, b1 = a + n, a1 + n
+            tris += [(a, a1, b), (a1, b1, b)]
+    top = rings * n
+    for j in range(n):
+        tris.append(((rings - 1) * n + j, (rings - 1) * n + (j + 1) % n, top))
+    m.add(verts, tris, hs, rnd)
+
+
+_ICO_T = (1.0 + 5.0 ** 0.5) / 2.0
+_ICO_V = np.array([(-1, _ICO_T, 0), (1, _ICO_T, 0), (-1, -_ICO_T, 0), (1, -_ICO_T, 0), (0, -1, _ICO_T), (0, 1, _ICO_T),
+                   (0, -1, -_ICO_T), (0, 1, -_ICO_T), (_ICO_T, 0, -1), (_ICO_T, 0, 1), (-_ICO_T, 0, -1), (-_ICO_T, 0, 1)])
+_ICO_V = _ICO_V / np.linalg.norm(_ICO_V[0])
+_ICO_F = np.array([(0, 11, 5), (0, 5, 1), (0, 1, 7), (0, 7, 10), (0, 10, 11), (1, 5, 9), (5, 11, 4), (11, 10, 2),
+                   (10, 7, 6), (7, 1, 8), (3, 9, 4), (3, 4, 2), (3, 2, 6), (3, 6, 8), (3, 8, 9), (4, 9, 5),
+                   (2, 4, 11), (6, 2, 10), (8, 6, 7), (9, 8, 1)])
+
+
+def blob(m, rng, centre, radius, jitter=0.2, h=0.15, rnd=0.5):
+    """A rough ball of 20 triangles: the dark heart of a puff of leaves."""
+    v = _ICO_V * (radius * (1.0 + rng.uniform(-jitter, jitter, (12, 1))))
+    hs = np.clip(h * (0.7 + 0.6 * (v[:, 2] / radius * 0.5 + 0.5)), 0, 1)
+    m.add(np.asarray(centre, dtype=np.float64) + v, _ICO_F, hs, rnd)
+
+
+def tube(m, pts, radii, sides=3, h=0.08, rnd=0.5, wood=1.0, cap=True):
+    """A stem: a prism of `sides` sides through the points, radius per point; cap: closed by a point."""
+    pts = np.asarray(pts, dtype=np.float64)
+    k = len(pts)
+    hv = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(h, dtype=np.float64), (k,)) if np.ndim(h) else np.full(k, float(h))
+    verts, hs = [], []
+    for i in range(k):
+        d = _unit(pts[min(i + 1, k - 1)] - pts[max(i - 1, 0)])
+        a, b = _perp(d)
+        for j in range(sides):
+            ang = 2 * math.pi * j / sides + 0.4 * i
+            verts.append(pts[i] + (a * math.cos(ang) + b * math.sin(ang)) * radii[i])
+            hs.append(hv[i])
+    tris = []
+    for i in range(k - 1):
+        for j in range(sides):
+            a, a1 = i * sides + j, i * sides + (j + 1) % sides
+            tris += [(a, a1, a + sides), (a1, a1 + sides, a + sides)]
+    if cap:
+        d = _unit(pts[-1] - pts[-2])
+        verts.append(pts[-1] + d * radii[-1] * 1.5)
+        hs.append(hv[-1])
+        for j in range(sides):
+            tris.append(((k - 1) * sides + j, (k - 1) * sides + (j + 1) % sides, k * sides))
+    m.add(verts, tris, hs, rnd, wood)
+
+
+def _fib(n, zmin=0.0, zmax=1.0):
+    """n directions spread evenly over the part of the unit sphere with zmin <= z <= zmax."""
+    i = np.arange(n) + 0.5
+    z = zmax - (zmax - zmin) * i / n
+    r = np.sqrt(np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - z * z))
+    return np.stack([r * np.cos(i * GOLDEN), r * np.sin(i * GOLDEN), z], 1)
+
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- plants
+def rosette(m, rng, leaves, length, width, n=5, fold=0.5, elev=(1.3, 0.3), droop=(0.25, 0.85),
+            shape="strap", stem=0.0):
+    """A spiky plant: blades spiralling out of one heart, the young ones upright in the middle."""
+    for i in range(leaves):
+        u = i / max(leaves - 1, 1)
+        yaw = i * GOLDEN + rng.normal(0, 0.15)
+        e = elev[0] + (elev[1] - elev[0]) * u ** 0.8 + rng.normal(0, 0.07)
+        d = droop[0] + (droop[1] - droop[0]) * u + rng.normal(0, 0.1)
+        ln = length * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(math.pi * min(1.0, 0.15 + 1.1 * u))) * rng.uniform(0.88, 1.1)
+        r = 0.04 * width / 0.1 * u
+        base = (r * math.cos(yaw), r * math.sin(yaw), stem - 0.03 * u)
+        blade(m, base, yaw, e, d, ln, width * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.1) * (0.75 + 0.25 * u), n, fold,
+              roll=rng.normal(0, 0.18), shape=shape, h=(0.04 + 0.1 * u, 1.0), rnd=rng.random(),
+              bend=rng.normal(0, 0.12))
+
+
+def fern(v, rng):
+    m = Mesh()

+    elif v == "B":    # a stiff burst of narrow blades on a short stock
+        tube(m, [(0, 0, -0.04), (0.01, 0.0, 0.1), (0.0, 0.01, 0.2)], [0.06, 0.05, 0.04], sides=4, h=0.05, cap=False)
+        rosette(m, rng, 34, 0.56, 0.05, n=4, fold=0.35, elev=(1.45, -0.1), droop=(0.05, 0.25), shape="needle", stem=0.2)
+    elif v == "C":    # arching pinnate fronds
+        for i in range(11):
+            u = i / 10.0
+            yaw = i * GOLDEN + rng.normal(0, 0.2)
+            frond(m, rng, (0.02 * math.cos(yaw), 0.02 * math.sin(yaw), -0.02), yaw, 1.3 - 0.75 * u + rng.normal(0, 0.06),
+                  0.9 + 0.5 * u + rng.normal(0, 0.1), 0.78 * (0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(math.pi * (0.2 + 0.8 * u))) * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.1),
+                  0.26, pairs=11, n=5, h=(0.08, 1.0), rnd=rng.random(), rachis=0.025, bend=rng.normal(0, 0.15))
+    else:             # a small young rosette
+        rosette(m, rng, 14, 0.43, 0.085, n=4, fold=0.6, elev=(1.25, 0.45), droop=(0.2, 0.7))
+    return m
+
+
+def shrub(v, rng):
+    m = Mesh()
+    if v in "AD":     # a dome of feathery sprigs, some forked
+        count, ln, wd, fork = (26, 0.46, 0.085, 0.4) if v == "A" else (16, 0.27, 0.07, 0.25)
+        for i in range(count):
+            u = (i + 0.5) / count
+            yaw = i * GOLDEN + rng.normal(0, 0.2)
+            e = 1.4 - 1.15 * u ** 0.75 + rng.normal(0, 0.08)
+            base = (0.05 * u * math.cos(yaw), 0.05 * u * math.sin(yaw), -0.02)
+            sp = frond(m, rng, base, yaw, e, rng.uniform(0.1, 0.5), ln * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.1), wd, pairs=6, n=3,
+                       sweep=0.7, vee=0.35, stalk=0.2, h=(0.1, 1.0), rnd=rng.random(), rachis=0.022, bend=rng.normal(0, 0.25))
+            if rng.random() < fork:
+                p, fwd, _, _ = _at(sp, rng.uniform(0.35, 0.55))
+                yaw2 = math.atan2(fwd[1], fwd[0]) + rng.choice((-1, 1)) * rng.uniform(0.5, 0.9)
+                frond(m, rng, p, yaw2, math.asin(max(-1, min(1, fwd[2]))) + rng.uniform(0.0, 0.3), rng.uniform(0.0, 0.4),
+                      ln * rng.uniform(0.4, 0.6), wd * 0.9, pairs=5, n=2, sweep=0.7, vee=0.35, stalk=0.15,
+                      h=(0.45, 1.0), rnd=rng.random(), rachis=0.0)
+    elif v == "B":    # a clump of small-leaved tufts over a dark body
+        rx, hz = 0.3, 0.42
+        dome(m, rng, (0, 0, 0), rx * 0.8, rx * 0.8, hz * 0.72, n=6, rings=2, h=(0.04, 0.22))
+        for d in _fib(40, zmin=0.05):
+            d = _unit(d + rng.normal(0, 0.12, 3))
+            c = d * (rx, rx, hz) * rng.uniform(0.82, 1.05)
+            whorl(m, rng, c, d + (0, 0, 0.35), 12, 0.085, 0.04, spread=1.0, h=(0.25 + 0.3 * d[2], 0.6 + 0.4 * d[2]))
+    else:             # C: fleshy branching stems, like red coral
+        def stem(base, yaw, elev, length, r, depth):
+            sp = _spine(base, yaw, elev, rng.uniform(-0.35, 0.1), length, 2, bend=rng.normal(0, 0.3))
+            z0 = base[2] / 0.7
+            tube(m, sp[0], [r, r * 0.85, r * 0.7], sides=3, h=np.clip([z0, z0 + 0.2, z0 + 0.4], 0.05, 1.0) if depth else (0.55, 0.8, 1.0),
+                 rnd=rng.random(), wood=0.0, cap=depth == 0)
+            if depth:
+                for _ in range(2 if depth == 1 or rng.random() < 0.6 else 3):
+                    p, fwd, _, _ = _at(sp, rng.uniform(0.55, 1.0))
+                    stem(p, yaw + rng.normal(0, 0.9), min(1.5, elev + rng.uniform(0.0, 0.5)), length * rng.uniform(0.55, 0.8),
+                         r * 0.72, depth - 1)
+        for i in range(6):
+            yaw = i * GOLDEN + rng.normal(0, 0.2)
+            stem(np.array([0.04 * math.cos(yaw), 0.04 * math.sin(yaw), -0.03]), yaw, rng.uniform(0.75, 1.35),
+                 rng.uniform(0.26, 0.36), 0.026, 2)
+    return m
+
+
+def mat(m, rng, rx, ry, height, tufts, per, leaf_len, leaf_w, spread=0.9, lobes=((0.0, 0.0, 1.0),), sides=6):
+    """A low mat: per lobe (x, y, size) a dark mound, and tufts of small pointed leaves all over it."""
+    for (lx, ly, ls) in lobes:
+        dome(m, rng, (lx * rx, ly * ry, 0.0), rx * ls * 0.85, ry * ls * 0.85, height * 0.62 * ls, n=sides, rings=2,
+             h=(0.03, 0.25), jitter=0.2)
+    done = 0
+    while done < tufts:
+        lx, ly, ls = lobes[done % len(lobes)]
+        ang, rad = rng.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi), math.sqrt(rng.uniform(0.0, 1.0))
+        x, y = rad * math.cos(ang), rad * math.sin(ang)
+        z = height * 0.62 * ls * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1.0 - rad * rad)) * 0.9
+        c = np.array([(lx + x * ls * 0.9) * rx, (ly + y * ls * 0.9) * ry, z])
+        axis = _unit((x * 0.7, y * 0.7, 1.0))
+        whorl(m, rng, c, axis, per, leaf_len, leaf_w, spread=spread, h=(0.3 + 0.2 * (1 - rad), 1.0))
+        done += 1
+
+
+def carpet(v, rng):
+    m = Mesh()
+    if v == "A":      # a round cushion of leaf rosettes
+        mat(m, rng, 0.36, 0.36, 0.2, 22, 6, 0.12, 0.05, spread=0.9)
+    elif v == "B":    # flat and creeping, bigger leaves lying down
+        mat(m, rng, 0.5, 0.42, 0.11, 22, 6, 0.13, 0.065, spread=1.25)
+    elif v == "C":    # a taller grassy clump
+        dome(m, rng, (0, 0, 0), 0.17, 0.17, 0.1, n=5, rings=2, h=(0.03, 0.2))
+        for i in range(45):
+            u = (i + 0.5) / 45
+            yaw = i * GOLDEN + rng.normal(0, 0.2)
+            sp = _spine((0.1 * u * math.cos(yaw), 0.1 * u * math.sin(yaw), 0.0), yaw, 1.45 - 1.0 * u + rng.normal(0, 0.08),
+                        rng.uniform(0.3, 1.0), 0.27 * rng.uniform(0.7, 1.1), 2)
+            ribbon(m, sp, 0.035, h=(0.12, 1.0), rnd=rng.random())
+    else:             # D: a long mat of three lobes
+        mat(m, rng, 0.5, 0.3, 0.18, 21, 6, 0.115, 0.05, spread=0.95,
+            lobes=((-0.55, 0.05, 0.62), (0.05, -0.1, 0.7), (0.6, 0.12, 0.55)), sides=5)
+    return m
+
+
+def bush(v, rng):
+    m = Mesh()
+    width, height, trunk, puffs, per, stems = {"A": (2.3, 2.0, 0.45, 13, 80, 3), "B": (3.0, 2.9, 1.15, 13, 80, 1),
+                                               "C": (1.7, 1.45, 0.25, 12, 76, 4)}[v]
+    rad = np.array([width / 2, width / 2, (height - trunk) / 2])
+    cc = np.array([0.0, 0.0, trunk + rad[2]])
+    dirs = _fib(puffs, zmin=-0.45)
+    pr = 0.42 * float(rad.mean()) * (13.0 / puffs) ** 0.33
+    centres = []
+    for d in dirs:
+        d = _unit(d + rng.normal(0, 0.15, 3))
+        r = pr * rng.uniform(0.8, 1.15)
+        c = cc + d * (rad - r * 0.75) * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.05)
+        centres.append(c)
+        blob(m, rng, c, r * 0.78, h=0.12)
+        ld = _fib(per, zmin=-0.75)
+        a, b = _perp(_unit(rng.normal(0, 1, 3)))
+        for q in ld:
+            # the leaves of a puff: on its outer side, pointing out and a little down, like shingles
+            o = _unit(q + d * 0.9 + rng.normal(0, 0.1, 3))
+            pos = c + o * r * rng.uniform(0.82, 1.08)
+            e = (pos - cc) / rad
+            out = float(np.clip((np.linalg.norm(e) - 0.55) / 0.45, 0.0, 1.0))
+            hh = (0.22 + 0.78 * out) * (0.62 + 0.38 * float(np.clip(e[2] * 0.5 + 0.5, 0, 1)))
+            t = _unit(np.cross(o, rng.normal(0, 1, 3)))
+            dr = _unit(t + o * rng.uniform(0.2, 0.9) - (0, 0, rng.uniform(0.0, 0.5)))
+            leaf(m, pos, dr, o, 0.17 * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.2), 0.1 * rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2), h=(hh * 0.8, hh), rnd=rng.random())
+    # the wood: stems from the ground into the crown, forking towards the puffs
+    order = np.argsort([c[2] for c in centres])
+    for s in range(stems):
+        yaw = s * GOLDEN + rng.uniform(0, 1)
+        off = (0.0 if stems == 1 else 0.12 * width / 2) * np.array([math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw), 0.0])
+        top = cc * (0, 0, 1) + off * 2.0 - (0, 0, rad[2] * 0.55)
+        r0 = (0.085 if stems == 1 else 0.05) * width / 2.3
+        mid = (off + top) / 2 + rng.normal(0, 0.04, 3) * (1, 1, 0)
+        tube(m, [off - (0, 0, 0.05), mid, top], [r0, r0 * 0.8, r0 * 0.62], sides=4 if stems == 1 else 3, h=0.3, cap=False)
+        for c in [centres[i] for i in order[s::stems][:4]]:
+            tube(m, [top, (top + c) / 2 + rng.normal(0, 0.05, 3), c], [r0 * 0.5, r0 * 0.38, r0 * 0.22], sides=3, h=0.25, cap=False)
+    return m
+
+
+def moss(v, rng):

+    if v == "A":      # a cushion with short blades
+        dome(m, rng, (0, 0, 0), 0.17, 0.15, 0.1, n=5, rings=2, h=(0.1, 0.5))

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ materials
+def foliage_material(name, ramp, accent, bark, translucency=0.38, hue_spread=(0.5, 0.25, 0.9, 0.12)):
+    """The leaf material (see the module's docstring). ramp: ((position, "#rrggbb"), ...) from the
+    darkest plants to the brightest; hue_spread: how far the random number per instance, the one per
+    leaf and the world noise move a leaf along the ramp, and the offset."""
+    if name in bpy.data.materials:
+        return bpy.data.materials[name]
+    mat_, nodes, links = common.new_material(name)
+
+    def node(kind, **props):
+        n = nodes.new(kind)
+        for k, v in props.items():
+            setattr(n, k, v)
+        return n
+
+    def math_(op, a, b=None, clamp=False):
+        n = node("ShaderNodeMath", operation=op, use_clamp=clamp)
+        for sock, v in zip(n.inputs, (a, b)):
+            if v is None:
+                continue
+            if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+                sock.default_value = v
+            else:
+                links.new(v, sock)
+        return n.outputs[0]
+
+    def mix(kind, fac, a, b, blend="MIX"):
+        n = node("ShaderNodeMix", data_type=kind, blend_type=blend) if kind == "RGBA" else node("ShaderNodeMix", data_type=kind)
+        ia, ib = (6, 7) if kind == "RGBA" else (2, 3)
+        for sock, v in ((n.inputs[0], fac), (n.inputs[ia], a), (n.inputs[ib], b)):
+            if isinstance(v, (int, float, tuple)):
+                sock.default_value = v
+            else:
+                links.new(v, sock)
+        return n.outputs[2 if kind == "RGBA" else 0]
+
+    attr = node("ShaderNodeAttribute", attribute_type="GEOMETRY", attribute_name=ATTR)
+    sep = node("ShaderNodeSeparateColor")
+    links.new(attr.outputs["Color"], sep.inputs[0])
+    h, per_leaf, wood = sep.outputs[0], sep.outputs[1], sep.outputs[2]
+    # three independent random numbers per instance
+    info = node("ShaderNodeObjectInfo")
+    white = node("ShaderNodeTexWhiteNoise", noise_dimensions="1D")
+    links.new(info.outputs["Random"], white.inputs["W"])
+    isep = node("ShaderNodeSeparateColor")
+    links.new(white.outputs["Color"], isep.inputs[0])
+    i1, i2 = isep.outputs[0], isep.outputs[1]
+    # drifts of one tint over the ground
+    geo = node("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    noise = node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", noise_dimensions="3D", noise_type="FBM")
+    noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 0.11
+    noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 2.0
+    noise.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.55
+    links.new(geo.outputs["Position"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
+    patch = math_("SUBTRACT", noise.outputs["Fac"], 0.5)
+    k = math_("ADD", math_("MULTIPLY", i1, hue_spread[0]), math_("MULTIPLY", per_leaf, hue_spread[1]))
+    k = math_("ADD", k, math_("MULTIPLY", patch, hue_spread[2]))
+    k = math_("ADD", k, hue_spread[3], clamp=True)
+    cr = node("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
+    els = cr.color_ramp.elements
+    for i, (pos, colr) in enumerate(ramp):
+        e = els[i] if i < 2 else els.new(pos)
+        e.position = pos
+        e.color = common.rgba(colr)
+    links.new(k, cr.inputs["Fac"])
+    # a few pale leaves; brightness per instance; dark toward the base
+    pale = math_("GREATER_THAN", per_leaf, 0.94)
+    colr = mix("RGBA", math_("MULTIPLY", pale, 0.75), cr.outputs["Color"], common.rgba(accent))
+    value = math_("MULTIPLY", mix("FLOAT", i2, 0.62, 1.12), mix("FLOAT", math_("POWER", h, 1.25), 0.1, 1.0))
+    lit = node("ShaderNodeVectorMath", operation="SCALE")
+    links.new(colr, lit.inputs[0])
+    links.new(value, lit.inputs["Scale"])
+    base = mix("RGBA", wood, lit.outputs[0], common.rgba(bark))
+    glow = node("ShaderNodeVectorMath", operation="MULTIPLY")
+    links.new(base, glow.inputs[0])
+    glow.inputs[1].default_value = (1.15, 1.7, 0.8)
+    bsdf = node("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    links.new(base, bsdf.inputs["Base Color"])
+    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.48
+    bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 0.4
+    trans = node("ShaderNodeBsdfTranslucent")
+    links.new(glow.outputs[0], trans.inputs["Color"])
+    sh = node("ShaderNodeMixShader")
+    links.new(math_("MULTIPLY", math_("SUBTRACT", 1.0, wood), translucency), sh.inputs[0])
+    links.new(bsdf.outputs[0], sh.inputs[1])
+    links.new(trans.outputs[0], sh.inputs[2])
+    out = node("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    links.new(sh.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat_
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- part
+def build(col):
+    """The library under `col`: one hidden child collection per category, one object per variant."""
+    red = foliage_material(RED, RED_RAMP, RED_ACCENT, RED_BARK)
+    green = foliage_material(MOSS, MOSS_RAMP, MOSS_ACCENT, MOSS_BARK, translucency=0.3, hue_spread=(0.6, 0.3, 0.8, 0.1))
+    factors = scale_factors()
+    made = {}
+    for ci, cat in enumerate(COLLECTIONS):
+        sub = bpy.data.collections.new(COLLECTIONS[cat])
+        col.children.link(sub)
+        for vi, v in enumerate(VARIANTS[cat]):
+            m = MAKERS[cat](v, np.random.default_rng([SEED, ci, vi]))
+            ob = m.object(f"{COLLECTIONS[cat]}_{v}", sub, green if cat == "moss" else red, scale=factors[cat])
+            made.setdefault(cat, []).append(ob)
+            print(f"  {ob.name:22s} {ob['cv_tris']:5d} triangles   {ob['cv_width']:.2f} m wide   {ob['cv_height']:.2f} m tall")
+        sub.hide_render = True
+        sub.hide_viewport = True
+    print("plants: scale from the picture", {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in factors.items()})
+    return made

@@ -1,0 +1,91 @@ 
+"""The rock formations of the Crimson Valley scene: part "rocks".
+
+  tools/cv part rocks --render renders/rocks/a.png --with sky,terrain,water
+
+One object per group of formations (CV_Rocks_<group>), from meshes/rocks_<group>.npz - closed solids
+whose camera-facing side follows the depth measured in the picture (tools/build_meshes.py explains how
+they are made). The groups and the rock each is made of:
+
+  near_hill        the hill the camera stands on: the left arch and its wall, the slope, the slabs
+  outcrop          the bladed outcrop at the bottom right
+  waterfall_cliff  pieces of the plateau the big waterfalls fall from
+  river_spires     the small spires standing in the river
+  mid_ridges       the ridges, spires and far spires in the mist left of centre (one continuous relief)
+  mid_spires       detached pieces of the tall spires
+  far_spires       detached pieces of the far spires seen under the left arch
+  big_arch         the city's arch, the cliffs and towers behind it, the waterfall plateau
+  right_towers     detached pieces of the towers
+  far              the mountains on the horizon
+
+Materials come from mat_rock.py (rock_material(name, preset)) when that module exists; until then a
+plain rock colour. Vertex attributes (ref_uv, dist, veg, moss, mist, front) are on every mesh."""
+import json
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+PRESETS = {
+    "near_hill": "sandstone", "outcrop": "boulder", "waterfall_cliff": "cliff", "river_spires": "spire",
+    "mid_ridges": "spire", "mid_spires": "spire", "far_spires": "far", "big_arch": "cliff",
+    "right_towers": "cliff", "far": "far",
+}
+PLAIN = {
+    "sandstone": "#8a6a52", "boulder": "#7a5c48", "cliff": "#5a4a44", "spire": "#6e5c52", "far": "#6f6a78",
+}
+TUNE = dict(crack_dark=0.35, block_crack=0.04, chip_crack=0.008, dist_from="attribute")
+ATTRS = ("ref_uv", "dist", "veg", "moss", "mist", "front")
+
+
+def plain_material(preset):
+    name = "CV_Rock_Plain_" + preset
+    if name in bpy.data.materials:
+        return bpy.data.materials[name]
+    mat, nodes, links = common.new_material(name)
+    bsdf = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = common.rgba(PLAIN[preset])
+    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.85
+    out = nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    links.new(bsdf.outputs["BSDF"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat
+
+
+def material_for(group):
+    preset = PRESETS.get(group, "cliff")
+    try:
+        import mat_rock
+        return mat_rock.rock_material("CV_Rock_" + group, preset=preset, **TUNE)
+    except Exception as ex:          # the library is not there yet (or failed): plain colour
+        print("rock material library not used for", group, "-", repr(ex)[:200])
+        return plain_material(preset)
+
+
+def build(col):
+    with open(os.path.join(common.MESHES, "rocks.json")) as fh:
+        info = json.load(fh)
+    for group in info["groups"]:
+        path = os.path.join(common.MESHES, f"rocks_{group}.npz")
+        if not os.path.exists(path):
+            continue
+        m = common.load_npz_mesh(path)
+        kind = m["face_kind"]
+        mat = material_for(group)
+        # the rock itself (front and back shells), and its unseen sides (the curtains) as a second
+        # object, so the sides can be kept from casting shadows into the picture
+        for suffix, sel in (("", kind != 3), ("_sides", kind == 3)):
+            faces = m["faces"][sel]
+            if not len(faces):
+                continue
+            used = np.unique(faces)
+            remap = np.full(len(m["verts"]), -1, np.int64)
+            remap[used] = np.arange(len(used))
+            ob = common.mesh_object("CV_Rocks_" + group + suffix, m["verts"][used], remap[faces].astype(np.int32), col,
+                                    attributes={k: m[k][used] for k in ATTRS if k in m}, smooth=not suffix)
+            ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+            ob["cv_group"] = group
+            if suffix:
+                ob.visible_shadow = os.environ.get("CV_SIDE_SHADOWS", "") == "1"
+                ob.visible_camera = os.environ.get("CV_SIDES_VISIBLE", "") == "1"   # they show through in places: off for renders
+            print(f"  {ob.name}: {len(used)} verts")

@@ -1,0 +1,130 @@ 
+"""A test of the rock material library (mat_rock.py), not part of the scene: part "rocktest".
+
+WORK IN PROGRESS - first version.
+
+  tools/cv part rocktest --no-save --no-sun --render renders/rocktest/a.png --scale 50 --samples 48 [options]
+
+Options (after the part's name, anywhere): --rt-layout=picture|lab  --rt-az=235  --rt-el=16  --rt-sun=10
+--rt-sky=0.3  --rt-only=name,name  --rt-border=x0,y0,x1,y1  --rt-flat (no relief modifier)  --rt-px=1
+"""
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+import mat_rock
+
+W, H = common.W, common.H
+
+
+def options():
+    o = {"layout": "picture", "az": "235", "el": "16", "sun": "10", "sky": "0.3", "only": "", "border": "",
+         "flat": "", "px": "1", "plain": ""}
+    for a in common.args_after_dashes():
+        if a.startswith("--rt-"):
+            k, _, v = a[5:].partition("=")
+            o[k] = v or "1"
+    return o
+
+
+def load_mask(name):
+    """An analysis mask as a bool array (H, W), row 0 at the top."""
+    img = bpy.data.images.load(os.path.join(common.ANALYSIS, name + ".png"))
+    img.colorspace_settings.name = "Non-Color"
+    buf = np.empty(img.size[0] * img.size[1] * img.channels, dtype=np.float32)
+    img.pixels.foreach_get(buf)
+    a = buf.reshape(img.size[1], img.size[0], img.channels)[::-1, :, 0]
+    bpy.data.images.remove(img)
+    return a > 0.5
+
+
+def sheet(name, mask, depth, col, attributes=None, cut=0.04):
+    """A stand-in for a rock mesh: one vertex per picture pixel of `mask`, at the given depth (metres
+    along the camera axis), joined into quads that face the camera; none across depth steps."""
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    vv, uu = np.nonzero(mask)
+    idx = -np.ones(mask.shape, dtype=np.int64)
+    idx[vv, uu] = np.arange(len(vv))
+    P = cm.unproject(uu + 0.5, vv + 0.5, depth[vv, uu])
+    a, b, c, d = idx[:-1, :-1], idx[:-1, 1:], idx[1:, 1:], idx[1:, :-1]
+    z = np.stack([depth[:-1, :-1], depth[:-1, 1:], depth[1:, 1:], depth[1:, :-1]])
+    ok = (a >= 0) & (b >= 0) & (c >= 0) & (d >= 0) & ((z.max(0) - z.min(0)) < cut * z.min(0) + 0.15)
+    faces = np.stack([a[ok], d[ok], c[ok], b[ok]], axis=1)
+    at = {"ref_uv": np.stack([(uu + 0.5) / W, 1.0 - (vv + 0.5) / H], axis=1),
+          "dist": np.linalg.norm(P - cm.pos, axis=1)}
+    for k, m in (attributes or {}).items():
+        at[k] = m[vv, uu].astype(np.float32)
+    return common.mesh_object(name, P, faces, col, attributes=at)
+
+
+def soft(mask, n=2):
+    """A mask as 0..1 floats, blurred a little."""
+    m = mask.astype(np.float32)
+    for _ in range(n):
+        m = (m + np.roll(m, 1, 0) + np.roll(m, -1, 0) + np.roll(m, 1, 1) + np.roll(m, -1, 1)) / 5.0
+    return m
+
+
+def picture_layout(col, opt):
+    """Sheets cut out of the picture's own depth, one per kind of rock."""
+    depth = np.load(os.path.join(common.ANALYSIS, "depth.npy")).astype(np.float64)
+    rock = ~load_mask("sky") & ~load_mask("floor") & ~load_mask("water") & (depth > 0)
+    veg, moss = soft(load_mask("veg")), soft(load_mask("moss"))
+    v, u = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
+
+    def box(x0, y0, x1, y1):
+        return (u >= x0) & (u < x1) & (v >= y0) & (v < y1)
+    boulder = rock & box(505, 585, 765, 860) & (depth > 24) & (depth < 45)
+    regions = [
+        ("boulder", "boulder", {}, boulder),
+        ("slab", "slab", {}, rock & box(0, 560, 840, H) & (depth < 60) & ~boulder),
+        ("outcrop", "boulder", {}, rock & box(840, 740, 1260, H) & (depth < 60)),
+        ("arch", "sandstone", {}, rock & box(0, 0, 700, 600) & (depth < 110)),
+        ("spire", "spire", {}, rock & (u < 900) & (depth >= 110) & (depth < 400)),
+        ("far", "far", {}, rock & (u < 900) & (depth >= 400)),
+        ("cliff", "cliff", {}, rock & (u >= 900) & (v < 640) & (depth >= 100)),
+        ("nearcliff", "cliff", {"scale": 0.35}, rock & (u >= 1250) & (v >= 430) & (depth < 100)),
+    ]
+    only = [s for s in opt["only"].split(",") if s]
+    taken = np.zeros((H, W), bool)
+    for name, preset, over, mask in regions:
+        mask = mask & ~taken
+        taken |= mask
+        if only and name not in only:
+            continue
+        ob = sheet("CV_RockTest_" + name, mask, depth, col, {"veg": veg, "moss": moss})
+        dress(ob, name, preset, over, opt)
+        print(f"  {ob.name}: {len(ob.data.vertices)} verts, preset {preset}")
+
+
+def dress(ob, name, preset, over, opt):
+    over = dict(over, px_scale=float(opt["px"]))
+    if opt["plain"]:
+        mat, nodes, links = common.new_material("CV_RockTest_plain")
+        b = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+        b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = common.rgba(mat_rock.PRESETS[preset].get("base", mat_rock.DEFAULTS["base"]))
+        b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.85
+        links.new(b.outputs[0], nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial").inputs[0])
+    else:
+        mat = mat_rock.rock_material("CV_RockTest_" + name, preset=preset, **over)
+    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+    if not opt["flat"]:
+        mat_rock.displace_modifiers(ob, preset, **over)
+
+
+def build(col):
+    opt = options()
+    print("rocktest options:", opt)
+    picture_layout(col, opt)
+    scene = bpy.context.scene
+    sun = common.preview_sun(scene, azimuth_deg=float(opt["az"]), elevation_deg=float(opt["el"]),
+                             strength=float(opt["sun"]))
+    sun.name = sun.data.name = "CV_RockTestSun"
+    common.preview_world(scene, strength=float(opt["sky"]))
+    if opt["border"]:
+        x0, y0, x1, y1 = [float(s) for s in opt["border"].split(",")]
+        r = scene.render
+        r.use_border, r.use_crop_to_border = True, False
+        r.border_min_x, r.border_max_x = x0 / W, x1 / W
+        r.border_min_y, r.border_max_y = 1.0 - y1 / H, 1.0 - y0 / H

@@ -1,0 +1,62 @@ 
+"""The clear sky of the Crimson Valley scene: part "sky" (the world CV_World).
+
+  tools/cv part sky --render renders/sky/sky.png --no-sun
+
+A sunset gradient by view direction: steel blue overhead, violet-grey lower, a peach band at the
+horizon, and a warm glow around the direction of the picture's brightest sky (behind the big arch, at
+picture point (1150, 380)); below the horizon a dark warm haze. The colours are sampled from the
+picture's clear patches. It is the scene's ambient light and what shows past the cloud card's edges."""
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    w = bpy.data.worlds.new(common.WORLD_NAME)
+    nt = common.node_tree(w)
+    nt.nodes.clear()
+    N, L = nt.nodes, nt.links
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputWorld")
+    bg = N.new("ShaderNodeBackground")
+    geo = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")             # Generated = the view direction in the world shader
+    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
+    L.new(geo.outputs["Generated"], sep.inputs[0])
+    ramp = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")            # by height of the direction: z = sin(elevation)
+    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    mp.inputs["From Min"].default_value = -0.25
+    mp.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.75
+    L.new(sep.outputs["Z"], mp.inputs["Value"])
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Result"], ramp.inputs["Fac"])
+    stops = [(0.0, "#2e2224"), (0.22, "#4a3434"), (0.25, "#e8a070"), (0.30, "#c98f86"), (0.40, "#8f8298"),
+             (0.60, "#66708e"), (1.0, "#4a5878")]
+    cr = ramp.color_ramp
+    while len(cr.elements) < len(stops):
+        cr.elements.new(0.5)
+    for el, (p, c) in zip(cr.elements, stops):
+        el.position = p
+        el.color = common.rgba(c)
+    # the glow: a lobe around the direction of the brightest sky
+    g = cm.rays(np.array(1150.0), np.array(385.0))
+    g = g / np.linalg.norm(g)
+    dot = N.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+    dot.operation = "DOT_PRODUCT"
+    dot.inputs[1].default_value = tuple(g)
+    L.new(geo.outputs["Generated"], dot.inputs[0])
+    pw = N.new("ShaderNodeMath")
+    pw.operation = "POWER"
+    pw.inputs[1].default_value = 10.0
+    cl = N.new("ShaderNodeClamp")
+    L.new(dot.outputs["Value"], cl.inputs["Value"])
+    L.new(cl.outputs["Result"], pw.inputs[0])
+    mix = N.new("ShaderNodeMix")
+    mix.data_type = "RGBA"
+    mix.blend_type = "ADD"
+    mix.inputs[7].default_value = common.rgba("#b05a20")
+    L.new(pw.outputs["Value"], mix.inputs[0])
+    L.new(ramp.outputs["Color"], mix.inputs[6])
+    L.new(mix.outputs[2], bg.inputs["Color"])
+    bg.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 1.5
+    L.new(bg.outputs["Background"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    bpy.context.scene.world = w

+"""The valley floor of the Crimson Valley scene: part "terrain".
+
+  tools/cv part terrain --render renders/terrain/a.png --with sky,rocks,water
+
+CV_Terrain is one sheet (meshes/terrain.npz, from tools/build_meshes.py): the valley floor at the height
+measured in the picture, filled in where rocks hide it and past the picture's edges, with river beds
+carved under the picture's water, and an apron of flat ground around it out to 30 km, so the world has
+a ground everywhere. Vertex attributes: ref_uv, dist, veg (red plant cover), moss, mist, seen (1 where the
+floor is visible in the picture), wet (1 at the water's edge and under water)."""
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+ATTRS = ("ref_uv", "dist", "veg", "moss", "mist", "front", "seen", "wet")
+
+
+def ground_material():
+    """Soil with red plant cover where the picture has it (the veg attribute), darker when wet."""
+    mat, nodes, links = common.new_material("CV_Ground")
+    out = nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    bsdf = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.9
+    veg = nodes.new("ShaderNodeAttribute")
+    veg.attribute_name = "veg"
+    wet = nodes.new("ShaderNodeAttribute")
+    wet.attribute_name = "wet"
+    geo = nodes.new("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    noise = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
+    noise.noise_type = "FBM"
+    noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 0.35
+    noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 6.0
+    links.new(geo.outputs["Position"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
+    soil = nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
+    soil.data_type = "RGBA"
+    soil.inputs[6].default_value = common.rgba("#5e4338")
+    soil.inputs[7].default_value = common.rgba("#8a6048")
+    links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], soil.inputs[0])
+    red = nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
+    red.data_type = "RGBA"
+    red.inputs[7].default_value = common.rgba("#5a1410")
+    links.new(veg.outputs["Fac"], red.inputs[0])

+    dark = nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
+    dark.data_type = "RGBA"
+    dark.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
+    dark.inputs[7].default_value = (0.45, 0.45, 0.5, 1.0)
+    links.new(wet.outputs["Fac"], dark.inputs[0])
+    links.new(red.outputs[2], dark.inputs[6])
+    links.new(dark.outputs[2], bsdf.inputs["Base Color"])
+    links.new(bsdf.outputs["BSDF"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat
+
+
+def build(col):
+    m = common.load_npz_mesh(os.path.join(common.MESHES, "terrain.npz"))
+    ob = common.mesh_object("CV_Terrain", m["verts"], m["faces"], col,
+                            attributes={k: m[k] for k in ATTRS if k in m})
+    ob.data.materials.append(ground_material())
+    print(f"  CV_Terrain: {len(m['verts'])} verts")

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,122 @@ 
+"""The red vegetation of the Crimson Valley scene: part "vegetation".
+
+  tools/cv part vegetation --with sky,clouds,terrain,rocks,water,lighting --render renders/vegetation/a.png
+
+Plants from the prototype library (parts/plants.blend, part_plants.py) instanced where the picture has
+red plant cover. The places come from the geometry itself: every camera-facing vertex of the terrain
+and the rocks carries the picture's plant cover (the veg attribute) and stands for one picture pixel,
+so vertices are drawn at random with a chance that grows with the cover and shrinks close to the camera
+(where a pixel is only centimetres wide). Near the camera they become ferns and shrubs at true size;
+farther away low carpets, scaled up with distance so the cover stays closed where a plant would be
+smaller than a pixel. Moss tufts go where the picture has yellow-green moss.
+One object of points per kind (CV_Veg_<kind>), each with a geometry-nodes modifier that instances the
+kind's variants at random, turned at random, at the point's scale."""
+import os
+
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+KINDS = {"fern": "CV_Plants_Fern", "shrub": "CV_Plants_Shrub", "carpet": "CV_Plants_Carpet",
+         "bush": "CV_Plants_Bush", "moss": "CV_Plants_Moss"}
+FOOT = {"fern": 0.9, "shrub": 0.7, "carpet": 0.7, "bush": 2.2, "moss": 0.35}     # metres a plant covers
+
+
+def gather():
+    """Candidate points: (position, cover, moss, distance) of the camera-facing vertices."""
+    out = []
+    names = [f for f in sorted(os.listdir(common.MESHES)) if f.endswith(".npz") and f != "water.npz"]
+    for f in names:
+        m = np.load(os.path.join(common.MESHES, f))
+        sel = (m["front"] > 0.5) & ((m["veg"] > 0.2) | (m["moss"] > 0.3))
+        uv = m["ref_uv"][sel]
+        inside = (uv[:, 0] > -0.03) & (uv[:, 0] < 1.03) & (uv[:, 1] > -0.05) & (uv[:, 1] < 1.03)
+        out.append(np.concatenate([m["verts"][sel][inside], m["veg"][sel][inside, None], m["moss"][sel][inside, None],
+                                   m["dist"][sel][inside, None]], 1))
+    return np.concatenate(out)
+
+
+def instancer(ob, collection):
+    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.new("CV_Scatter_" + collection.name, "GeometryNodeTree")
+    ng.interface.new_socket(name="Geometry", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
+    ng.interface.new_socket(name="Geometry", in_out="OUTPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry")
+    N, L = ng.nodes, ng.links
+    gi, go = N.new("NodeGroupInput"), N.new("NodeGroupOutput")
+    ci = N.new("GeometryNodeCollectionInfo")
+    ci.inputs["Collection"].default_value = collection
+    ci.inputs["Separate Children"].default_value = True
+    ci.inputs["Reset Children"].default_value = True
+    iop = N.new("GeometryNodeInstanceOnPoints")
+    iop.inputs["Pick Instance"].default_value = True
+    ri = N.new("FunctionNodeRandomValue")
+    ri.data_type = "INT"
+    ri.inputs["Min"].default_value = 0
+    ri.inputs["Max"].default_value = max(len(collection.objects) - 1, 0)
+    rz = N.new("FunctionNodeRandomValue")
+    rz.data_type = "FLOAT"
+    rz.inputs["Min"].default_value = 0.0
+    rz.inputs["Max"].default_value = 6.2832
+    rz.inputs["Seed"].default_value = 3
+    rot = N.new("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
+    def val(node):                       # the node's one live "Value" output (it has one per data type)
+        return next(o for o in node.outputs if o.enabled)
+    L.new(val(rz), rot.inputs["Z"])
+    sc = N.new("GeometryNodeInputNamedAttribute")
+    sc.data_type = "FLOAT"
+    sc.inputs["Name"].default_value = "s"
+    L.new(gi.outputs[0], iop.inputs["Points"])
+    L.new(ci.outputs[0], iop.inputs["Instance"])
+    L.new(val(ri), iop.inputs["Instance Index"])
+    L.new(rot.outputs[0], iop.inputs["Rotation"])
+    L.new(val(sc), iop.inputs["Scale"])
+    L.new(iop.outputs[0], go.inputs[0])
+    mod = ob.modifiers.new("Scatter", "NODES")
+    mod.node_group = ng
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
+    # the prototypes, out of sight
+    protos = bpy.data.collections.new("CV_Veg_Prototypes")
+    col.children.link(protos)
+    with bpy.data.libraries.load(common.part_path("plants"), link=False) as (src, dst):
+        dst.collections = [c for c in src.collections if c in KINDS.values()]
+    kinds = {}
+    for c in dst.collections:
+        protos.children.link(c)
+        c.hide_render = False
+        c.hide_viewport = False
+        kinds[[k for k, v in KINDS.items() if v == c.name][0]] = c
+    protos.hide_render = True
+    protos.hide_viewport = True
+
+    P = gather()
+    pos, veg, moss, dist = P[:, :3], P[:, 3], P[:, 4], P[:, 5]
+    px = dist / cm.f                                    # metres one pixel spans there
+    r = rng.random(len(P))
+    picks = {}
+    # moss
+    picks["moss"] = (moss > 0.3) & (r < np.clip((px / 0.25) ** 2, 0, 1) * moss)
+    red = veg > 0.2
+    kind_r = rng.random(len(P))
+    near, mid = dist < 45, (dist >= 45) & (dist < 150)
+    is_fern = red & near & (kind_r < 0.14)
+    is_shrub = red & ((near & (kind_r >= 0.14) & (kind_r < 0.62)) | (mid & (kind_r < 0.25)))
+    is_bush = red & mid & (kind_r > 0.985) & (dist > 55)
+    is_carpet = red & ~is_fern & ~is_shrub & ~is_bush
+    for k, sel in (("fern", is_fern), ("shrub", is_shrub), ("bush", is_bush), ("carpet", is_carpet)):
+        chance = np.clip((px / (0.42 * FOOT[k])) ** 2, 0, 1) * np.clip(veg * 2.5, 0, 1)
+        picks[k] = sel & (rng.random(len(P)) < chance)
+    for k, sel in picks.items():
+        if k not in kinds or not sel.any():
+            continue
+        p = pos[sel]
+        s = np.maximum(1.0, 2.4 * px[sel] / FOOT[k]) * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.3, int(sel.sum()))
+        if k == "bush":
+            s = rng.uniform(0.8, 1.25, int(sel.sum()))
+        ob = common.mesh_object("CV_Veg_" + k, p, [], col, smooth=False, attributes={"s": s})
+        instancer(ob, kinds[k])
+        ob["cv_light"] = "near" if k in ("fern",) else "valley"
+        print(f"  CV_Veg_{k}: {len(p)} plants")

+"""The river of the Crimson Valley scene: part "water".
+
+  tools/cv part water --render renders/water/a.png --with sky,clouds,terrain,rocks
+
+CV_Water is the plane z = 0 under the whole valley floor (meshes/water.npz). The terrain's river beds
+are carved below it exactly where the picture has water, and its banks are kept above it, so the
+river's outline is the picture's. The material is still water: a mirror with a faint tint and soft,
+slow ripples that stretch the reflections of the sky and the rocks a little, as in the picture."""
+import os
+
+import bpy
+
+import common
+
+
+def water_material():
+    mat, nodes, links = common.new_material("CV_Water")
+    out = nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    bsdf = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = common.rgba("#141c20")
+    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.06
+    bsdf.inputs["IOR"].default_value = 1.333
+    bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 1.0
+    bsdf.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = 0.6          # a brighter mirror at shallow angles
+    bsdf.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.04
+    geo = nodes.new("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    mapping = nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
+    mapping.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (0.5, 0.12, 1.0)   # ripples stretched across the view
+    links.new(geo.outputs["Position"], mapping.inputs["Vector"])
+    noise = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
+    noise.noise_type = "FBM"
+    noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 1.2
+    noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 4.0
+    noise.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.55
+    links.new(mapping.outputs["Vector"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
+    bump = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
+    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.06
+    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.05
+    links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], bump.inputs["Height"])
+    links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], bsdf.inputs["Normal"])
+    links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], bsdf.inputs["Coat Normal"])
+    links.new(bsdf.outputs["BSDF"], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat
+
+
+def build(col):
+    m = common.load_npz_mesh(os.path.join(common.MESHES, "water.npz"))
+    ob = common.mesh_object("CV_Water", m["verts"], m["faces"], col, smooth=False)
+    ob.data.materials.append(water_material())
+    ob.visible_shadow = False

@@ -1,0 +1,81 @@ 
+"""The waterfalls: part "waterfalls".
+
+  tools/cv part waterfalls --with sky,rocks,terrain,water --render renders/waterfalls/a.png
+
+Six falls traced off the picture (FALLS: top and bottom of the centre line and the width at each, in
+picture pixels). Each is a ribbon of two crossed, slightly bulged sheets hung half a metre in front of
+the rock: the distance of every row is the depth the picture has along the fall (analysis/depth.npy,
+smoothed down the fall). The material is self-lit cool white broken into long vertical streaks by
+noise stretched along the fall, denser at the lip and thinning into veils below."""
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+
+import common
+
+# u top, v top, u bottom, v bottom, width top, width bottom (picture pixels)
+FALLS = [(1566, 546, 1562, 772, 46, 72), (1432, 540, 1421, 705, 14, 30), (1300, 458, 1298, 525, 8, 15),
+         (1390, 330, 1392, 436, 12, 24), (1508, 340, 1506, 424, 8, 15), (1527, 342, 1526, 424, 8, 15)]
+
+
+def material():
+    mat, N, L = common.new_material("CV_Waterfall")
+    out = N.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    uv = N.new("ShaderNodeUVMap"); uv.uv_map = "UVMap"
+    mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
+    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (22.0, 1.3, 1.0)
+    L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
+    no = N.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise"); no.noise_type = "FBM"
+    no.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 1.0; no.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 5.0; no.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.6
+    L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], no.inputs["Vector"])
+    sep = N.new("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ"); L.new(uv.outputs["UV"], sep.inputs[0])
+    # denser at the lip (v = 1), thinner below; soft at the sides
+    side = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); side.operation = "PINGPONG"; side.inputs[1].default_value = 0.5
+    L.new(sep.outputs["X"], side.inputs[0])
+    sf = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange"); sf.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.22
+    L.new(side.outputs[0], sf.inputs["Value"])
+    th = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    th.inputs["To Min"].default_value = 0.62; th.inputs["To Max"].default_value = 0.30
+    L.new(sep.outputs["Y"], th.inputs["Value"])
+    a = N.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    a.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.8
+    L.new(th.outputs["Result"], a.inputs["From Min"])
+    L.new(no.outputs["Fac"], a.inputs["Value"])
+    al = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); al.operation = "MULTIPLY"
+    L.new(a.outputs["Result"], al.inputs[0]); L.new(sf.outputs["Result"], al.inputs[1])
+    em = N.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
+    em.inputs["Color"].default_value = common.rgba("#cfd6dc")
+    em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.85
+    tr = N.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
+    mix = N.new("ShaderNodeMixShader")
+    L.new(al.outputs[0], mix.inputs["Fac"]); L.new(tr.outputs[0], mix.inputs[1]); L.new(em.outputs[0], mix.inputs[2])
+    L.new(mix.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return mat
+
+
+def build(col):
+    cm = common.cam_model()
+    z = np.load(common.ANALYSIS + "/depth.npy")
+    mat = material()
+    for k, (ut, vt, ub, vb, wt, wb) in enumerate(FALLS):
+        rows = np.arange(vt, vb + 1)
+        t = (rows - vt) / max(vb - vt, 1)
+        uc = ut + (ub - ut) * t
+        d = np.array([np.median(z[r, int(u) - 2:int(u) + 3][z[r, int(u) - 2:int(u) + 3] > 0]) for r, u in zip(rows, uc)])
+        d = np.convolve(np.pad(d, 6, mode="edge"), np.ones(13) / 13, mode="valid") - 0.5
+        w = wt + (wb - wt) * t ** 0.7
+        verts, uvs = [], []
+        for bulge in (0.0, 0.35):
+            for side in (-1.0, 0.0, 1.0):
+                verts.append(cm.unproject(uc + side * w / 2, rows.astype(float), d - (bulge + (0.4 if side == 0 else 0.0)) * w * d / cm.f * 0.4))
+                uvs.append(np.stack([np.full(len(rows), 0.5 + side * 0.5 + bulge), 1 - t], 1))
+        n = len(rows)
+        faces = []
+        for s in range(2):
+            for c in range(2):
+                a0 = (s * 3 + c) * n + np.arange(n - 1)
+                b0 = a0 + n
+                faces.append(np.stack([a0, a0 + 1, b0 + 1, b0], 1))
+        ob = common.mesh_object(f"CV_Waterfall_{k + 1}", np.concatenate(verts), np.concatenate(faces).astype(np.int32),
+                                col, uvs=np.concatenate(uvs))
+        ob.data.materials.append(mat)
+        ob.visible_shadow = False

files.explanation: Produces the final analysis of the reference picture: calibrates and fuses the two depth maps, then writes the camera, the depth and the masks (sky, floor, water, plants, moss, mist) and an overview. Part of the Crimson Valley project in external/blender/: a recreation of a reference picture of an alien valley at sunset as a real 3D scene in Blender. It isn't part of the game or its builds.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,149 @@ 
+"""Final analysis products of the reference picture, written into analysis/.
+
+  python -I analyze.py <raw dir> [--water water_mask.png]
+
+<raw dir> holds the depth models' outputs (depth_estimate.py): depth_dav2s.npy (the detail map) and
+depth_dav1l.npy (the second opinion). Steps: calibrate both against the valley floor (calibrate.py),
+fuse them (fuse_depth.py), then:
+
+  camera.json     the camera (cvlib.Camera)
+  depth.npy       float32 (941, 1672): metres along the camera axis, 0 = sky. Nothing below the
+                  horizon is farther than the z = 0 plane; nothing is farther than FAR.
+  height.npy      world z of every land pixel (NaN in the sky)
+  sky.png         255 = sky (the planet, moons and clouds are sky)
+  floor.png       255 = valley floor (low, near z = 0): the river, its banks, the plain
+  water.png       255 = water (river and ponds; from sam_mask.py, cleaned)
+  veg.png         0..255 red vegetation cover (from colour)
+  moss.png        0..255 yellow-green moss / lichen on rock tops (from colour)
+  mist.png        0..255 pale mist and waterfall spray (from colour and softness)
+  overview.png    the masks drawn over the picture, to check them
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage as ndi
+from skimage import color
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
+import cvlib  # noqa: E402
+
+FAR = 9000.0          # the farthest any land is put (m)
+MIN_HEIGHT = -0.3     # land below the horizon is not put under this height (m)
+
+
+def run(*args):
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", *args], check=True)
+
+
+def save_mask(name, m):
+    a = (np.clip(m, 0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8) if m.dtype != np.bool_ else (m * 255).astype(np.uint8)
+    Image.fromarray(a).save(os.path.join(cvlib.ANALYSIS, name))
+
+
+def main():
+    a = sys.argv[1:]
+    raw = a[0]
+    water_src = a[a.index("--water") + 1] if "--water" in a else os.path.join(cvlib.ANALYSIS, "water.png")
+    os.makedirs(cvlib.ANALYSIS, exist_ok=True)
+    tmp = os.path.join(raw, "calibrated")
+    run(os.path.join(HERE, "calibrate.py"), os.path.join(raw, "depth_dav2s.npy"), tmp, "--tag", "v2s")
+    run(os.path.join(HERE, "calibrate.py"), os.path.join(raw, "depth_dav1l.npy"), tmp, "--tag", "v1l")
+    run(os.path.join(HERE, "fuse_depth.py"), os.path.join(tmp, "depth_v2s.npy"), os.path.join(tmp, "depth_v1l.npy"),
+        os.path.join(tmp, "depth_fused.npy"), "--weight", "0.5")
+    with open(os.path.join(tmp, "camera.json")) as fh:
+        cam = cvlib.Camera(**json.load(fh))
+    z = np.load(os.path.join(tmp, "depth_fused.npy")).astype(np.float64)
+    H, W = z.shape
+    u, v = cvlib.pixel_grid(W, H)
+
+    # --- sky: the detail model's zero, minus specks; the two moons are sky -----------------------
+    land = z > 0
+    lab, n = ndi.label(land)
+    sizes = ndi.sum(land, lab, range(1, n + 1))
+    land = lab == (1 + int(np.argmax(sizes)))                       # the one big piece of land
+    holes, nh = ndi.label(~land)                                     # pinholes in the land -> land
+    hs = ndi.sum(~land, holes, range(1, nh + 1))
+    for i in np.nonzero(hs < 40)[0]:
+        land |= holes == i + 1
+    # Land that the specks rule added needs a depth: nearest valid one.
+    need = land & ~(z > 0)
+    if need.any():
+        idx = ndi.distance_transform_edt(~(z > 0), return_distances=False, return_indices=True)
+        z[need] = z[idx[0][need], idx[1][need]]
+    z[~land] = 0.0
+
+    # --- depth limits ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    zmax_plane = cam.ground_z(v, MIN_HEIGHT)                         # inf above the horizon
+    z = np.where(land, np.minimum(np.minimum(z, zmax_plane), FAR), 0.0)
+    p = cam.unproject(u, v, np.where(land, z, 1.0))
+    height = np.where(land, p[..., 2], np.nan)
+    rng = np.hypot(p[..., 0], p[..., 1])
+
+    # --- valley floor: low land -----------------------------------------------------------------
+    floor = land & (np.nan_to_num(height, nan=1e9) < 2.5 + 0.012 * rng)
+    floor = ndi.binary_opening(floor, iterations=2)
+    fl, nf = ndi.label(floor)
+    fs = ndi.sum(floor, fl, range(1, nf + 1))
+    floor = np.isin(fl, 1 + np.nonzero(fs > 400)[0])                 # no specks of "floor" on rocks
+    floor &= v > cam.horizon_v + 1
+
+    # --- water (SAM), cleaned -------------------------------------------------------------------
+    water = np.asarray(Image.open(water_src).convert("L")) > 127
+    water &= land & (v > cam.horizon_v + 20)
+    water = ndi.binary_opening(water, iterations=1)
+    wl, nw = ndi.label(water)
+    ws = ndi.sum(water, wl, range(1, nw + 1))
+    water = np.isin(wl, 1 + np.nonzero(ws > 90)[0])
+    floor |= water
+
+    # --- colour classes -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    ref = np.asarray(Image.open(cvlib.REFERENCE).convert("RGB")).astype(np.float32) / 255
+    labc = color.rgb2lab(ref)
+    L, A, B = labc[..., 0], labc[..., 1], labc[..., 2]
+    chroma = np.hypot(A, B)
+    hue = np.degrees(np.arctan2(B, A))
+    # red plants: strongly red, hue between magenta-red and red-orange (sunlit rock is orange: hue > 45)
+    veg = np.clip((A - 9) / 14, 0, 1) * np.clip((47 - hue) / 9, 0, 1) * np.clip((hue + 15) / 10, 0, 1)
+    veg = np.where(land & ~water, veg, 0.0)
+    veg = ndi.gaussian_filter(veg, 0.7)
+    # moss: yellow-green, on land
+    moss = np.clip((chroma - 18) / 12, 0, 1) * np.clip((hue - 72) / 8, 0, 1) * np.clip((125 - hue) / 10, 0, 1)
+    moss = np.where(land & ~water, ndi.gaussian_filter(moss, 0.7), 0.0)
+    # mist: pale, colourless, soft (little local contrast), on land and not water
+    soft = ndi.gaussian_filter(np.abs(L - ndi.gaussian_filter(L, 3.0)), 4.0)
+    mist = np.clip((L - 52) / 14, 0, 1) * np.clip((16 - chroma) / 8, 0, 1) * np.clip((4.5 - soft) / 2.0, 0, 1)
+    mist = np.where(land & ~water, ndi.gaussian_filter(mist, 2.0), 0.0)
+
+    np.save(os.path.join(cvlib.ANALYSIS, "depth.npy"), z.astype(np.float32))
+    np.save(os.path.join(cvlib.ANALYSIS, "height.npy"), height.astype(np.float32))
+    with open(os.path.join(cvlib.ANALYSIS, "camera.json"), "w") as fh:
+        json.dump(cam.to_dict(), fh, indent=1)
+    save_mask("sky.png", ~land)
+    save_mask("floor.png", floor)
+    save_mask("water.png", water)
+    save_mask("veg.png", veg)
+    save_mask("moss.png", moss)
+    save_mask("mist.png", mist)
+
+    ov = ref * 255
+    ov[~land] = ov[~land] * 0.5 + np.array([60, 90, 200]) * 0.5
+    fo = floor & ~water
+    ov[fo] = ov[fo] * 0.6 + np.array([0, 200, 255]) * 0.4
+    ov[water] = ov[water] * 0.35 + np.array([0, 60, 255]) * 0.65
+    ov = ov * (1 - 0.6 * veg[..., None]) + np.array([255, 0, 200]) * 0.6 * veg[..., None]
+    ov = ov * (1 - 0.7 * moss[..., None]) + np.array([255, 255, 0]) * 0.7 * moss[..., None]
+    ov = ov * (1 - 0.7 * mist[..., None]) + np.array([255, 255, 255]) * 0.7 * mist[..., None]
+    Image.fromarray(np.clip(ov, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)).save(os.path.join(cvlib.ANALYSIS, "overview.png"))
+    print("land", round(float(land.mean()), 3), "floor", round(float(floor.mean()), 3), "water", round(float(water.mean()), 4),
+          "veg", round(float(veg.mean()), 4), "moss", round(float(moss.mean()), 4), "mist", round(float(mist.mean()), 4))
+    print("depth percentiles (m):", [round(float(np.percentile(z[land], q)), 1) for q in (0, 5, 25, 50, 75, 95, 100)])
+    print("height percentiles (m):", [round(float(np.nanpercentile(height, q)), 1) for q in (0, 5, 25, 50, 75, 95, 100)])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
