@@ -1,0 +1,497 @@ 
+"""Modelling kit of the spaceship (build_ship.py): materials and the ways its parts are made.
+
+The ship's frame: x forward (the nose), y to port, z up, metres; the origin is midway between the
+two lift fans, level with their rims. Everything is built in place (objects keep an identity
+transform), parts on the port side with mirror=True get a starboard twin (".P" -> ".S").
+
+Shapes: mesh() any verts / faces; box(); prism() a flat outline pushed out along an axis; lathe() a
+profile turned round an axis; skin() a stack of same-sized rings; plates() armour plates laid over the
+facets of a skin, with gaps; greebles() small machinery scattered on a patch; decal() a painted mark.
+Materials (Cycles): painted armour with panel lines, chips and scratches made in the shader from the
+point's place in space (no UVs needed), dark machinery, gold, glass, glowing lamps, engine flame."""
+import math
+import random
+
+import bmesh
+import bpy
+import numpy as np
+from mathutils import Vector
+
+COLL = "Spaceship"
+M = {}
+
+
+def coll():
+    c = bpy.data.collections.get(COLL)
+    if c is None:
+        c = bpy.data.collections.new(COLL)
+        bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(c)
+    return c
+
+
+def lin(c):
+    if isinstance(c, str):
+        c = tuple(int(c[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (1, 3, 5))
+    return tuple(x / 12.92 if x <= 0.04045 else ((x + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4 for x in c)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials
+
+def _mat(name):
+    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
+    m.use_nodes = True
+    nt = m.node_tree
+    nt.nodes.clear()
+    out = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+    return m, nt, out
+
+
+def _mix(nt, a, b, fac, kind="MIX"):
+    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
+    n.data_type = "RGBA"
+    n.blend_type = kind
+    for sock, v in ((n.inputs[6], a), (n.inputs[7], b), (n.inputs[0], fac)):
+        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+            sock.default_value = v
+        elif isinstance(v, tuple):
+            sock.default_value = (*v, 1)
+        else:
+            nt.links.new(v, sock)
+    return n.outputs[2]
+
+
+def _math(nt, op, a, b=None, clamp=False):
+    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
+    n.operation = op
+    n.use_clamp = clamp
+    for sock, v in ((n.inputs[0], a), (n.inputs[1], b)):
+        if v is None:
+            continue
+        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+            sock.default_value = v
+        else:
+            nt.links.new(v, sock)
+    return n.outputs[0]
+
+
+def _noise(nt, vec, scale, detail=4.0, rough=0.6, stretch=None):
+    if stretch:
+        mp = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
+        mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = stretch
+        nt.links.new(vec, mp.inputs["Vector"])
+        vec = mp.outputs[0]
+    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
+    n.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale
+    n.inputs["Detail"].default_value = detail
+    n.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
+    nt.links.new(vec, n.inputs["Vector"])
+    return n.outputs["Fac"]
+
+
+def _step(nt, v, lo, hi):
+    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    n.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
+    n.inputs[1].default_value, n.inputs[2].default_value = lo, hi
+    nt.links.new(v, n.inputs[0])
+    return n.outputs[0]
+
+
+def mat_armour(name, color, panel=(0.7, 1.1, 1.3), dark="#1b1a1c", metal=0.0, rough=0.42, chips=1.0, lines=1.0, tint=0.14, seam_w=0.022):
+    """Painted armour: rectangular panels (`panel` of them per metre along x, y, z, each row
+    staggered) of slightly different shades with dark seams between them, chipped and scratched
+    paint, grime - all from the point's place in the ship's frame."""
+    m, nt, out = _mat(name)
+    N, L = nt.nodes.new, nt.links.new
+    tc = N("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    co = tc.outputs["Object"]
+    sep = N("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
+    L(co, sep.inputs[0])
+    geo = N("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
+    sn = N("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
+    L(geo.outputs["Normal"], sn.inputs[0])
+    c = [_math(nt, "MULTIPLY", sep.outputs[i], panel[i]) for i in range(3)]
+    fl = [_math(nt, "FLOOR", c[i]) for i in range(3)]
+    seam, ids = None, []
+    for a in range(3):
+        b1, b2 = [i for i in range(3) if i != a]
+        cb = N("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
+        L(fl[b1], cb.inputs[0])
+        L(fl[b2], cb.inputs[1])
+        cb.inputs[2].default_value = 7.3 * (a + 1)
+        wn = N("ShaderNodeTexWhiteNoise")
+        wn.noise_dimensions = "3D"
+        L(cb.outputs[0], wn.inputs["Vector"])
+        pa = _math(nt, "ADD", c[a], wn.outputs["Value"])              # each row of panels starts somewhere else
+        d = _math(nt, "ABSOLUTE", _math(nt, "SUBTRACT", _math(nt, "FRACT", pa), 0.5))
+        w = seam_w * panel[a]
+        line = _step(nt, d, 0.5 - w, 0.5 - w * 0.35)
+        flat = _math(nt, "SUBTRACT", 1.0, _step(nt, _math(nt, "ABSOLUTE", sn.outputs[a]), 0.75, 0.92))   # (no seams lying in the face)
+        line = _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", line, flat)
+        seam = line if seam is None else _math(nt, "MAXIMUM", seam, line)
+        ids.append(_math(nt, "FLOOR", pa))
+    seam = _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", seam, lines)
+    cid = N("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ")
+    for i in range(3):
+        L(ids[i], cid.inputs[i])
+    rnd = N("ShaderNodeTexWhiteNoise")
+    rnd.noise_dimensions = "3D"
+    L(cid.outputs[0], rnd.inputs["Vector"])
+    base = lin(color)
+    shade = _mix(nt, tuple(c * (1 - tint) for c in base), tuple(min(c * (1 + tint * 0.5), 1.0) for c in base), rnd.outputs["Value"])
+    grime = _step(nt, _noise(nt, co, 0.45, 5.0, 0.65), 0.35, 0.75)
+    shade = _mix(nt, shade, tuple(c * 0.5 for c in base), _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", grime, 0.55))
+    chip = _step(nt, _noise(nt, co, 5.0, 7.0, 0.78), 0.60, 0.63)                                         # flakes of paint gone
+    scratch = _step(nt, _noise(nt, co, 2.2, 6.0, 0.8, stretch=(0.2, 4.0, 4.0)), 0.63, 0.66)
+    worn = _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", _math(nt, "MAXIMUM", chip, scratch), chips)
+    shade = _mix(nt, shade, lin(dark), worn)
+    shade = _mix(nt, shade, lin("#08080a"), seam)
+    bs = N("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    L(shade, bs.inputs["Base Color"])
+    bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
+    L(_math(nt, "ADD", rough - 0.08, _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", grime, 0.22)), bs.inputs["Roughness"])
+    bump = N("ShaderNodeBump")
+    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.7
+    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.04
+    L(_math(nt, "SUBTRACT", 1.0, _math(nt, "MAXIMUM", seam, _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", worn, 0.4))), bump.inputs["Height"])
+    L(bump.outputs[0], bs.inputs["Normal"])
+    L(bs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    m.diffuse_color = (*base, 1)
+    return m
+
+
+def mat_metal(name, color, rough=0.25, metal=1.0):
+    m, nt, out = _mat(name)
+    bs = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*lin(color), 1)
+    bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
+    tc = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    r = _math(nt, "ADD", rough, _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", _noise(nt, tc.outputs["Object"], 2.5, 4.0, 0.6), 0.18))
+    nt.links.new(r, bs.inputs["Roughness"])
+    nt.links.new(bs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    m.diffuse_color = (*lin(color), 1)
+    return m
+
+
+def mat_glow(name, color, strength):
+    m, nt, out = _mat(name)
+    em = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeEmission")
+    em.inputs["Color"].default_value = (*lin(color), 1)
+    em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = strength
+    nt.links.new(em.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    m.diffuse_color = (*lin(color), 1)
+    return m
+
+
+def mat_glass(name):
+    m, nt, out = _mat(name)
+    bs = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.012, 0.016, 0.03, 1)
+    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.04
+    bs.inputs["Transmission Weight"].default_value = 0.85
+    bs.inputs["IOR"].default_value = 1.2
+    bs.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = 1.0
+    bs.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.02
+    nt.links.new(bs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    m.diffuse_color = (0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 1)
+    return m
+
+
+def mat_flame(name, x_hot, x_end):
+    """Engine flame: bright blue-white at x_hot fading to nothing at x_end, soft at its edge."""
+    m, nt, out = _mat(name)
+    N, L = nt.nodes.new, nt.links.new
+    tc = N("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    sep = N("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
+    L(tc.outputs["Object"], sep.inputs[0])
+    t = N("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+    t.inputs[1].default_value, t.inputs[2].default_value = x_hot, x_end
+    L(sep.outputs[0], t.inputs[0])
+    fade = _math(nt, "POWER", _math(nt, "SUBTRACT", 1.0, t.outputs[0]), 1.6)
+    lw = N("ShaderNodeLayerWeight")
+    lw.inputs["Blend"].default_value = 0.35
+    soft = _math(nt, "SUBTRACT", 1.0, lw.outputs["Facing"])
+    a = _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", fade, _math(nt, "POWER", soft, 1.5), clamp=True)
+    col = _mix(nt, lin("#0a3cff"), lin("#7fd0ff"), _math(nt, "POWER", fade, 3.0))
+    em = N("ShaderNodeEmission")
+    L(col, em.inputs["Color"])
+    em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 7.0
+    tr = N("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent")
+    mix = N("ShaderNodeMixShader")
+    L(a, mix.inputs[0])
+    L(tr.outputs[0], mix.inputs[1])
+    L(em.outputs[0], mix.inputs[2])
+    L(mix.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return m
+
+
+def mat_decal(name, image, color):
+    """Paint laid over the armour: `color` where the picture is white, nothing elsewhere, chipped."""
+    m, nt, out = _mat(name)
+    N, L = nt.nodes.new, nt.links.new
+    tx = N("ShaderNodeTexImage")
+    tx.image = image
+    tx.extension = "CLIP"
+    tc = N("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    co = tc.outputs["Object"]
+    chip = _step(nt, _noise(nt, co, 5.0, 7.0, 0.78), 0.60, 0.63)
+    scratch = _step(nt, _noise(nt, co, 2.2, 6.0, 0.8, stretch=(0.2, 4.0, 4.0)), 0.63, 0.66)
+    a = _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", tx.outputs["Color"], _math(nt, "SUBTRACT", 1.0, _math(nt, "MAXIMUM", chip, scratch)), clamp=True)
+    bs = N("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    base = lin(color)
+    shade = _mix(nt, base, tuple(c * 0.6 for c in base), _step(nt, _noise(nt, co, 0.35, 5.0, 0.65), 0.35, 0.75))
+    L(shade, bs.inputs["Base Color"])
+    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.42
+    L(a, bs.inputs["Alpha"])
+    L(bs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return m
+
+
+def image(name, a):
+    """A Blender image from an (h, w) or (h, w, 3) float array (top row first)."""
+    if a.ndim == 2:
+        a = np.repeat(a[..., None], 3, axis=2)
+    h, w = a.shape[:2]
+    img = bpy.data.images.new(name, w, h, alpha=False, is_data=True)       # (a mask: no colour management)
+    px = np.ones((h, w, 4), np.float32)
+    px[:, :, :3] = a[::-1]
+    img.pixels.foreach_set(px.ravel())
+    img.update()
+    img.pack()
+    return img
+
+
+def stroke_mask(w, h, pts, width, m=None):
+    """A soft-edged stroke along the points (picture pixels), added to the mask m."""
+    m = np.zeros((h, w), np.float32) if m is None else m
+    r = width / 2
+    P = [np.array(p, np.float64) for p in pts]
+    for a, b in zip(P, P[1:]):
+        x0, x1 = max(int(min(a[0], b[0]) - r - 2), 0), min(int(max(a[0], b[0]) + r + 3), w)
+        y0, y1 = max(int(min(a[1], b[1]) - r - 2), 0), min(int(max(a[1], b[1]) + r + 3), h)
+        if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
+            continue
+        yy, xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1, x0:x1]
+        ab = b - a
+        t = np.clip(((xx - a[0]) * ab[0] + (yy - a[1]) * ab[1]) / (float(ab @ ab) or 1e-9), 0, 1)
+        d = np.hypot(xx - (a[0] + t * ab[0]), yy - (a[1] + t * ab[1]))
+        m[y0:y1, x0:x1] = np.maximum(m[y0:y1, x0:x1], np.clip(r - d + 0.5, 0, 1))
+    return m
+
+
+def spiral(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, turns, n=80):
+    return [(cx + (r0 + (r1 - r0) * i / n) * math.cos(a0 + 2 * math.pi * turns * i / n),
+             cy + (r0 + (r1 - r0) * i / n) * math.sin(a0 + 2 * math.pi * turns * i / n)) for i in range(n + 1)]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- meshes
+
+def _twin(name):
+    return name.replace(".P", ".S") if ".P" in name else name + ".S"
+
+
+def mesh(name, verts, faces, mat="white", bevel=0.0, smooth=False, mirror=False, uv=None, mats=None, fmat=None, weld=False, recalc=True):
+    """A mesh object. bevel: rounds its sharp edges (m); mats: more materials, fmat: each face's
+    material number; uv: one coordinate per face corner, in order."""
+    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
+    me.from_pydata([tuple(v) for v in verts], [], [tuple(f) for f in faces])
+    me.update()
+    if uv is not None:
+        me.uv_layers.new(name="UV").data.foreach_set("uv", np.asarray(uv, np.float32).ravel())
+    bm = bmesh.new()
+    bm.from_mesh(me)
+    if weld:
+        bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=1e-4)
+    if recalc:
+        bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
+    bm.to_mesh(me)
+    bm.free()
+    for k in [mat] + list(mats or []):
+        me.materials.append(M[k])
+    if fmat is not None:
+        me.polygons.foreach_set("material_index", np.asarray(fmat, np.int32))
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
+    coll().objects.link(ob)
+    if bevel > 0:
+        b = ob.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
+        b.width, b.segments, b.limit_method, b.angle_limit = bevel, 2, "ANGLE", math.radians(30)
+        b.harden_normals = True
+    me.polygons.foreach_set("use_smooth", np.full(len(me.polygons), True, bool))
+    me.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(40 if smooth else 16))
+    if mirror:
+        mirror_obj(ob)
+    return ob
+
+
+def mirror_obj(ob):
+    """The starboard twin of a port part."""
+    me2 = ob.data.copy()
+    me2.name = _twin(ob.name)
+    co = np.empty(len(me2.vertices) * 3, np.float32)
+    me2.vertices.foreach_get("co", co)
+    co[1::3] *= -1.0
+    me2.vertices.foreach_set("co", co)
+    me2.flip_normals()
+    ob2 = bpy.data.objects.new(me2.name, me2)
+    coll().objects.link(ob2)
+    for md in ob.modifiers:
+        b = ob2.modifiers.new(md.name, md.type)
+        b.width, b.segments, b.limit_method, b.angle_limit, b.harden_normals = md.width, md.segments, md.limit_method, md.angle_limit, True
+    return ob2
+
+
+def cut_hole(ob, center, radius, z0, z1, seg=64):
+    """Cuts a round hole (a vertical cylinder) through the object."""
+    c = cyl("_cutter", (center[0], center[1], z0), (center[0], center[1], z1), radius, seg=seg)
+    mods = [(m.width, m.segments, m.limit_method, m.angle_limit) for m in ob.modifiers]
+    ob.modifiers.clear()
+    b = ob.modifiers.new("Cut", "BOOLEAN")
+    b.operation, b.object, b.solver = "DIFFERENCE", c, "EXACT"
+    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
+    dg.update()
+    me = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(ob.evaluated_get(dg))
+    old = ob.data
+    ob.modifiers.clear()
+    ob.data = me
+    me.name = old.name
+    bpy.data.meshes.remove(old)
+    bpy.data.objects.remove(c, do_unlink=True)
+    me.polygons.foreach_set("use_smooth", np.full(len(me.polygons), True, bool))
+    me.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(16))
+    for w, sg, lm, al in mods:
+        m = ob.modifiers.new("Bevel", "BEVEL")
+        m.width, m.segments, m.limit_method, m.angle_limit, m.harden_normals = w, sg, lm, al, True
+
+
+def box_data(lo, hi):
+    (x0, y0, z0), (x1, y1, z1) = lo, hi
+    v = [(x0, y0, z0), (x1, y0, z0), (x1, y1, z0), (x0, y1, z0), (x0, y0, z1), (x1, y0, z1), (x1, y1, z1), (x0, y1, z1)]
+    f = [(0, 3, 2, 1), (4, 5, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5, 4), (1, 2, 6, 5), (2, 3, 7, 6), (3, 0, 4, 7)]
+    return v, f
+
+
+def box(name, lo, hi, mat="white", bevel=0.03, **kw):
+    v, f = box_data(lo, hi)
+    return mesh(name, v, f, mat, bevel=bevel, **kw)
+
+
+def prism(name, outline, lo, hi, axis="z", mat="white", bevel=0.03, taper=None, **kw):
+    """The outline (2D points) pushed from lo to hi along the axis: "z" - outline (x, y); "y" -
+    outline (x, z); "x" - outline (y, z). taper: the far end's outline instead (same point count)."""
+    def P(p, h):
+        return {"z": (p[0], p[1], h), "y": (p[0], h, p[1]), "x": (h, p[0], p[1])}[axis]
+    n = len(outline)
+    far = taper or outline
+    verts = [P(p, lo) for p in outline] + [P(p, hi) for p in far]
+    faces = [tuple(range(n)), tuple(range(n, 2 * n))] + [(i, (i + 1) % n, n + (i + 1) % n, n + i) for i in range(n)]
+    return mesh(name, verts, faces, mat, bevel=bevel, **kw)
+
+
+def skin(name, rings, mat="dark", caps=True, bevel=0.0, loop=False, **kw):
+    """Skins a stack of rings (lists of the same number of points). loop: the last joins the first."""
+    n = len(rings[0])
+    R = len(rings)
+    verts = [p for r in rings for p in r]
+    faces = []
+    for i in range(R if loop else R - 1):
+        i2 = (i + 1) % R
+        for j in range(n):
+            k = (j + 1) % n
+            faces.append((i * n + j, i * n + k, i2 * n + k, i2 * n + j))
+    if caps and not loop:
+        faces += [tuple(range(n)), tuple(range((len(rings) - 1) * n, len(rings) * n))]
+    return mesh(name, verts, faces, mat, bevel=bevel, **kw)
+
+
+def lathe(name, profile, origin, axis="z", seg=48, mat="gold", smooth=True, caps=False, loop=False, **kw):
+    """The profile - (radius, height) points - turned round the axis through origin. loop: the
+    profile is a closed outline (a ring's section)."""
+    o = Vector(origin)
+    rings = []
+    for r, h in profile:
+        ring = []
+        for k in range(seg):
+            a = 2 * math.pi * k / seg
+            c, s = r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a)
+            ring.append(o + Vector({"z": (c, s, h), "x": (h, c, s), "y": (c, h, s)}[axis]))
+        rings.append(ring)
+    return skin(name, rings, mat, caps=caps, loop=loop, smooth=smooth, **kw)
+
+
+def cyl(name, p0, p1, r0, r1=None, mat="dark", seg=16, **kw):
+    p0, p1 = Vector(p0), Vector(p1)
+    r1 = r0 if r1 is None else r1
+    t = (p1 - p0).normalized()
+    u = t.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
+    u = u.normalized() if u.length > 1e-5 else Vector((1, 0, 0))
+    v = t.cross(u)
+    rings = [[p + u * (r * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / seg)) + v * (r * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / seg)) for k in range(seg)]
+             for p, r in ((p0, r0), (p1, r1))]
+    return skin(name, rings, mat, smooth=True, **kw)
+
+
+def quad_plate(q, thick, gap):
+    """A plate over the quad q (4 points, counter-clockwise seen from outside): shrunk by gap from its
+    edges and raised by thick. Returns verts, faces."""
+    q = [Vector(p) for p in q]
+    n = (q[1] - q[0]).cross(q[3] - q[0])
+    if n.length < 1e-9:
+        n = (q[2] - q[1]).cross(q[0] - q[1])
+    n.normalize()
+    c = sum(q, Vector()) / 4
+    inner = []
+    for p in q:
+        d = c - p
+        inner.append(p + d.normalized() * min(gap * 1.4, d.length * 0.3))
+    v = [p - n * 0.02 for p in inner] + [p + n * thick for p in inner]
+    f = [(4, 5, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5, 4), (1, 2, 6, 5), (2, 3, 7, 6), (3, 0, 4, 7)]
+    return v, f
+
+
+def merge(parts):
+    """Joins (verts, faces) lists into one."""
+    V, F = [], []
+    for v, f in parts:
+        o = len(V)
+        V += list(v)
+        F += [tuple(i + o for i in face) for face in f]
+    return V, F
+
+
+def greebles(name, origin, u, v, count, seed, size=(0.25, 0.9), height=(0.08, 0.45), mat="dark", mirror=False, bevel=0.012, lamps=0, n=None):
+    """Small machinery scattered on the patch origin + a*u + b*v (a, b in 0..1), standing along the
+    patch's normal: boxes and a few pipes; `lamps` of them are glowing lamps (a second object)."""
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    o, u, v = Vector(origin), Vector(u), Vector(v)
+    nrm = Vector(n).normalized() if n is not None else u.cross(v).normalized()
+    ul, vl = u.length, v.length
+    uu, vv = u / ul, v / vl
+    parts, glow = [], []
+    for i in range(count):
+        w, d = rng.uniform(*size), rng.uniform(*size) * rng.choice((0.4, 0.7, 1.0))
+        if rng.random() < 0.5:
+            w, d = d, w
+        w, d = min(w, ul * 0.9), min(d, vl * 0.9)
+        a, b = rng.uniform(0, ul - w), rng.uniform(0, vl - d)
+        h = rng.uniform(*height) * rng.choice((0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 1.6))
+        base = o + uu * a + vv * b
+        pts = [base, base + uu * w, base + uu * w + vv * d, base + vv * d]
+        verts = [p - nrm * 0.05 for p in pts] + [p + nrm * h for p in pts]
+        faces = [(4, 5, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5, 4), (1, 2, 6, 5), (2, 3, 7, 6), (3, 0, 4, 7)]
+        (glow if i < lamps else parts).append((verts, faces))
+    obs = []
+    if parts:
+        V, F = merge(parts)
+        obs.append(mesh(name, V, F, mat, bevel=bevel, mirror=mirror))
+    if glow:
+        V, F = merge(glow)
+        obs.append(mesh(name + "_Lamps", V, F, "lamp", mirror=mirror))
+    return obs
+
+
+def decal(name, corners, mat, lift=0.012):
+    """A painted mark on the quad `corners` (its picture's bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right,
+    top-left), a hair above the surface."""
+    q = [Vector(p) for p in corners]
+    n = (q[1] - q[0]).cross(q[3] - q[0]).normalized()
+    ob = mesh(name, [p + n * lift for p in q], [(0, 1, 2, 3)], mat, uv=[(0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1)], recalc=False)
+    return ob

@@ -1,0 +1,131 @@ 
+"""The reference picture's camera, worked out from its two lift fans:  python -I camera.py fit | at <px> <py> <axis> <value> ...
+
+The fans are two equal circles (radius FAN_R, level, either side of the centre line), so the way the
+picture squashes and sizes them fixes where the camera is. `fit` solves for it and writes camera.json
+(the ship's frame: x forward, y to port, z up, the origin midway between the fans' centres).
+`at px py axis value` tells where the picture's pixel (px, py) is on the plane axis = value (e.g.
+"at 1745 765 y 0" = the nose tip, on the centre plane) - how the ship's sizes are read off the picture."""
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "camera.json")
+W, H = 1774, 887
+FAN_R = 2.6
+# the top lip of each fan's ring in the picture: its leftmost and rightmost points, its top and bottom rows
+NEAR = dict(left=(341, 404), right=(633, 396), top=340, bottom=450)       # the starboard fan (y < 0)
+FAR = dict(left=(934, 228), right=(1160, 258), top=211, bottom=282)
+
+
+def basis(p):
+    az, el, dist, tx, ty, tz, f, roll = p[:8]
+    t = np.array([tx, ty, tz])
+    c = t + dist * np.array([math.cos(el) * math.cos(az), math.cos(el) * math.sin(az), math.sin(el)])
+    fw = (t - c) / np.linalg.norm(t - c)
+    right = np.cross(fw, [0, 0, 1.0])
+    right /= np.linalg.norm(right)
+    up = np.cross(right, fw)
+    r2 = right * math.cos(roll) + up * math.sin(roll)
+    u2 = -right * math.sin(roll) + up * math.cos(roll)
+    return c, fw, r2, u2, f
+
+
+def project(p, pts):
+    c, fw, right, up, f = basis(p)
+    d = np.asarray(pts, float) - c
+    z = d @ fw
+    return np.stack([W / 2 + f * (d @ right) / z, H / 2 - f * (d @ up) / z], axis=1)
+
+
+def circle(y, n=180):
+    a = np.linspace(0, 2 * math.pi, n, endpoint=False)
+    return np.stack([FAN_R * np.cos(a), y + FAN_R * np.sin(a), np.zeros(n)], axis=1)
+
+
+def residual(p):
+    out = []
+    for obs, y in ((NEAR, -p[8]), (FAR, p[8])):
+        q = project(p, circle(y))
+        i, j = q[:, 0].argmin(), q[:, 0].argmax()
+        out += [q[i, 0] - obs["left"][0], q[i, 1] - obs["left"][1], q[j, 0] - obs["right"][0], q[j, 1] - obs["right"][1],
+                q[:, 1].min() - obs["top"], q[:, 1].max() - obs["bottom"]]
+    return np.array(out)
+
+
+def fit():
+    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
+    p0 = [math.radians(-45), math.radians(24), 38.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1500.0, 0.0, 5.5]
+    r = least_squares(residual, p0, x_scale=[0.1, 0.1, 5, 1, 1, 1, 200, 0.05, 1])
+    p = r.x
+    c, fw, right, up, f = basis(p)
+    print("residuals (px):", np.round(r.fun, 1))
+    print("azimuth %.1f, elevation %.1f, distance %.1f, focal %.0f px (lens %.1f mm), roll %.2f, fans at y = +-%.2f"
+          % (math.degrees(p[0]), math.degrees(p[1]), p[2], p[6], p[6] * 36 / W, math.degrees(p[7]), p[8]))
+    with open(OUT, "w") as fh:
+        json.dump(dict(params=list(map(float, p)), location=list(map(float, c)), forward=list(map(float, fw)), up=list(map(float, up)),
+                       lens=float(p[6] * 36 / W), fan_y=float(p[8]), fan_r=FAN_R, size=[W, H]), fh, indent=1)
+
+
+def at(px, py, axis, value):
+    with open(OUT) as fh:
+        p = json.load(fh)["params"]
+    c, fw, right, up, f = basis(p)
+    d = fw + right * ((px - W / 2) / f) + up * ((H / 2 - py) / f)
+    k = "xyz".index(axis)
+    t = (value - c[k]) / d[k]
+    return c + d * t
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if sys.argv[1] == "fit":
+        fit()
+    elif sys.argv[1] == "at":
+        a = sys.argv[2:]
+        for i in range(0, len(a), 4):
+            q = at(float(a[i]), float(a[i + 1]), a[i + 2], float(a[i + 3]))
+            print("(%s, %s) on %s = %s:  x %.2f  y %.2f  z %.2f" % (a[i], a[i + 1], a[i + 2], a[i + 3], *q))
+
+
+def rectify(axis, value, u_rng, v_rng, out, ppm=40):
+    """The picture as it would look drawn flat on the plane axis = value (a plan for z, an elevation
+    for y): out is a picture of the plane's other two axes over the given ranges, a line every metre."""
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+    ref = np.asarray(Image.open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "reference", "reference.png")).convert("RGBA")).astype(np.float32)
+    with open(OUT) as fh:
+        p = json.load(fh)["params"]
+    k = "xyz".index(axis)
+    ua, va = [i for i in range(3) if i != k]
+    us = np.arange(u_rng[0], u_rng[1], 1.0 / ppm)
+    vs = np.arange(v_rng[1], v_rng[0], -1.0 / ppm)
+    uu, vv = np.meshgrid(us, vs)
+    pts = np.zeros(uu.shape + (3,))
+    pts[..., k], pts[..., ua], pts[..., va] = value, uu, vv
+    q = project(p, pts.reshape(-1, 3)).reshape(uu.shape + (2,))
+    xi, yi = np.round(q[..., 0]).astype(int), np.round(q[..., 1]).astype(int)
+    ok = (xi >= 0) & (xi < W) & (yi >= 0) & (yi < H)
+    img = np.zeros(uu.shape + (3,), np.float32) + 40
+    px = ref[yi.clip(0, H - 1), xi.clip(0, W - 1)]
+    a = px[..., 3:4] / 255 * ok[..., None]
+    img = img * (1 - a) + px[..., :3] * a
+    im = Image.fromarray(img.astype(np.uint8))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im, "RGBA")
+    for u in range(int(math.ceil(u_rng[0])), int(u_rng[1]) + 1):
+        X = (u - u_rng[0]) * ppm
+        d.line([(X, 0), (X, im.height)], fill=(0, 255, 255, 160 if u % 5 == 0 else 50))
+        if u % 5 == 0:
+            d.text((X + 2, 2), "%s %d" % ("xyz"[ua], u), fill=(0, 255, 255, 255))
+    for v in range(int(math.ceil(v_rng[0])), int(v_rng[1]) + 1):
+        Y = (v_rng[1] - v) * ppm
+        d.line([(0, Y), (im.width, Y)], fill=(0, 255, 255, 160 if v % 5 == 0 else 50))
+        if v % 5 == 0:
+            d.text((2, Y + 2), "%s %d" % ("xyz"[va], v), fill=(0, 255, 255, 255))
+    im.save(out)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__" and sys.argv[1] == "rectify":
+    a = sys.argv[2:]
+    rectify(a[0], float(a[1]), (float(a[2]), float(a[3])), (float(a[4]), float(a[5])), a[6], int(a[7]) if len(a) > 7 else 40)

+"""Puts the render beside the reference picture:  python -I compare.py [<render>]
+Writes renders/vs_reference.png (the picture above, the render below, both on dark grey) and
+renders/overlay.png (the picture's outline in green over the render), and prints how much of the
+two silhouettes agrees (intersection over union)."""
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage as ndi
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
+
+
+def on_grey(im):
+    a = np.asarray(im.convert("RGBA")).astype(np.float32)
+    al = a[..., 3:4] / 255
+    return (a[..., :3] * al + 34 * (1 - al)).astype(np.uint8), al[..., 0] > 0.5
+
+
+def main():
+    render = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(ROOT, "renders", "view.png")
+    ref, mr = on_grey(Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "reference", "reference.png")))
+    ren, mm = on_grey(Image.open(render))
+    print("silhouette agreement %.3f  (picture only %d px, model only %d px)" % ((mr & mm).sum() / (mr | mm).sum(), (mr & ~mm).sum(), (mm & ~mr).sum()))
+    Image.fromarray(np.vstack([ref, ren])).save(os.path.join(ROOT, "renders", "vs_reference.png"))
+    edge = mr ^ ndi.binary_erosion(mr, iterations=2)
+    ov = ren.copy()
+    ov[edge] = (0, 255, 0)
+    g = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(ref).convert("L")).astype(np.float32)
+    inner = (np.hypot(ndi.sobel(g, 0), ndi.sobel(g, 1)) > 260) & mr          # the picture's strong inner edges too, faintly
+    ov[inner & ~edge] = (ov[inner & ~edge] * 0.5 + np.array((0, 200, 255)) * 0.5).astype(np.uint8)
+    Image.fromarray(ov).save(os.path.join(ROOT, "renders", "overlay.png"))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""The spinosaurus of reference/reference.png, modelled in the picture's pose.

+limb on its own plane). The animal faces +x, its left is +y, the ground is z = 0.

+  skin     the body (tail to snout), lower jaw, legs, arms, toes and fingers are tubes of rings
+           (SKIN: every part with what it is and where along it each point lies), fused into one
+           seamless surface by a voxel remesh and smoothed -> SPINO_Skin
+  paint    each skin point looks up the part it came from and is coloured by rule (paint(): tail
+           stripes, dark back, tan belly, the neck's orange and black, the head, the mouth) into
+           the colour attribute "Col"; the material adds scales (bump, cracks, shade) on top
+  sail     a thin fan on the back with a rib and a scallop per spine, painted in bands
+  rest     neck and tail spikes, teeth, claws, tongue, eyes, nostrils - separate objects
+All objects are in the collection "Spinosaurus", children of the empty SPINO_Root. Nothing of the
+picture is in the model."""

+import os
+import sys

+def cr(vals, sub):

+    out.append(vals[-1])

+def ring(c, up, side, ru, rs, n=40, e=2.3, pinch=0.0):
+    """n points round c: ru along `up` (the first point), rs along `side`; e: 2 an ellipse, more =
+    boxier; pinch: narrows the upper half."""

+    for k in range(n):

+                self.f.append((o + i * n + j, o + i * n + k, o + (i + 1) * n + k, o + (i + 1) * n + j))

+def stations(soup, st, part, sub=8, n=48):
+    """A body made of stations across it: (top pixel, bottom pixel, half width in metres, boxiness,
+    pinch). Returns its dense top points, bottom points and the length along it at each (m)."""
+    T = cr([U(s[0]) for s in st], sub)
+    B = cr([U(s[1]) for s in st], sub)
+    HW, E, PN = cr([s[2] for s in st], sub), cr([s[3] for s in st], sub), cr([s[4] for s in st], sub)
+    rings, cs = [], []
+    for tp, bt, hw, e, pn in zip(T, B, HW, E, PN):
+        d = tp - bt
+        rings.append(ring((tp + bt) / 2, d.normalized(), Yv, d.length / 2, max(hw, 0.006), n, max(e, 2.0), max(pn, 0.0)))
+        cs.append((tp + bt) / 2)
+    arc = [0.0]
+    for a, b in zip(cs, cs[1:]):
+        arc.append(arc[-1] + (b - a).length)
+    soup.loft(rings, part, arc)
+    return T, B, arc

+def tube(soup, part, pts, radii, lat=0.85, n=24, sub=5, t0=0.0, t1=1.0):
+    """A limb: rings along the smoothed path; radii in the plane it bends in, lat x that sideways."""
+    Pn, R = cr(pts, sub), cr(radii, sub)
+    L = cr(lat, sub) if isinstance(lat, list) else [lat] * len(Pn)
+    rings = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(Pn):
+        tg = (Pn[min(i + 1, len(Pn) - 1)] - Pn[max(i - 1, 0)]).normalized()
+        side = Yv - tg * tg.dot(Yv)
+        side = side.normalized() if side.length > 1e-4 else Xv
+        r = max(R[i], 0.004)
+        rings.append(ring(p, side.cross(tg), side, r, r * L[i], n, 2.0))
+    soup.loft(rings, part, [t0 + (t1 - t0) * i / (len(Pn) - 1) for i in range(len(Pn))])

+def transfer(ob, soup):
+    """For every skin point: the part it came from, how far along it, where round it."""
+    kd = KDTree(len(soup.v))
+    for i, p in enumerate(soup.v):
+        kd.insert(p, i)
+    kd.balance()
+    n = len(ob.data.vertices)
+    co = np.empty(n * 3, np.float32)
+    ob.data.vertices.foreach_get("co", co)
+    co = co.reshape(-1, 3)
+    part, t, dv = np.empty(n, np.int32), np.empty(n), np.empty(n)
+    sp, st, sd = soup.part, soup.t, soup.dv
+    for i in range(n):
+        res = kd.find_n(co[i], 4)
+        p0 = sp[res[0][1]]
+        w = tt = dd = 0.0
+        for _, j, d in res:
+            if sp[j] == p0:
+                k = 1.0 / (d + 1e-4)
+                w += k
+                tt += k * st[j]
+                dd += k * sd[j]
+        part[i], t[i], dv[i] = p0, tt / w, dd / w
+    return co.astype(np.float64), part, t, dv

+def C(h):
+    c = np.array([int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (1, 3, 5)])
+    return np.where(c <= 0.04045, c / 12.92, ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)        # (linear, as colour attributes are)
+
+
+PAL = {k: C(v) for k, v in dict(

+    orange="#d4590f", red="#a8240e", crimson="#851a0e", pink="#c05058", throat="#7a2428", cream="#e6cf8f").items()}
+
+
+def _hash(ix, iy, iz, seed):
+    h = (ix * np.uint64(374761393) + iy * np.uint64(668265263) + iz * np.uint64(2147483647) + np.uint64(seed * 1442695041 + 7)) & np.uint64(0xffffffff)
+    h = ((h ^ (h >> np.uint64(13))) * np.uint64(1274126177)) & np.uint64(0xffffffff)
+    return ((h ^ (h >> np.uint64(16))) & np.uint64(0xffff)).astype(np.float64) / 65535.0
+
+
+def vnoise(P, seed):
+    i = np.floor(P)
+    f = P - i
+    u = f * f * (3 - 2 * f)
+    i = (i + 4096).astype(np.uint64)
+    out = 0.0
+    for dx in (0, 1):
+        for dy in (0, 1):
+            for dz in (0, 1):
+                w = (u[:, 0] if dx else 1 - u[:, 0]) * (u[:, 1] if dy else 1 - u[:, 1]) * (u[:, 2] if dz else 1 - u[:, 2])
+                out = out + w * _hash(i[:, 0] + np.uint64(dx), i[:, 1] + np.uint64(dy), i[:, 2] + np.uint64(dz), seed)
+    return out
+
+
+def fbm(P, freq, seed, octaves=3):
+    """Cloudy noise, 0..1, about `freq` blobs per metre."""
+    out, amp, tot = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0
+    for o in range(octaves):
+        out = out + amp * vnoise(P * (freq * 2 ** o), seed + o * 17)
+        tot += amp
+        amp *= 0.5
+    return out / tot
+
+
+def ss(a, b, x):
+    t = np.clip((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)
+    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
+
+
+def mix(a, b, t):
+    a = np.broadcast_to(a, (len(t), 3)) if np.ndim(a) == 1 else a
+    return a + (np.asarray(b) - a) * np.asarray(t)[:, None]
+

+def paint(P, part, t, dv, L):
+    """The colour of every skin point. L: the length along the body at each of its stations."""
+    n = len(P)
+    h = (dv + 1) / 2
+    f1, f2, f3 = fbm(P, 0.8, 1), fbm(P, 2.4, 2), fbm(P, 6.5, 3)
+    blot = fbm(P, 3.4, 7, 2)
+    streak = fbm(P * np.array([3.2, 3.2, 0.8]), 1.0, 4)                 # (tall, narrow marks)
+    col = np.empty((n, 3))
+    coarse = np.zeros(n)
+    # --- the body
+    base = mix(PAL["pale"], PAL["tan"], ss(0.08, 0.38, h))
+    base = mix(base, PAL["ochre"], 0.6 * ss(0.45, 0.7, f2))
+    # tail: black bars over tan and orange, a red ridge
+    bar = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 0.175 + 7.0 * (f1 - 0.5))
+    bars = ss(0.34, 0.52, bar) * ss(0.14, 0.40, h + 0.3 * (f3 - 0.5))
+    tail = mix(base, PAL["orange"], 0.9 * ss(0.42, 0.56, blot) * ss(0.25, 0.45, h))
+    tail = mix(tail, PAL["black"], bars)
+    tail = mix(tail, PAL["red"], 0.8 * ss(0.88, 0.96, h))
+    # torso: a black back, dark streaks down the flank, flecks of orange high up
+    torso = mix(base, PAL["ochre"], 0.7 * ss(0.3, 0.5, h))
+    torso = mix(torso, PAL["brown"], 0.6 * ss(0.45, 0.65, f1))
+    torso = mix(torso, PAL["dbrown"], 0.9 * ss(0.44, 0.58, streak) * ss(0.26, 0.46, h))
+    torso = mix(torso, PAL["black"], ss(0.56, 0.74, h + 0.30 * (f2 - 0.5)))
+    torso = mix(torso, PAL["orange"], 0.8 * ss(0.56, 0.66, blot) * ss(0.82, 0.92, h))
+    # neck: black with orange and red blotches above, pale below, the edge between them toothed
+    edge = h + 0.07 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 0.24) + 0.22 * (f2 - 0.5)
+    upper = mix(PAL["black"], PAL["orange"], ss(0.50, 0.58, blot))
+    upper = mix(upper, PAL["red"], ss(0.62, 0.70, blot))
+    upper = mix(upper, PAL["red"], 0.7 * ss(0.9, 0.97, h))
+    neck = mix(mix(PAL["pale"], PAL["tan"], 0.6 * ss(0.4, 0.7, f3)), upper, ss(0.44, 0.52, edge))

+    along = ss(L[EYE_AT], L[SNOUT_AT], t)

+    head = mix(PAL["tan"], PAL["brown"], 0.75 * ss(0.4, 0.62, f3))

+    band = ss(L[EYE_AT] + 0.1, L[EYE_AT] - 0.2, t) * ss(0.25, 0.4, h + 0.25 * ss(L[EYE_AT] - 0.1, L[HEAD_AT], t))
+    head = mix(head, PAL["grey"], 0.85 * band)

+    col[k], coarse[k] = jaw[k], 0.9

+def colored(name, verts, faces, col, coarse=0.3, smooth=True):
+    """A mesh object carrying the colour attribute "Col" and the scale size "coarse"."""
+    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
+    me.from_pydata([tuple(p) for p in verts], [], faces)
+    bm = bmesh.new()
+    bm.from_mesh(me)
+    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
+    bm.to_mesh(me)
+    bm.free()
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
+    coll().objects.link(ob)
+    set_colors(ob, col, coarse)
+    me.polygons.foreach_set("use_smooth", np.full(len(me.polygons), smooth, bool))
+    me.materials.append(bpy.data.materials["SPINO_Skin"])
+    return ob
+
+
+def set_colors(ob, col, coarse):
+    me = ob.data
+    n = len(me.vertices)
+    c4 = np.ones((n, 4), np.float32)
+    c4[:, :3] = np.broadcast_to(col, (n, 3))
+    me.color_attributes.new("Col", "FLOAT_COLOR", "POINT").data.foreach_set("color", c4.ravel())
+    me.attributes.new("coarse", "FLOAT", "POINT").data.foreach_set("value", np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(coarse, np.float32), (n,)).copy())
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sail, spikes
+
+SAIL_BASE = [(300, 392), (380, 386), (428, 380), (524, 343), (619, 305), (714, 291), (810, 277), (900, 274), (975, 272), (1035, 266)]
+SAIL_EDGE = [(300, 384), (364, 326), (410, 270), (436, 214), (486, 150), (516, 100), (574, 50), (620, 29), (714, 12), (764, 5), (836, 28),
+             (900, 83), (946, 155), (968, 210), (1000, 248), (1035, 262)]
+SPINES = 44
+
+
+def resample(pts, n):
+    P = cr(pts, 12)
+    d = [0.0]
+    for a, b in zip(P, P[1:]):
+        d.append(d[-1] + (b - a).length)
+    out, j = [], 0
+    for i in range(n + 1):
+        s = d[-1] * i / n
+        while j < len(d) - 2 and d[j + 1] < s:
+            j += 1
+        f = (s - d[j]) / max(d[j + 1] - d[j], 1e-9)
+        out.append(P[j].lerp(P[j + 1], min(max(f, 0.0), 1.0)))
+    return out
+
+
+def sail():
+    nu, nv = 660, 56
+    base, edge = resample([U(p) for p in SAIL_BASE], nu), resample([U(p) for p in SAIL_EDGE], nu)
+    verts, us, vs, faces = [], [], [], []
+    n = 2 * (nv + 1)
+    for i in range(nu + 1):
+        u = i / nu
+        ph = u * SPINES
+        d = abs(ph - round(ph)) * 2                           # 0 on a spine, 1 between two
+        top = base[i].lerp(edge[i], 1 - 0.035 * d * d)        # (the edge dips between the spines)
+        for side in (1, -1):
+            for j in (range(nv + 1) if side == 1 else range(nv, -1, -1)):
+                v = j / nv
+                th = (0.17 + (0.028 - 0.17) * v ** 0.55) * (0.7 + 0.6 * (1 - d) ** 3)
+                verts.append(base[i].lerp(top, v) + Yv * (side * th / 2))
+                us.append(u)
+                vs.append(v)
+    for i in range(nu):
+        for j in range(n):
+            k = (j + 1) % n
+            faces.append((i * n + j, i * n + k, (i + 1) * n + k, (i + 1) * n + j))
+    faces += [tuple(range(n)), tuple(range(nu * n, (nu + 1) * n))]
+    u, v = np.array(us), np.array(vs)
+    P = np.array([tuple(p) for p in verts])
+    Q = np.stack([u * 9.0, v * 3.0, np.zeros(len(u))], axis=1)                 # (the sail unrolled, about metres)
+    b1, b2, b3 = fbm(Q, 1.3, 11), fbm(Q, 3.2, 12), fbm(Q * np.array([1.0, 0.35, 1.0]), 6.0, 13)
+    col = mix(PAL["orange"], PAL["tan"], 0.85 * ss(0.52, 0.68, b1))
+    col = mix(col, PAL["red"], 0.85 * ss(0.5, 0.66, b2) * (1 - ss(0.3, 0.6, u) * ss(0.45, 0.6, v) * (1 - ss(0.75, 0.85, v))))
+    band = ss(0.30, 0.36, v + 0.10 * (b1 - 0.5)) * (1 - ss(0.42, 0.50, v + 0.10 * (b1 - 0.5)))
+    col = mix(col, mix(PAL["crimson"], PAL["black"], ss(0.45, 0.6, b3)), 0.85 * band)
+    col = mix(col, PAL["red"], 0.9 * ss(0.80, 0.93, v + 0.08 * (b2 - 0.5)))
+    col = mix(col, PAL["orange"], 0.5 * ss(0.95, 1.0, v))
+    ph = u * SPINES
+    between = np.abs(ph - np.round(ph)) * 2
+    col = mix(col, PAL["black"], 0.7 * ss(0.62, 0.95, between) * (1 - 0.45 * v))        # dark creases between the spines
+    col = mix(col, PAL["black"], ss(0.27, 0.10, v + 0.10 * (b3 - 0.5)))                 # the dark foot of the sail
+    return colored("SPINO_Sail", verts, faces, col.astype(np.float32), 0.15)
+
+
+def cone_rings(base, tip, along, w_along, w_lat, bend=None, steps=7, n=10):
+    """A flattened, pointed spike: its base w_along wide along the body, w_lat thick."""
+    axis = tip - base
+    side = Yv
+    al = (along - axis * along.dot(axis) / axis.length_squared).normalized()
+    rings = []
+    for i in range(steps):
+        f = i / (steps - 1)
+        k = (1 - f) ** 0.85 * 0.97 + 0.03
+        c = base + axis * f + (bend or V()) * math.sin(math.pi * f)
+        rings.append([c + al * (w_along * k * math.cos(2 * math.pi * j / n)) + side * (w_lat * k * math.sin(2 * math.pi * j / n)) for j in range(n)])
+    return rings
+
+
+def add_rings(V_, F_, rings):
+    n, o = len(rings[0]), len(V_)
+    for r in rings:
+        V_ += r
+    for i in range(len(rings) - 1):
+        for j in range(n):
+            k = (j + 1) % n
+            F_.append((o + i * n + j, o + i * n + k, o + (i + 1) * n + k, o + (i + 1) * n + j))
+    F_.append(tuple(range(o, o + n)))
+    F_.append(tuple(range(o + (len(rings) - 1) * n, o + len(rings) * n)))
+    return o, len(V_)
+
+
+def spikes(T, arc, L):
+    """Spikes along the neck (large, swept back, dark) and the tail's ridge (small, red)."""
+    Vs, Fs, cols = [], [], []
+
+    def at(s):
+        i = min(range(len(arc)), key=lambda q: abs(arc[q] - s))
+        i = min(max(i, 1), len(arc) - 2)
+        tg = (T[i + 1] - T[i - 1]).normalized()
+        return T[i], tg, V((-tg.z, 0, tg.x))
+    s0, s1 = L[NECK_AT] - 0.1, L[EYE_AT] + 0.25
+    lengths = [0.10, 0.14, 0.20, 0.26, 0.32, 0.38, 0.44, 0.50, 0.54, 0.52, 0.46, 0.38, 0.30, 0.24, 0.20, 0.17, 0.14]
+    for i, ln in enumerate(lengths):
+        p, tg, nrm = at(s0 + (s1 - s0) * i / (len(lengths) - 1))
+        d = (nrm * (0.42 + 0.3 * i / 16) - tg * 0.9).normalized()
+        a, b = add_rings(Vs, Fs, cone_rings(p - nrm * 0.06, p + d * ln, tg, 0.085 + ln * 0.13, 0.035, bend=-tg * ln * 0.10))
+        base = PAL["orange"] if i % 3 == 1 else PAL["dbrown"]
+        for q in range(a, b):
+            f = min(max(((Vs[q] - p).length) / ln, 0), 1)
+            cols.append(base + (PAL["black"] - base) * min(f * 1.6, 1.0))
+    s0, s1 = 0.35, L[TAIL_END] - 0.9
+    for i in range(34):
+        f = i / 33
+        p, tg, nrm = at(s0 + (s1 - s0) * f)
+        ln = 0.05 + 0.10 * f
+        d = (nrm - tg * 0.35).normalized()
+        a, b = add_rings(Vs, Fs, cone_rings(p - nrm * 0.03, p + d * ln, tg, 0.035 + 0.035 * f, 0.02, steps=4, n=8))
+        cols += [PAL["red"]] * (b - a)
+    return colored("SPINO_Spikes", Vs, Fs, np.array(cols, np.float32), 0.2)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- claws, teeth, tongue, eyes
+
+def simple(name, V_, F_, mat, smooth=True):
+    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
+    me.from_pydata([tuple(p) for p in V_], [], F_)
+    bm = bmesh.new()
+    bm.from_mesh(me)
+    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
+    bm.to_mesh(me)
+    bm.free()
+    me.polygons.foreach_set("use_smooth", np.full(len(me.polygons), smooth, bool))
+    me.materials.append(bpy.data.materials[mat])
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
+    coll().objects.link(ob)
+    return ob
+
+
+def horn_rings(pts, r, lat=0.62, n=12, power=0.8):
+    """A curved, pointed horn through the points (a claw, a tooth)."""
+    Pn = cr(pts, 6)
+    rings = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(Pn):
+        f = i / (len(Pn) - 1)
+        tg = (Pn[min(i + 1, len(Pn) - 1)] - Pn[max(i - 1, 0)]).normalized()
+        side = Yv - tg * tg.dot(Yv)
+        side = side.normalized() if side.length > 1e-4 else Xv
+        up = side.cross(tg)
+        k = r * ((1 - f) ** power * 0.97 + 0.03)
+        rings.append([p + up * (k * math.cos(2 * math.pi * j / n)) + side * (k * lat * math.sin(2 * math.pi * j / n)) for j in range(n)])
+    return rings
+
+
+def claws():
+    Vs, Fs = [], []
+    for pts, r in CLAWS:
+        add_rings(Vs, Fs, horn_rings(pts, r))
+    return simple("SPINO_Claws", Vs, Fs, "SPINO_Horn")
+
+
+def along(poly, t):
+    """The point a fraction t along a polyline of pixels."""
+    d = [0.0]
+    for a, b in zip(poly, poly[1:]):
+        d.append(d[-1] + math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]))
+    s = t * d[-1]
+    for i in range(len(poly) - 1):
+        if s <= d[i + 1] or i == len(poly) - 2:
+            f = (s - d[i]) / (d[i + 1] - d[i])
+            return (poly[i][0] + (poly[i + 1][0] - poly[i][0]) * f, poly[i][1] + (poly[i + 1][1] - poly[i][1]) * f)
+
+
+UPPER_LINE = [(1310, 180), (1421, 159), (1493, 150), (1588, 131), (1683, 104), (1750, 99)]
+LOWER_LINE = [(1405, 248), (1445, 272), (1493, 310), (1541, 348), (1588, 382), (1640, 414)]
+UPPER_TEETH = [10, 12, 15, 17, 20, 22, 25, 30, 27, 37, 32, 52, 35, 42, 56, 37, 50, 40, 30, 22]     # lengths in pixels, back to front
+LOWER_TEETH = [10, 13, 16, 18, 21, 23, 26, 29, 23, 31, 26, 34, 29, 34, 31, 26, 21, 16]
+
+
+def teeth(bvh):
+    Vs, Fs = [], []
+    for line, lens, sgn in ((UPPER_LINE, UPPER_TEETH, -1), (LOWER_LINE, LOWER_TEETH, 1)):
+        for i, ln in enumerate(lens):
+            t = i / (len(lens) - 1)
+            a, b = U(along(line, max(t - 0.02, 0))), U(along(line, min(t + 0.02, 1)))
+            p = (a + b) / 2
+            tg = (b - a).normalized()
+            out = V((-tg.z, 0, tg.x)) * sgn                    # the way the tooth points: away from its jaw
+            lm = ln * cam.mpp(p)
+            for side in (NEAR, FAR):
+                o = p - out * 0.05 + Yv * (side * 3.0)
+                hit = bvh.ray_cast(o, Yv * -side)[0]
+                if hit is None or abs(hit.y) < 0.02:
+                    continue
+                base = V((hit.x, hit.y * 0.86, hit.z)) - out * 0.02
+                tip = base + out * lm - tg * (0.12 * lm) + Yv * (-side * 0.02)
+                add_rings(Vs, Fs, horn_rings([base, base.lerp(tip, 0.5) + tg * (0.05 * lm), tip], max(lm * 0.25, 0.02), lat=0.85, n=10, power=0.9))
+    return simple("SPINO_Teeth", Vs, Fs, "SPINO_Tooth")
+
+
+def tongue():
+    pts = [(1295, 250, 26), (1370, 268, 30), (1440, 300, 26), (1500, 334, 17), (1532, 354, 7)]
+    P = cr([U(p) for p in pts], 6)
+    R = cr([p[2] * cam.K for p in pts], 6)
+    rings = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(P):
+        tg = (P[min(i + 1, len(P) - 1)] - P[max(i - 1, 0)]).normalized()
+        rings.append(ring(p, Yv.cross(tg) * -1, Yv, max(R[i], 0.01) * 0.75, max(R[i], 0.01) * 1.5, 20, 2.0))
+    Vs, Fs = [], []
+    add_rings(Vs, Fs, rings)
+    return simple("SPINO_Tongue", Vs, Fs, "SPINO_Tongue")
+
+
+def ball_data(c, ax, ay, az, n=16, rows=10):
+    """A stretched ball: its three half axes as vectors."""
+    Vs, Fs = [], []
+    rings = []
+    for i in range(1, rows):
+        a = math.pi * i / rows
+        rings.append([c + az * math.cos(a) + (ax * math.cos(2 * math.pi * j / n) + ay * math.sin(2 * math.pi * j / n)) * math.sin(a) for j in range(n)])
+    add_rings(Vs, Fs, rings)
+    return Vs, Fs
+
+
+def eyes(bvh):
+    """An eye on each side where the picture has it, a nostril on each side of the snout's end."""
+    c = V(cam.location())
+    made = []
+    for name, px, kind in (("Eye", (1400, 88), "eye"), ("Nostril", (1667, 38), "nostril")):
+        d = V(cam._ray(*px)).normalized()
+        hit, nrm = bvh.ray_cast(c, d)[:2]
+        if hit is None:
+            print("no skin under the", name)
+            continue
+        for side, tag in ((1, "R"), (-1, "L")):                # (the hit is on the right side; mirror it for the left)
+            h, n = V((hit.x, hit.y * side, hit.z)), V((nrm.x, nrm.y * side, nrm.z))
+            t1 = n.cross(Zv).normalized()
+            t2 = t1.cross(n)
+            if kind == "eye":
+                made.append(simple("SPINO_Eye." + tag, *ball_data(h - n * 0.035, t1 * 0.078, t2 * 0.078, n * 0.078), "SPINO_Eye"))
+                made.append(simple("SPINO_Pupil." + tag, *ball_data(h + n * 0.034, t1 * 0.02, t2 * 0.045, n * 0.012, 12, 6), "SPINO_Black"))
+                lid_v, lid_f = [], []
+                rings = []
+                for i in range(20):                              # the lid: a dark ring round the eye
+                    a = 2 * math.pi * i / 20
+                    cc = h + n * 0.008 + (t1 * 1.25 * math.cos(a) + t2 * 0.85 * math.sin(a)) * 0.082
+                    rad = (t1 * math.cos(a) + t2 * math.sin(a))
+                    rings.append([cc + (rad * math.cos(2 * math.pi * j / 8) + n * math.sin(2 * math.pi * j / 8)) * 0.03 for j in range(8)])
+                for i in range(20):
+                    o = len(lid_v)
+                    lid_v += rings[i]
+                    for j in range(8):
+                        lid_f.append((i * 8 + j, i * 8 + (j + 1) % 8, ((i + 1) % 20) * 8 + (j + 1) % 8, ((i + 1) % 20) * 8 + j))
+                made.append(colored("SPINO_Lid." + tag, lid_v, lid_f, PAL["black"].astype(np.float32), 0.0))
+            else:
+                made.append(simple("SPINO_Nostril." + tag, *ball_data(h - n * 0.004, t1 * 0.05, t2 * 0.028, n * 0.012, 12, 6), "SPINO_Black"))
+    return made
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials, stage
+
+def _nodes(name):
+    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
+    m.use_nodes = True
+    nt = m.node_tree
+    nt.nodes.clear()
+    return m, nt, nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
+
+
+def _math(nt, op, a, b=None, clamp=False):
+    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
+    n.operation, n.use_clamp = op, clamp
+    for sock, v in ((n.inputs[0], a), (n.inputs[1], b)):
+        if v is None:
+            continue
+        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+            sock.default_value = v
+        else:
+            nt.links.new(v, sock)
+    return n.outputs[0]
+
+
+def _mixf(nt, a, b, fac):
+    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
+    n.data_type = "FLOAT"
+    for sock, v in ((n.inputs[2], a), (n.inputs[3], b), (n.inputs[0], fac)):
+        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
+            sock.default_value = v
+        else:
+            nt.links.new(v, sock)
+    return n.outputs[0]
+
+
+def mat_skin():
+    """Scaly skin: the painted colour ("Col") broken into scales - each a little lighter or darker,
+    dark in the cracks between them, raised - small ones, or large where "coarse" says so."""
+    m, nt, out = _nodes("SPINO_Skin")
+    N, L = nt.nodes.new, nt.links.new
+    colr = N("ShaderNodeAttribute")
+    colr.attribute_name = "Col"
+    crs = N("ShaderNodeAttribute")
+    crs.attribute_name = "coarse"
+    tc = N("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
+    layers = []
+    for scale in (58.0, 26.0):
+        e = N("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi")
+        e.feature = "DISTANCE_TO_EDGE"
+        e.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale
+        L(tc.outputs["Object"], e.inputs["Vector"])
+        cl = N("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi")
+        cl.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale
+        L(tc.outputs["Object"], cl.inputs["Vector"])
+        sep = N("ShaderNodeSeparateColor")
+        L(cl.outputs["Color"], sep.inputs[0])
+        mr = N("ShaderNodeMapRange")
+        mr.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
+        mr.inputs[1].default_value, mr.inputs[2].default_value = 0.0, 0.08
+        L(e.outputs["Distance"], mr.inputs[0])
+        layers.append((mr.outputs[0], sep.outputs[0]))
+    height = _mixf(nt, layers[0][0], layers[1][0], crs.outputs["Fac"])
+    cell = _mixf(nt, layers[0][1], layers[1][1], crs.outputs["Fac"])
+    shade = _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", _math(nt, "ADD", 0.56, _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", cell, 0.82)), _math(nt, "ADD", 0.36, _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", height, 0.64)))
+    mul = N("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
+    mul.operation = "SCALE"
+    L(colr.outputs["Color"], mul.inputs[0])
+    L(shade, mul.inputs["Scale"])
+    bs = N("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    L(mul.outputs[0], bs.inputs["Base Color"])
+    L(_math(nt, "SUBTRACT", 0.60, _math(nt, "MULTIPLY", height, 0.28)), bs.inputs["Roughness"])
+    bs.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = 0.65
+    bs.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = 0.10
+    bs.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.25
+    wr = N("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
+    wr.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 5.0
+    wr.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 5.0
+    L(tc.outputs["Object"], wr.inputs["Vector"])
+    b1 = N("ShaderNodeBump")
+    b1.inputs["Strength"].default_value, b1.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.25, 0.05
+    L(wr.outputs["Fac"], b1.inputs["Height"])
+    b2 = N("ShaderNodeBump")
+    b2.inputs["Strength"].default_value, b2.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 1.0, 0.012
+    L(height, b2.inputs["Height"])
+    L(b1.outputs[0], b2.inputs["Normal"])
+    L(b2.outputs[0], bs.inputs["Normal"])
+    L(bs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    return m
+
+
+def mat_plain(name, color, rough, emit=0.0, coat=0.0, sss=0.0):
+    m, nt, out = _nodes(name)
+    c = C(color)
+    bs = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
+    bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*c, 1)
+    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
+    bs.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
+    if emit:
+        bs.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*c, 1)
+        bs.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emit
+    if sss:
+        bs.inputs["Subsurface Weight"].default_value = sss
+        bs.inputs["Subsurface Radius"].default_value = (0.02, 0.008, 0.005)
+    nt.links.new(bs.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])
+    m.diffuse_color = (*c, 1)
+    return m
+
+
+def materials():
+    mat_skin()
+    mat_plain("SPINO_Horn", "#231f1c", 0.22, coat=0.5)
+    mat_plain("SPINO_Tooth", "#e2c988", 0.28, coat=0.3)
+    mat_plain("SPINO_Tongue", "#c2575c", 0.22, coat=0.6, sss=0.3)
+    mat_plain("SPINO_Eye", "#e3a511", 0.08, emit=0.25, coat=1.0)
+    mat_plain("SPINO_Black", "#050505", 0.15, coat=1.0)

+def stage(draft):
+    sc = bpy.context.scene
+    root = bpy.data.objects.new("SPINO_Root", None)
+    root.empty_display_size = 1.0
+    coll().objects.link(root)
+    for ob in coll().objects:
+        if ob is not root:
+            ob.parent = root
+    cd = bpy.data.cameras.new("SPINO_RefCamera")
+    cd.lens, cd.sensor_width, cd.sensor_fit, cd.clip_end = cam.F * 36.0 / cam.W, 36.0, "HORIZONTAL", 300
+    ob = bpy.data.objects.new("SPINO_RefCamera", cd)
+    fw, up, right = V(cam.FW), V(cam.UP), V(cam.RIGHT)
+    ob.matrix_world = Matrix.Translation(V(cam.location())) @ Matrix((right, up, -fw)).transposed().to_4x4()
+    coll().objects.link(ob)
+    sc.camera = ob
+    sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y = cam.W, cam.H
+    sc.render.film_transparent = True
+    for name, loc, energy, color, angle in (("SPINO_Key", (4, -12, 18), 4.8, (1.0, 0.97, 0.92), 10), ("SPINO_Fill", (14, -12, 2), 0.6, (1.0, 0.95, 0.9), 30),
+                                            ("SPINO_Rim", (-10, 10, 8), 1.5, (0.9, 0.95, 1.0), 15)):
+        ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, "SUN")
+        ld.energy, ld.color, ld.angle = energy, color, math.radians(angle)
+        lo = bpy.data.objects.new(name, ld)
+        lo.rotation_euler = (V((0, 0, 3)) - V(loc)).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
+        lo.location = loc
+        coll().objects.link(lo)
+    w = bpy.data.worlds.new("SPINO_World")
+    w.use_nodes = True
+    w.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Color"].default_value = (0.85, 0.87, 0.9, 1)
+    w.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.28
+    sc.world = w
+    sc.render.engine = "CYCLES"

+        for kind in ("OPTIX", "CUDA"):
+            try:

+    build("draft" in args)

hunks.title: The spinosaurus model
hunks.note: The whole build script: tubes of rings for the body and limbs, fused by a voxel remesh into one skin, painted per point by which part it came from, plus the sail, spikes, teeth, eyes and materials, rendered through the reference picture's camera.

bubbles.text: The ring tubes overlap freely; a voxel Remesh then a Smooth modifier are applied to turn them into one seamless closed surface (SPINO_Skin).

After the remesh the skin's points no longer know which part they belong to: each looks up its four nearest original ring points (a KD-tree) and takes the part, the position along it and round it, weighted by distance.
The sail is a thin two-sided fan between a base line and an edge line, with its edge dipping between the spines and its colour bands built from layered noise.

files.explanation: New plain-maths module shared by the spinosaurus build and its tools: the reference picture's camera as assumed (a small yaw and elevation, its distance and scale). U(px, py, y) gives the 3D point on the plane y = const seen at a picture pixel, so sizes can be read off the picture, and a render through the same camera lands where the picture has the animal.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,59 @@ 
+"""The reference picture's camera, as assumed for the spinosaurus (plain maths: used by build_spino.py
+inside Blender and by the tools outside it).
+
+The animal's frame: x forward (to the snout), y to its left, z up, metres, the ground at z = 0. The
+picture shows its right side from a little in front (YAW) and a little above (ELEV); nothing in the
+picture fixes these exactly, so they are a judgement: with them the animal's sizes are read off the
+picture - U(px, py, y) is the point of the plane y = const seen at a pixel (the animal's spine,
+sail and head lie on y = 0, a limb on its own plane) - and a render through the same camera lands
+where the picture has it."""
+import math
+
+W, H = 1774, 887
+YAW, ELEV, DIST = 22.0, 5.0, 22.0
+K = 0.0075                      # metres per pixel on the plane y = 0 at the picture's centre
+F = DIST / K                    # focal length in pixels
+CX, CY = W / 2, H / 2
+_y, _e = math.radians(YAW), math.radians(ELEV)
+D = (math.sin(_y) * math.cos(_e), -math.cos(_y) * math.cos(_e), math.sin(_e))      # from the target to the camera
+FW = (-D[0], -D[1], -D[2])
+RIGHT = (math.cos(_y), math.sin(_y), 0.0)
+UP = (-math.sin(_y) * math.sin(_e), math.cos(_y) * math.sin(_e), math.cos(_e))
+Z0 = 0.0                        # the height of the point at the picture's centre (set below)
+
+
+def location():
+    return (D[0] * DIST, D[1] * DIST, Z0 + D[2] * DIST)
+
+
+def _ray(px, py):
+    a, b = (px - CX) / F, (CY - py) / F
+    return tuple(FW[i] + RIGHT[i] * a + UP[i] * b for i in range(3))
+
+
+def U(px, py, y=0.0):
+    """The point of the plane y = const seen at the pixel."""
+    c, d = location(), _ray(px, py)
+    t = (y - c[1]) / d[1]
+    return (c[0] + d[0] * t, y, c[2] + d[2] * t)
+
+
+def depth(p):
+    c = location()
+    return sum((p[i] - c[i]) * FW[i] for i in range(3))
+
+
+def P(p):
+    """The pixel a point is seen at."""
+    c = location()
+    v = [p[i] - c[i] for i in range(3)]
+    z = sum(v[i] * FW[i] for i in range(3))
+    return (CX + F * sum(v[i] * RIGHT[i] for i in range(3)) / z, CY - F * sum(v[i] * UP[i] for i in range(3)) / z)
+
+
+def mpp(p):
+    """Metres per pixel at a point."""
+    return depth(p) / F
+
+
+Z0 = -U(350, 866, -0.76)[2]     # the near foot stands on the ground
hunks.title: The picture's camera
hunks.note: Defines the camera's direction, right and up vectors from YAW and ELEV, a ray per pixel, and the pixel-to-plane mapping used to write the model's sizes in picture pixels.

bubbles.text: The camera is a judgement (nothing in the picture fixes it): seen from 22 degrees in front and 5 above, 22 m away.
A pixel becomes a ray direction: forward plus right and up scaled by the pixel's offset from the centre over the focal length.

files.explanation: The spinosaurus cut out of its reference picture's checkered background (white on black), written by tools/compare.py and used to measure how well the model's silhouette matches.
The reference picture of the spinosaurus that build_spino.py models from: its sizes are read off this picture through cam.py. It is only a guide; nothing of it is in the model.

New Python tool that puts the spinosaurus render beside its reference picture: it cuts the animal out of the picture's checkered background, writes a side-by-side image and an overlay (the picture's outline in green, model-only areas blue, missed areas pink) and prints how much of the two silhouettes agree.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,48 @@ 
+"""Puts the render beside the reference picture:  python -I compare.py [<render>]
+Writes renders/vs_reference.png (the picture above, the render below, on white), renders/overlay.png
+(the picture's outline in green over the render) and reference/mask.png (the animal cut from the
+picture's checkered background), and prints how much of the two silhouettes agrees."""
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy import ndimage as ndi
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
+
+
+def ref_mask(ref):
+    a = ref.astype(np.int32)
+    bg = (a.min(axis=2) > 222) & (a.max(axis=2) - a.min(axis=2) < 16)
+    fg = ndi.binary_opening(~bg, iterations=2)
+    lab, n = ndi.label(fg)
+    sizes = ndi.sum(fg, lab, range(1, n + 1))
+    fg = np.isin(lab, 1 + np.nonzero(sizes > 150)[0])
+    return ndi.binary_fill_holes(fg)
+
+
+def main():
+    render = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(ROOT, "renders", "view.png")
+    ref = np.asarray(Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "reference", "reference.png")).convert("RGB"))
+    mr = ref_mask(ref)
+    Image.fromarray((mr * 255).astype(np.uint8)).save(os.path.join(ROOT, "reference", "mask.png"))
+    r = np.asarray(Image.open(render).convert("RGBA")).astype(np.float32)
+    al = r[..., 3:4] / 255
+    ren = (r[..., :3] * al + 255 * (1 - al)).astype(np.uint8)
+    mm = al[..., 0] > 0.5
+    print("silhouette agreement %.3f  (picture only %d px, model only %d px)" % ((mr & mm).sum() / (mr | mm).sum(), (mr & ~mm).sum(), (mm & ~mr).sum()))
+    refw = ref.copy()
+    refw[~mr] = 255
+    Image.fromarray(np.vstack([refw, ren])).save(os.path.join(ROOT, "renders", "vs_reference.png"))
+    edge = mr ^ ndi.binary_erosion(mr, iterations=2)
+    ov = ren.copy()
+    ov[mm & ~mr] = (ov[mm & ~mr] * 0.5 + np.array((60, 110, 255)) * 0.5).astype(np.uint8)        # model outside the picture: blue
+    ov[mr & ~mm] = (255, 190, 190)                                                                  # picture the model misses: pink
+    ov[edge] = (0, 200, 0)
+    Image.fromarray(ov).save(os.path.join(ROOT, "renders", "overlay.png"))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

files.explanation: New Blender script that models the triceratops android part by part after its model sheet (a front and a left view in a T-pose): head with horns and painted frill, torso, shoulders, arms, legs, the kilt and the cape. Every part is a mesh shaped in code with kit.py (lofts, tubes, cloth sheets, armour plates and panel lines), its sizes in the sheet's pixels, and its painted patterns (spirals, waves, triskelions) drawn by code. It then calls rig.py for the skeleton and its walk, punch and die animations, and renders front, left, three-quarter and back views.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,657 @@ 
+"""The triceratops android, modelled part by part after reference/reference.png (a model sheet: left
+view and front view in a T-pose, 1980s anime style).
+
+  blender -b --factory-startup --python external/blender/tricera_android/build_model.py [-- only head,torso]
+Saves tricera_android.blend and renders/front.png, left.png (framed like the sheet's two views) and
+three_quarter.png, back.png. tools/compare.py puts the renders beside the sheet. Then rig.py gives it
+a skeleton and its animations (walk, punch, die); stills of them go to renders/anim/ and
+tools/sheet.py tiles them into renders/anim_<name>.png.
+
+Nothing of the sheet's picture is in the model: every part is a mesh shaped here (kit.py: lofted
+bodies, swept tubes, cloth sheets, armour plates and panel lines laid on them), its sizes written in
+the sheet's pixels as read off it by eye, and the painted patterns (spirals, waves, triskelions) are
+drawn by code. The android faces -Y, feet on z = 0, 2.2 m to the top of the frill. All objects are in
+the collection "TriceraAndroid", children of the empty TRI_Root, named <Part>_<Piece>[.L/.R]."""
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Vector
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
+import kit  # noqa: E402
+from kit import K, Q, X, Y, Z, M, lerp, zloft, xloft, yloft, tube, horn, ball, sheet, plate, ink_line, loft, ring  # noqa: E402
+
+V = Vector
+CREAM, GOLD, RED = "#edcb96", "#e0a02e", "#9a2123"
+
+
+def rgb(h):
+    return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (1, 3, 5))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- painted patterns
+
+def tex_frill():
+    """The frill's face as seen from the front: 4 texture pixels per sheet pixel, from 160 px left of
+    the centre line and row 10. Cream with three red spirals and their tails."""
+    S = 4
+    c = kit.Canvas(320 * S, 220 * S, rgb(CREAM))
+
+    def T(pts):
+        return [((dx + 160) * S, (row - 10) * S) for dx, row in pts]
+    red = rgb("#c8423a")
+    left = kit.spiral(-82, 125, 4, 33, math.pi, 1.25) + [(-62, 96), (-48, 106), (-40, 120), (-37, 133)]
+    for sgn in (1, -1):
+        c.stroke(T(kit.smooth([V((sgn * dx, row)) for dx, row in left], 3)), 9.5 * S, red)
+    sp = kit.spiral(0, 66, 3, 26, -math.pi / 2, 1.5)
+    tail = [(-12, 93), (-24, 95), (-33, 99), (-39, 105)]
+    c.stroke(T(kit.smooth([V(p) for p in sp + tail], 3)), 9.5 * S, red)
+    c.stroke(T([(0, 28), (0, 40)]), 1.6 * S, rgb("#3a2a20"))
+    return kit.image("TRI_frill", c.a)
+
+
+def tex_kilt():
+    """The front cloth (u across, v down from the belt): cream, a red band near the hem with a row of
+    cream running spirals, a few fold lines."""
+    W = H = 1024
+    c = kit.Canvas(W, H, rgb(CREAM))
+    y0, y1 = 0.800 * H, 0.945 * H
+    c.rect(0, y0, W, y1, rgb("#c8423a"))
+    n = 6
+    uw, bh = W / n, y1 - y0
+    for k in range(n):
+        cx, cy = (k + 0.56) * uw, y0 + 0.47 * bh
+        sp = kit.spiral(cx, cy, 0.07 * bh, 0.36 * bh, math.pi, -1.15)          # (out from the middle, ending low on the left)
+        tail = [(cx - 0.36 * uw, y1 - 0.10 * bh), (cx - 0.60 * uw, y1 + 0.05 * bh)]
+        c.stroke(kit.smooth([V(p) for p in sp + tail], 3), 0.15 * bh, rgb(CREAM))
+    line = rgb("#4a3626")
+    for u, v0, v1, lean in ((0.24, 0.06, 0.74, 0.03), (0.70, 0.18, 0.76, -0.02), (0.44, 0.22, 0.36, 0.05)):
+        c.stroke([(u * W, v0 * H), ((u + lean) * W, v1 * H)], 3.0, line)
+    return kit.image("TRI_kilt", c.a)
+
+
+def triskelion(cx, cy, rx, ry, flip=1):
+    """Three spirals joined at the centre (lists of points); rx, ry: its radii in the picture."""
+    arms = []
+    for k in range(3):
+        a = math.radians(-90 + 120 * k)
+        ox, oy = 0.52 * math.cos(a), 0.52 * math.sin(a)
+        sp = kit.spiral(ox, oy, 0.46, 0.07, a + math.pi, flip * 1.3, n=70)

+
+def tex_cape(marks):

+    side panel. marks: (u, v, radius along u, radius along v, handedness) of each triskelion."""
+    W, H = 2048, 1024
+    c = kit.Canvas(W, H, rgb(RED))
+    c.rect(0, 0.958 * H, W, H, rgb(GOLD))
+    c.rect(0, 0.954 * H, W, 0.958 * H, rgb("#2a0a0a"))

+def materials(cape_marks):

+        "frill": t("TRI_Frill", CREAM, "#b79869", img=tex_frill()),
+        "frill_back": t("TRI_FrillBack", "#8a3018", "#5e2010"),
+        "kilt": t("TRI_Kilt", CREAM, "#ac8e66", img=tex_kilt()),
+        "cape": t("TRI_Cape", RED, "#6a1417", img=tex_cape(cape_marks), tone=(-0.25, 0.9, 0.3), edge=0.16),
+        "dark": kit.mat_flat("TRI_Dark", "#141a22"),
+        "cyan": kit.mat_flat("TRI_Cyan", "#3ef1fc", 1.6),
+        "white": kit.mat_flat("TRI_White", "#e8ffff", 1.5),
+        "ink": kit.mat_flat("TRI_Ink", "#0a0706", 1.0, cull=True),
+    })
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- head
+
+FR_T0 = 0.20                      # where the frill starts (inside the skull), as a fraction of its radius
+FR_RX, FR_RZ = 141.0, 120.0       # the frill face's radii in the front view (px), about (0, row 150)
+
+
+def frill_max_angle(t):
+    return math.radians(100 + 12 * ((t - 0.7) / 0.3) ** 2)
+
+
+def frill_pt(th, t, back=0.0):
+    """The frill's face: th = the angle from straight up (radians, + to the android's left), t = 0 at
+    its centre .. 1 at the edge. It is a dish swept back, more at the sides than at the top."""
+    g = max((t - FR_T0) / (1 - FR_T0), 0.0) ** 1.15
+    sweep = 50 + 62 * min(abs(math.sin(th)), 1.0) ** 1.3 if abs(th) < math.pi / 2 else 112
+    return Q(t * FR_RX * math.sin(th), 287 + sweep * g + back, 150 - t * FR_RZ * math.cos(th))
+
+
+def frill_normal(th, t):
+    e = 1e-3
+    du = frill_pt(th + e, t) - frill_pt(th - e, t)
+    dv = frill_pt(th, t + e) - frill_pt(th, t - e)

+
+
+def head():
+    # --- the skull: wide at the cheeks, a narrow snout, a hooked beak
+    yloft("Head_Skull", [
+        (299, 150, 200, 26, 0.1), (294, 141, 205, 34, 0.15), (285, 137, 209, 40, 0.2), (268, 139, 213, 41, 0.25), (256, 144, 215, 38, 0.3),
+        (245, 149, 217, 34, 0.35), (235, 155, 218, 27.5, 0.4), (225, 161, 220, 22.5, 0.45), (212, 169, 222, 19.5, 0.5),

+    yloft("Head_Jaw", [(262, 209, 226, 27), (245, 214, 229, 22), (226, 218, 231, 16), (208, 221, 233, 11.5), (194, 225, 236, 7.5),
+                       (186, 229, 238, 3)], "cream", n=2.6, m=24, sub=1)
+    sk = kit.Caster(["Head_Skull", "Head_Jaw"])
+    # eyes: a dark socket and a slanted cyan eye on the slope between cheek and snout
+    for sgn, s in ((-1, "R"), (1, "L")):
+        inner, outer = Q(sgn * 13, 221, 183), Q(sgn * 35, 248, 166)
+        c = (inner + outer) / 2
+        along = (outer - inner).normalized()
+        nrm = V((sgn * 0.50, -0.83, 0.24))
+        nrm = (nrm - along * nrm.dot(along)).normalized()
+        tube("Head_Socket." + s, [c - nrm * 0.010, c + nrm * 0.006], 10 * K, 18 * K, mat="dark", m=20, n=1.8, up=along, ink=0)
+        tube("Head_Eye." + s, [c - nrm * 0.004, c + nrm * 0.008], 5.8 * K, 12.5 * K, mat="cyan", m=20, n=1.5, up=along, ink=0)
+    # brow ridge over each eye (a plate from the side), cheek plate behind the eye
+    plate("Head_Brow.L", [(214, 168), (232, 160), (256, 158), (264, 150), (286, 150), (290, 168), (268, 171), (250, 165), (232, 164)],
+          "S", sk, "cream", thick=0.007, lift=0.001, grid=4, bevel=0.002, mirror=True)
+    plate("Head_Cheek.L", [(246, 191), (262, 186), (284, 190), (288, 205), (262, 213), (244, 208)],
+          "S", sk, "cream", thick=0.006, lift=0.001, grid=4, bevel=0.002, mirror=True)
+    for i, pts in enumerate(([(170, 235), (186, 226), (210, 222), (240, 219), (262, 213)],          # the mouth
+                             [(238, 190), (232, 204), (236, 217)],   # sutures
+                             [(178, 200), (186, 204)], [(172, 212), (180, 207), (192, 208)])):
+        ink_line("Head_Line%d.L" % i, pts, "S", sk, mirror=True)
+    # nostril

+def _circle(c, axis, ru, rv, ref, n=28):
+    """n points of an ellipse around c, in the plane across `axis`."""

+    v = axis.cross(u)
+    return [c + u * (ru * math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / n)) + v * (rv * math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / n)) for i in range(n)]

+    return loft(name, rings, mat, ink=0.6)
