+extends TestCase
+## Damage to parts and the Repair Bay (Parts, RepairBay): hits leave faults
+## that weaken what the part does and are saved; on the operating table each
+## kind is found with its scan mode and fixed with its tool, by mouse - the
+## bolts undone in a good order, the crack welded, the cable soldered (the
+## power cut first: live, it shocks), the leak sealed at low pressure, the
+## component calibrated, a wreck replaced by a spare turned the right way.
+
+var _main: Node
+
+
+func teardown() -> void:
+	if is_instance_valid(_main):
+		_main.queue_free()
+	SaveGame.pending = {}
+
+
+func _rng(n: int) -> RandomNumberGenerator:
+	var r := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	r.seed = n
+	return r
+
+
+func test_hits_leave_faults_that_weaken_parts() -> void:
+	var c := {}
+	var rng := _rng(3)
+	var made := 0
+	for i in 200:
+		if not Parts.hit(c, "ship", 200.0, 800.0, "kinetic", Vector2(0, 1), rng).is_empty():
+			made += 1
+	check(made > 0, "big hits leave faults (%d)" % made)
+	var b := Parts.body(c, "ship")
+	var rear: int = b["engines"]["faults"].size() + b["fuel"]["faults"].size()
+	var front: int = b["sensors"]["faults"].size()
+	check(rear > front, "hits from behind reach the engines and fuel lines, not the sensors (%d / %d)" % [rear, front])
+	check(Parts.fault_count(c, "ship") <= Parts.BODIES["ship"]["parts"].size() * Parts.MAX_FAULTS, "a part holds at most MAX_FAULTS")
+	check(Parts.mod(c, "ship", "speed_mult") < 0.0, "damaged engines: less speed (%.2f)" % Parts.mod(c, "ship", "speed_mult"))
+	var small := 0
+	var c2 := {}
+	for i in 200:
+		if not Parts.hit(c2, "ship", 2.0, 800.0, "kinetic", Vector2.ZERO, rng).is_empty():
+			small += 1
+	check(small < 10, "grazes rarely leave one (%d of 200)" % small)
+	# A fault's kind follows the damage: lasers burn wiring, heat leaks.
+	var c3 := {}
+	var kinds := {}
+	for i in 300:
+		var f := Parts.hit(c3, "ship", 300.0, 800.0, "energy", Vector2.ZERO, rng)
+		if not f.is_empty():
+			kinds[f["kind"]] = int(kinds.get(f["kind"], 0)) + 1
+	check(kinds.has("burn"), "energy weapons burn wiring (%s)" % str(kinds))
+	# Saved and loaded (JSON numbers as floats) the same.
+	var back := Parts.load_condition(JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(c)))
+	check_eq(Parts.fault_count(back, "ship"), Parts.fault_count(c, "ship"), "the faults survive a save")
+	check(is_equal_approx(Parts.mod(back, "ship", "speed_mult"), Parts.mod(c, "ship", "speed_mult")), "and weaken the same")
+	# Cut the power: the part does nothing.
+	var c4 := {}
+	Parts.part(c4, "ship", "engines")["off"] = true
+	check(is_equal_approx(Parts.mod(c4, "ship", "speed_mult"), -0.45), "an engine switched off: all its speed gone")
+	check(Parts.service_cost(c, "ship") > 0 and Parts.clear_all(c, "ship") > 0 and Parts.fault_count(c, "ship") == 0, "a station's technicians fix everything, for a price")
+
+
+func test_the_ship_and_automaton_feel_their_damage() -> void:
+	Galaxy.new_game(false)
+	_main = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(_main)
+	for i in 10:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	var pd: Node = _main.player_data
+	var ship: Node2D = _main.ship
+	var speed: float = ship.max_speed
+	var shields: float = ship.max_shields
+	Parts.add_fault(pd.condition, "ship", "engines", "wreck", 0, _rng(1))
+	Parts.add_fault(pd.condition, "ship", "shields", "wreck", 0, _rng(1))
+	ship.apply_tech()
+	check(ship.max_speed < speed * 0.9, "wrecked engine parts: slower (%.0f < %.0f)" % [ship.max_speed, speed])
+	check(ship.max_shields < shields, "a wrecked emitter part: weaker shields")
+	check(pd.get_save_data()["condition"]["ship"]["engines"]["faults"].size() == 1, "the condition is saved with the player")
+	# Hits through to the hull leave faults (and say so).
+	var before := Parts.fault_count(pd.condition, "ship")
+	for i in 60:
+		ship.hull = ship.max_hull
+		ship.shields = 0.0
+		ship.take_damage(ship.max_hull * 0.2, ship.global_position + Vector2(0, 300).rotated(ship.rotation))
+	check(Parts.fault_count(pd.condition, "ship") > before, "heavy hits on the hull damage parts")
+	# The automaton: its legs slow it, its frame lets more through.
+	var pilot := SurfaceProps.Pilot.new()
+	var player := {"condition": {}}
+	pilot.apply_gear(player)
+	var walk := pilot.speed
+	Parts.add_fault(player["condition"], "automaton", "legs", "wreck", 0, _rng(2))
+	Parts.add_fault(player["condition"], "automaton", "frame", "wreck", 0, _rng(2))
+	pilot.apply_gear(player)
+	check(pilot.speed < walk, "damaged leg servos: slower walking (%.0f < %.0f)" % [pilot.speed, walk])
+	pilot.hp = 100.0
+	pilot.surface_hit(10.0)
+	check(pilot.hp < 90.0, "a damaged frame: more damage taken (%.1f)" % (100.0 - pilot.hp))
+	pilot.free()
+
+
+# --- The operating table, by mouse --------------------------------------------------
+
+var _bay: RepairBay
+var _t: RepairBay.Table
+
+
+func _btn(at: Vector2, pressed: bool, button := MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) -> void:
+	var e := InputEventMouseButton.new()
+	e.button_index = button
+	e.pressed = pressed
+	e.position = at
+	_t._gui_input(e)
+
+
+func _move(to: Vector2) -> void:
+	var e := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
+	e.relative = to - _t._mouse
+	e.position = to
+	_t._gui_input(e)
+
+
+func _step(s: float, dt := 0.05) -> void:
+	var n := ceili(s / dt)
+	for i in n:
+		_t._process(dt)
+
+
+func _hold_at(at: Vector2, s: float) -> void:
+	_move(at)
+	_btn(at, true)
+	_step(s)
+	_btn(at, false)
+
+
+func _open_bay() -> void:
+	Galaxy.new_game(false)
+	_main = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(_main)
+	for i in 10:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	_main.ship_menu.open(_main.ship_menu.REPAIR_TAB)
+	for i in 3:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	_bay = _main.ship_menu._pages[_main.ship_menu.REPAIR_TAB]
+	_t = _bay._table
+
+
+func test_surgery_on_the_engines() -> void:
+	await _open_bay()
+	var pd: Node = _main.player_data
+	var c: Dictionary = pd.condition
+	var cs := Parts.comps("ship", "engines")   # injector, liner, vector, ignition, chamber
+	Parts.add_fault(c, "ship", "engines", "crack", 1, _rng(4))
+	Parts.add_fault(c, "ship", "engines", "leak", 0, _rng(5))
+	Parts.add_fault(c, "ship", "engines", "burn", 3, _rng(6))
+	Parts.add_fault(c, "ship", "engines", "drift", 2, _rng(7))
+	Parts.add_fault(c, "ship", "engines", "wreck", 4, _rng(8))
+	pd.add_item("spare_cell", 1)
+	_bay.pick_part("engines")
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(_t.size.x > 600 and _t.size.y > 400, "the table has room (%s)" % str(_t.size))
+	var speed: float = _main.ship.max_speed
+	# The scanner can't see through the casing (no Deep Scanner).
+	_bay.set_tool("scanner")
+	_bay.set_scan("structure")
+	_hold_at(_t.anchor(_bay.faults()[0]), 1.0)
+	check(not _bay.faults()[0]["found"], "the closed casing blocks the scan")
+	# Undo the bolts (a click near each, whatever tool), opposite ones in turn: no strain.
+	for i in [0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5]:
+		_hold_at(_t.bolt_pos(i) + Vector2(20, 14), 0.1)   # (near it, not on it: a generous reach)
+	check(_bay.op()["open"], "all six bolts out: the casing comes off")
+	check(_bay.faults().size() == 5, "no complication from a good order")
+	var wreck: Dictionary = _bay.faults().filter(func(f): return f["kind"] == "wreck")[0]
+	check(wreck["found"], "a wreck is plain to see once it's open")
+	_step(0.6)   # (the casing lifts away)
+	# Scan: each kind in its mode.
+	_bay.set_tool("scanner")
+	for mode in ["structure", "thermal"]:
+		_bay.set_scan(mode)
+		for f in _bay.faults():
+			if Parts.FAULTS[f["kind"]]["scan"] == mode:
+				_move(_t.anchor(f))
+				_step(0.6)
+	var by := {}
+	for f in _bay.faults():
+		by[f["kind"]] = f
+	check(by["crack"]["found"] and by["leak"]["found"], "structure finds the crack, thermal the leak")
+	check(not by["burn"]["found"] and not by["drift"]["found"], "the field and resonance modes need a Mk II scanner")
+	pd.add_item("scanner_mk2", 1)
+	_bay._fill()
+	for mode in ["field", "resonance"]:
+		_bay.set_scan(mode)
+		for f in _bay.faults():
+			if Parts.FAULTS[f["kind"]]["scan"] == mode:
+				_move(_t.anchor(f))
+				_step(0.6)
+	check(by["burn"]["found"] and by["drift"]["found"], "with the Mk II: the burnt cable and the misalignment")
+	# Weld the crack: slowly along it.
+	_bay.set_tool("welder")
+	var bits: Array = _t.crack_bits(by["crack"])
+	_move(bits[0][0])
+	_btn(bits[0][0], true)
+	for b in bits:
+		var m: Vector2 = (b[0] + b[1]) * 0.5
+		_move(_t._mouse.lerp(m, 0.5))
+		_t._speed = 200.0
+		_t._process(0.03)
+		_move(m)
+		_t._speed = 200.0
+		_t._process(0.03)
+	_btn(_t._mouse, false)
+	check(by["crack"]["id"] not in _bay.faults().map(func(f): return f["id"]), "the crack welded shut")
+	# Solder: live first - a shock.
+	_bay.set_tool("solder")
+	var g: Dictionary = _t.burn_geo(by["burn"])
+	var heat := float(_bay.op()["heat"])
+	var before := _bay.faults().size()
+	_btn(g["l"][0], true)
+	_btn(g["l"][0], false)
+	check(float(_bay.op()["heat"]) > heat, "soldering a live cable: a shock")
+	check(_bay.faults().size() == before, "a shock hurts, but never adds a fault (faults come only from hits)")
+	_bay._toggle_power()
+	check(not _bay.powered(), "the breaker cut")
+	var burn_id: int = by["burn"]["id"]
+	for bf in _bay.faults().filter(func(f): return f["kind"] == "burn"):
+		var gg: Dictionary = _t.burn_geo(bf)
+		for k in 3:
+			var j: int = gg["order"].find(k)
+			_move(gg["l"][k])
+			_btn(gg["l"][k], true)
+			_move(gg["r"][j])
+			_btn(gg["r"][j], false)
+	check(burn_id not in _bay.faults().map(func(f): return f["id"]), "each strand to its own colour: the cable mended")
+	_bay._toggle_power()
+	# Seal the leak: only while the pressure's low.
+	_bay.set_tool("sealant")
+	var lp: Vector2 = _t.leak_pos(by["leak"])
+	_move(lp)
+	var leak_id: int = by["leak"]["id"]
+	for i in 600:
+		var low: bool = _t.pressure(by["leak"]) < 0.42
+		if low and not _t._down:
+			_btn(lp, true)
+		elif not low and _t._down:
+			_btn(lp, false)
+		_t._process(0.05)
+		if leak_id not in _bay.faults().map(func(f): return f["id"]):
+			break
+	_btn(lp, false)
+	check(leak_id not in _bay.faults().map(func(f): return f["id"]), "sealed, a little at each low")
+	# Calibrate: the dials onto the reference.
+	_bay.set_tool("calibrator")
+	var st: Dictionary = _t.fstate(by["drift"])
+	var panel: Array = _t.cal_panel(by["drift"])
+	for k in 2:
+		var dial: Vector2 = panel[k + 1]
+		var need: float = (float(st["f0"]) - float(st["f"])) / 0.008 if k == 0 else angle_difference(float(st["p"]), float(st["p0"])) / 0.02
+		_move(dial)
+		_btn(dial, true)
+		var e := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
+		e.position = dial
+		e.relative = Vector2(0, -need)
+		_t._gui_input(e)
+		_btn(dial, false)
+	var drift_id: int = by["drift"]["id"]
+	_step(1.3)
+	check(drift_id not in _bay.faults().map(func(f): return f["id"]), "frequency and phase on the reference: aligned")
+	# The wreck: clamps, out, a spare turned to the notch, clamps.
+	_bay.set_tool("forceps")
+	var cp: Vector2 = _t.comp_pos(4)
+	_btn(_t.clamp_pos(wreck, 0), true)
+	_btn(_t.clamp_pos(wreck, 1), true)
+	_btn(cp, true)
+	_move(cp + Vector2(0, _t.comp_size() * 3.0))
+	_btn(_t._mouse, false)
+	check_eq(str(_t.fstate(wreck)["stage"]), "empty", "pulled out")
+	_btn(cp, true)
+	check(_t._held_spare >= 0, "a spare in the forceps")
+	if _t._held_spare != _t.notch(wreck):
+		_btn(cp, true)
+		check(str(_t.fstate(wreck)["stage"]) == "empty", "turned wrong, it won't seat")
+	for i in 4:
+		if _t._held_spare == _t.notch(wreck):
+			break
+		_btn(cp, true, MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT)
+	_btn(cp, true)
+	check_eq(str(_t.fstate(wreck)["stage"]), "seat", "turned to the notch, it seats")
+	check_eq(pd.count("spare_cell"), 0, "the spare used")
+	_btn(_t.clamp_pos(wreck, 0), true)
+	_btn(_t.clamp_pos(wreck, 1), true)
+	check(_bay.faults().is_empty(), "every fault fixed")
+	check(_main.ship.max_speed > speed, "the engines back to full speed (%.0f > %.0f)" % [_main.ship.max_speed, speed])
+	# Close up: a click on each empty hole.
+	for i in 6:
+		_hold_at(_t.bolt_pos(i), 0.1)
+	check(not _bay.op()["open"], "the bolts back in: closed")
+
+
+func test_careless_surgery_has_consequences() -> void:
+	await _open_bay()
+	var c: Dictionary = _main.player_data.condition
+	_bay.pick_part("reactor")
+	await tree.process_frame
+	# Neighbouring bolts one after another: the casing warps and the bolts seize -
+	# never a new fault (faults come only from hits to the hull or the body).
+	var faults_of := func(): return Parts.part(c, "ship", "reactor")["faults"].size()
+	var n0: int = faults_of.call()
+	for i in [0, 1, 2]:
+		_hold_at(_t.bolt_pos(i), 0.6)
+	check(faults_of.call() == n0, "undoing neighbours warped the casing, but no new fault")
+	check(int(_bay.op()["seized"]) > 0, "the warped casing seized the bolts")
+	var left: int = _bay.op()["bolts"].count(true)
+	_hold_at(_t.bolt_pos(3), 0.1)
+	check(_bay.op()["bolts"].count(true) == left, "a seized bolt doesn't come out at the first turn")
+	for k in 6:
+		for i in [3, 4, 5]:
+			if _bay.op()["bolts"][i]:
+				_hold_at(_t.bolt_pos(i), 0.6)
+	check(_bay.op()["open"], "kept turning: the casing came off")
+	# Too long with the welder in one place: overheated - the welder cuts out, no new fault.
+	var n: int = faults_of.call()
+	_bay.set_tool("welder")
+	var at: Vector2 = _t.comp_pos(0)
+	_move(at)
+	_btn(at, true)
+	_step(4.0)
+	var said: String = _t._flash_text
+	_btn(at, false)
+	check(said.begins_with("Overheated"), "welding in one place too long: overheated (%s)" % said)
+	check(faults_of.call() == n, "an overheat costs work, but no new fault")
+	# The automaton's core can't be switched off (it's you).
+	_bay._pick_body("automaton")
+	_bay.pick_part("core")
+	_bay._toggle_power()
+	check(_bay.powered(), "the automaton's power core stays on")
hunks.title: Repair Bay tests
hunks.note: Hits leave faults where they land, in kinds that follow the damage, saved and loaded; the ship and automaton feel their damage. A full operation on the engines by simulated mouse: bolts in a good order, scanning in each mode, welding, soldering with the power cut, sealing at low pressure, calibrating, replacing a wreck with a spare turned to its notch, closing up. Careless work warps the casing and overheats the welder but never makes a new fault.

+# --- the operating table, by mouse ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _btn(at: Vector2, pressed: bool, button := MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) -> void:
+	var e := InputEventMouseButton.new()
+	e.button_index = button
+	e.pressed = pressed
+	e.position = at
+	_s._gui_input(e)
+
+
+func _move(to: Vector2) -> void:
+	var e := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
+	e.relative = to - _s._mouse
+	e.position = to
+	_s._gui_input(e)
+
+
+func _step(s: float, dt := 0.05) -> void:
+	for i in ceili(s / dt):
+		_s._process(dt)
+
+
+func _click(at: Vector2) -> void:
+	_move(at)
+	_btn(at, true)
+	_btn(at, false)
+
+
+## The button held, drawn steadily through the middle of each piece (a cut, a fracture).
+func _trace(bits: Array) -> void:
+	var first: Vector2 = ((bits[0][0] as Vector2) + (bits[0][1] as Vector2)) * 0.5
+	_move(first)
+	_btn(first, true)
+	for b in bits:
+		var m: Vector2 = ((b[0] as Vector2) + (b[1] as Vector2)) * 0.5
+		_move(_s._mouse.lerp(m, 0.5))
+		_s._speed = 200.0
+		_s._process(0.03)
+		_move(m)
+		_s._speed = 200.0
+		_s._process(0.03)
+	_btn(_s._mouse, false)
+
+
+func _scan_at(f: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_bay.set_tool("scanner")
+	_move(_s.anchor(f))
+	_step(0.7)
+
+
+func _open_bay(part: String) -> void:

+	tree.root.add_child(_main)
+	for i in 10:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	_main.ship_menu.open(_main.ship_menu.REPAIR_TAB)
+	for i in 3:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	_bay = _main.ship_menu._pages[_main.ship_menu.REPAIR_TAB]
+	_s = _bay._surgery
+	_bay._pick_body("automaton")
+	_bay.pick_part(part)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	_s.opened()
+	_s._view = _s._view_to
+
+
+func test_an_operation_on_the_arm() -> void:
+	await _open_bay("arms")
+	var pd: Node = _main.player_data
+	var c: Dictionary = pd.condition
+	check(_s.visible and not _bay._table.visible, "the automaton: the anatomy on the table")
+	check_eq(_bay._tool_btns.size(), RepairBay.SURGERY_TOOLS.size(), "a surgeon's tools")
+	check(_s.size.x > 600 and _s.size.y > 400, "the table has room (%s)" % str(_s.size))
+	for i in _s.comps().size():
+		check(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, _s.size).grow(-20.0).has_point(_s.site(i)), "%s is in view" % _s.comps()[i][1])
+	var tear := Parts.add_fault(c, "automaton", "arms", "crack", 0, _rng(4))     # right biceps
+	var spasm := Parts.add_fault(c, "automaton", "arms", "drift", 1, _rng(5))    # left forearm flexors
+	var nerve := Parts.add_fault(c, "automaton", "arms", "burn", 2, _rng(6))     # right median nerve
+	var bleed := Parts.add_fault(c, "automaton", "arms", "leak", 3, _rng(7))     # right brachial artery
+	var bone := Parts.add_fault(c, "automaton", "arms", "crack", 4, _rng(8))     # left upper arm bone
+	var by := func(x: Dictionary) -> Dictionary: return _bay.fault(int(x["id"]))
+	var has := func(x: Dictionary) -> bool: return not _bay.fault(int(x["id"])).is_empty()
+	var total := func() -> int: return Parts.fault_count(c, "automaton")
+	check_eq(total.call(), 5, "five faults")
+	# The scanner finds the faults of the layer shown.
+	_bay.set_layer("veins")
+	_scan_at(by.call(tear))
+	check(not by.call(tear)["found"], "a torn muscle doesn't show in the veins layer")
+	_bay.set_layer("muscles")
+	_scan_at(by.call(tear))
+	_scan_at(by.call(spasm))
+	check(by.call(tear)["found"] and by.call(spasm)["found"], "the muscles layer: the tear and the spasm found")
+	_bay.set_layer("veins")
+	_scan_at(by.call(bleed))
+	check(by.call(bleed)["found"], "the veins layer: the bleed")
+	_bay.set_layer("skeleton")
+	_scan_at(by.call(bone))
+	check(not by.call(bone)["found"], "the skeleton is too deep for the built-in scanner")
+	pd.add_item("scanner_mk2", 1)
+	_scan_at(by.call(bone))
+	_bay.set_layer("nerves")
+	_scan_at(by.call(nerve))
+	check(by.call(bone)["found"] and by.call(nerve)["found"], "with a Mk II: the fracture and the burnt nerve")
+	# The muscle is the surface: sutured directly, a stitch at each mark.
+	_bay.set_layer("muscles")
+	_bay.set_tool("suture")
+	var marks := _s.stitch_pts(by.call(tear))
+	for i in marks.size() - 1:
+		_click(marks[i])
+	check(has.call(tear), "one stitch short: still torn")
+	_click(marks[-1])
+	check(not has.call(tear), "sutured: the tear is mended")
+	# The spasm: the tuner's wave onto the reference, and held.
+	_bay.set_tool("tuner")
+	var st: Dictionary = _s.fstate(by.call(spasm))
+	var panel := _s.cal_panel(by.call(spasm))
+	_move(panel[1])
+	_btn(panel[1], true)
+	check(str(_s._drag.get("kind", "")) == "dial", "a dial in hand")
+	_btn(panel[1], false)
+	st["f"] = st["f0"]
+	st["p"] = st["p0"]
+	_step(1.3)
+	check(not has.call(spasm), "tuned and held: the spasm is gone")
+	# The bone lies under the muscle: no fusing until it's cut down to.
+	_bay.set_layer("skeleton")
+	_bay.set_tool("fuser")
+	check(not _s.reachable(by.call(bone)), "the fracture is under the muscle")
+	_trace(_s.crack_bits(by.call(bone)))
+	check(has.call(bone), "the fuser does nothing through the muscle")
+	_bay.op()["heat"] = 0.0
+	_bay.set_tool("scalpel")
+	_trace(_s.cut_bits(4))
+	check(_s.is_open(4) and _s.reachable(by.call(bone)), "an incision along the line: the bone is reached")
+	_bay.set_tool("fuser")
+	_trace(_s.crack_bits(by.call(bone)))
+	check(not has.call(bone), "traced with the fuser: the fracture knit")
+	check(float(_bay.op()["heat"]) > 0.0, "the fuser heats the site")
+	# The incision closed with sutures.
+	_bay.set_tool("suture")
+	for p in _s.close_pts(4):
+		_click(p)
+	check(not _s.is_open(4), "stitched shut")
+	# The nerve: cut down to it; live, it shocks - numb the arm first.
+	_bay.set_layer("nerves")
+	_bay.set_tool("scalpel")
+	_trace(_s.cut_bits(2))
+	check(_s.is_open(2), "an incision over the nerve")
+	_bay.set_tool("splicer")
+	var g: Dictionary = _s.burn_geo(by.call(nerve))
+	_bay.op()["shock"] = 0.0
+	_btn(g["l"][0], true)
+	_btn(g["l"][0], false)
+	check(float(_bay.op()["shock"]) > 0.0 and has.call(nerve), "splicing a live nerve: a shock, and nothing joined")
+	check_eq(total.call(), 2, "... and no new fault from it")
+	_bay._toggle_power()
+	check(not _bay.powered(), "the nerve block: the arm numbed")
+	for j in 3:
+		var to: int = g["order"].find(j)
+		_move(g["l"][j])
+		_btn(g["l"][j], true)
+		_move(g["r"][to])
+		_btn(g["r"][to], false)
+	check(not has.call(nerve), "each fibre to its own colour: the nerve spliced")
+	_bay._toggle_power()
+	check(_bay.powered(), "the block lifted")
+	# The bleed: clamped upstream, the pressure stays down; sealed.
+	_bay.set_layer("veins")
+	_bay.set_tool("scalpel")
+	_trace(_s.cut_bits(3))
+	_bay.set_tool("clamp")
+	_click(_s.clamp_at(by.call(bleed)))
+	check(float(_s.fstate(by.call(bleed))["clamp"]) > 0.0, "the vessel clamped")
+	var hi := 0.0
+	for i in 40:
+		_s._process(0.05)
+		hi = maxf(hi, _s.pressure(by.call(bleed)))
+	check(hi < 0.42, "clamped: the pressure stays low (%.2f)" % hi)
+	_bay.set_tool("sealant")
+	var lp := _s.leak_pos(by.call(bleed))
+	_move(lp)
+	_btn(lp, true)
+	for i in 80:
+		if not has.call(bleed):
+			break
+		_s._process(0.05)
+	_btn(lp, false)
+	check(not has.call(bleed), "sealed while it held")
+	check_eq(total.call(), 0, "the arm is whole again - and nothing new went wrong on the table")
+	# Leaving the part closes what's still open.
+	check(_s.is_open(3), "(an incision still open)")
+	_bay.pick_part("legs")
+	_bay.pick_part("arms")
+	check(not _s.is_open(3), "leaving the part closed it up")
+
+
+func test_a_graft() -> void:
+	await _open_bay("legs")
+	var pd: Node = _main.player_data
+	var c: Dictionary = pd.condition
+	var dead := Parts.add_fault(c, "automaton", "legs", "wreck", 0, _rng(9))   # right thigh muscle
+	var walk: float = Parts.mod(c, "automaton", "speed_mult")
+	check(walk < 0.0, "a destroyed thigh muscle: slower")
+	_s._view_pid = ""
+	_s.opened()
+	_s._view = _s._view_to
+	var f: Dictionary = _bay.fault(int(dead["id"]))
+	check(f["found"], "a destroyed muscle is plain to see")
+	_bay.set_tool("forceps")
+	var st: Dictionary = _s.fstate(f)
+	for j in 2:
+		_click(_s.tie_pos(f, j))
+	check_eq(str(st["stage"]), "lift", "both ties undone")
+	var at := _s.site(0)
+	_move(at)
+	_btn(at, true)
+	_move(at + Vector2(0, -_s.piece(0).x * 3.0))
+	_btn(_s._mouse, false)
+	check_eq(str(st["stage"]), "empty", "lifted out")
+	_click(at)
+	check(_s._held_spare < 0, "no spare: nothing to graft")
+	pd.add_item("spare_servo", 1)
+	_click(at)
+	check(_s._held_spare >= 0, "a spare in the forceps")
+	_click(at)
+	check_eq(str(st["stage"]), "empty", "turned the wrong way: it won't take")
+	for i in 4:
+		if _s._held_spare == _s.notch(f):
+			break
+		_btn(at, true, MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT)
+	_click(at)
+	check_eq(str(st["stage"]), "seat", "turned the way the tissue runs: grafted")
+	check_eq(pd.count("spare_servo"), 0, "the spare is used")
+	for j in 2:
+		_click(_s.tie_pos(f, j))
+	check(_bay.fault(int(dead["id"])).is_empty() and Parts.mod(c, "automaton", "speed_mult") == 0.0, "tied in: the leg works again")
hunks.title: Surgery tests

files.explanation: New: takes the screenshots for the guide, the tutorial and the encyclopedia. It runs tests/doc_shots.gd in a game window with its own user data, draws each shot's infographic notes (boxes, numbered steps, labels with arrows) in the GUI's amber, saves data/docs/shots/<id>.jpg at 1280x720, and keeps a manifest of what each shot was taken from so stale ones can be found and retaken.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,152 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Screenshots of the game for the guide, the tutorial and the encyclopedia.
+
+The shots are listed in data/docs/shots.json (a caption, the files each one
+shows, and its notes - an infographic drawn over it). This takes them in a
+game window (tests/doc_shots.gd sets each moment up), draws the notes, and
+saves data/docs/shots/<id>.jpg (1280 x 720) with a manifest of what each was
+taken from - test_doc_shots fails when a shot is older than the files it shows.
+
+  python3 tools/doc_shots.py            every shot
+  python3 tools/doc_shots.py ID ...     just these
+  python3 tools/doc_shots.py --stale    only the out-of-date ones (and missing)
+  python3 tools/doc_shots.py --notes    redraw the notes only, from the raw shots
+                                        kept in external/doc_shots_raw/
+
+Pages show a shot where their text has  ![caption](shot:id)  (DocPictures).
+"""
+import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+SHOTS = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "docs", "shots.json")
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "docs", "shots")
+RAW = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "doc_shots_raw")
+MANIFEST = os.path.join(OUT, "manifest.json")
+FONT = os.path.join(ROOT, "assets", "fonts", "Rajdhani-Bold.ttf")
+SIZE = (1280, 720)
+AMBER = (255, 176, 64, 255)
+INK = (255, 238, 205, 255)
+PANEL = (16, 11, 6, 232)
+DARK = (20, 12, 4, 255)
+
+
+def load():
+    return json.load(open(SHOTS))["shots"]
+
+
+def sources_hash(srcs):
+    h = hashlib.md5()
+    for s in srcs:
+        p = os.path.join(ROOT, s)
+        h.update(s.encode())
+        h.update(open(p, "rb").read() if os.path.exists(p) else b"-")
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def manifest():
+    return json.load(open(MANIFEST)) if os.path.exists(MANIFEST) else {}
+
+
+def stale(shots):
+    m = manifest()
+    return [k for k, v in shots.items()
+            if m.get(k, {}).get("hash") != sources_hash(v["sources"]) or not os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT, k + ".jpg"))]
+
+
+def capture(ids):
+    os.makedirs(RAW, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as xdg:   # (the game's own user data, untouched)
+        env = dict(os.environ, XDG_DATA_HOME=xdg)
+        cmd = ["godot", "--path", ROOT, "--resolution", "1920x1080", "--position", "0,30", "-s", "tests/doc_shots.gd",
+               "--"] + ids + ["--mute", "--no-live", "--window-at=0,30", "--out=" + RAW]
+        out = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900).stdout
+    done = []
+    for line in out.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith("DOC SHOTS: "):
+            done = [x for x in line[len("DOC SHOTS: "):].split(",") if x]
+    return done
+
+
+def _font(size):
+    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT, size)
+
+
+def _arrow(d, a, b):
+    d.line([a, b], fill=AMBER, width=5)
+    r = 10
+    d.ellipse([b[0] - r, b[1] - r, b[0] + r, b[1] + r], fill=AMBER, outline=DARK, width=3)
+
+
+def _edge_point(box, to):
+    """The point on the box's edge nearest `to` (where the arrow leaves)."""
+    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
+    return (min(max(to[0], x0), x1), min(max(to[1], y0), y1))
+
+
+def annotate(sid, shot):
+    raw = Image.open(os.path.join(RAW, sid + ".png")).convert("RGBA")
+    over = Image.new("RGBA", raw.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(over)
+    f = _font(36)
+    for n in shot.get("notes", []):
+        t = n.get("t")
+        if t == "box":
+            x, y, w, h = n["rect"]
+            d.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=10, outline=AMBER, width=5)
+        elif t == "step":
+            x, y = n["at"]
+            r = 26
+            d.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=AMBER, outline=DARK, width=3)
+            d.text((x, y), str(n["n"]), font=_font(34), fill=DARK, anchor="mm")
+        elif t == "label":
+            x, y = n["at"]
+            tw = d.textbbox((0, 0), n["text"], font=f)
+            w, h = tw[2] - tw[0] + 32, tw[3] - tw[1] + 22
+            x = min(max(x, 8), raw.size[0] - w - 8)   # (on the picture)
+            y = min(max(y, 8), raw.size[1] - h - 8)
+            box = (x, y, x + w, y + h)
+            if "to" in n:
+                _arrow(d, _edge_point(box, n["to"]), tuple(n["to"]))
+            d.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=10, fill=PANEL, outline=AMBER, width=4)
+            d.text((x + 16, y + 9 - tw[1]), n["text"], font=f, fill=INK)
+    img = Image.alpha_composite(raw, over).convert("RGB").resize(SIZE, Image.LANCZOS)
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+    img.save(os.path.join(OUT, sid + ".jpg"), quality=88, optimize=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[1:]
+    shots = load()
+    notes_only = "--notes" in args
+    if "--stale" in args:
+        ids = stale(shots)
+    else:
+        ids = [a for a in args if not a.startswith("--")] or list(shots)
+    unknown = [i for i in ids if i not in shots]
+    if unknown:
+        sys.exit("unknown shots: " + ", ".join(unknown))
+    if not ids:
+        print("every shot is up to date")
+        return
+    if not notes_only:
+        print("taking %d shot(s) in a game window..." % len(ids))
+        done = capture(ids)
+        missing = [i for i in ids if i not in done]
+        if missing:
+            print("NOT taken (see tests/doc_shots.gd): " + ", ".join(missing))
+        ids = [i for i in ids if i in done]
+    m = manifest()
+    for sid in ids:
+        annotate(sid, shots[sid])
+        if not notes_only:
+            m[sid] = {"hash": sources_hash(shots[sid]["sources"]), "taken": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}
+        print("  %s.jpg" % sid)
+    json.dump(m, open(MANIFEST, "w"), indent=1, sort_keys=True)
+    # (Godot imports the pictures, so the game can show them)
+    subprocess.run(["godot", "--headless", "--path", ROOT, "--import"], capture_output=True, timeout=600)
+    print("done: %d shot(s) in data/docs/shots/" % len(ids))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

files.explanation: New: a check that every game script compiles, run by LiveLink in a fresh Godot process before a live restart, so the game never restarts into code that doesn't compile.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,29 @@ 
+extends SceneTree
+## Every game script compiles? Run by LiveLink in a fresh process before a
+## live restart (after an import, so new class_names are known):
+##   godot --headless --path . -s res://tools/live_check.gd
+## Exit code 0: all compile; 1: some don't (their paths printed, "BROKEN <path>").
+
+const DIRS := ["res://scripts"]
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	var bad := []
+	var n := 0
+	var stack: Array = DIRS.duplicate()
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var d: String = stack.pop_back()
+		for sub in DirAccess.get_directories_at(d):
+			stack.append(d.path_join(sub))
+		for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(d):
+			if not f.ends_with(".gd"):
+				continue
+			var p := d.path_join(f)
+			n += 1
+			var s: Script = load(p)
+			if s == null or not s.can_instantiate():
+				bad.append(p)
+	for p in bad:
+		print("BROKEN ", p)
+	print("live_check: %d scripts, %d broken" % [n, bad.size()])
+	quit(1 if not bad.is_empty() else 0)

+def gd_str(s):
+    return '"' + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
+

+def main():
+    ids = set()
+    goods, cats, makes, uses = [], [], {e: [] for e in ECONOMIES}, {e: [] for e in ECONOMIES}
+    for title, base, makers, users, new in CATEGORIES:
+        assert len(base) + len(new) == 14, title
+        for m in makers + users:
+            assert m in ECONOMIES, m
+        cats.append((title, base + [g[0] for g in new]))
+        for g in new:
+            gid = g[0]
+            assert gid not in ids, gid
+            ids.add(gid)
+            goods.append((title, g))
+            for m in makers:
+                makes[m].append(gid)
+            # two users, picked by the good's name (stable)
+            h = zlib.crc32(gid.encode())
+            picks = [users[h % len(users)], users[(h // 7 + 1 + h % (len(users) - 1)) % len(users)]]
+            for u in dict.fromkeys(picks):
+                if u not in makers:
+                    uses[u].append(gid)
+    assert len(ids) == 126, len(ids)
+
+    out = []
+    out.append("class_name TradeGoods")
+    out.append("## The market's trade goods beyond the original fourteen: 126 of them, in")
+    out.append("## ten categories of fourteen. GENERATED by tools/trade_goods.py - edit the")
+    out.append("## tables there and run it again.")
+    out.append("##")
+    out.append("## GOODS: item entries (merged into Items.ITEMS: name, kind \"cargo\", value,")
+    out.append("## desc, cat) plus each one's icon (shape, c1, c2 - draw_icon). CATEGORIES: the")
+    out.append("## market's tabs in order, [title, [ids]] - the originals first in each. MAKES /")
+    out.append("## USES: economy -> the new goods its stations make / use (Galaxy sets the rates).")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("const GOODS := {")
+    for title, (gid, name, value, shape, c1, c2, desc) in goods:
+        out.append('\t%s: {"name": %s, "kind": "cargo", "value": %d, "cat": %s, "shape": %s, "c1": Color("%s"), "c2": Color("%s"),' % (
+            gd_str(gid), gd_str(name), value, gd_str(title), gd_str(shape), c1, c2))
+        out.append('\t\t"desc": %s},' % gd_str(desc))
+    out.append("}")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("const CATEGORIES := [")
+    for title, members in cats:
+        out.append("\t[%s, [%s]]," % (gd_str(title), ", ".join(gd_str(m) for m in members)))
+    out.append("]")
+    out.append("")
+    for name, table in (("MAKES", makes), ("USES", uses)):
+        out.append("const %s := {" % name)
+        for e in ECONOMIES:
+            out.append("\t%s: [%s]," % (gd_str(e), ", ".join(gd_str(g) for g in table[e])))
+        out.append("}")
+        out.append("")
+    out.append(DRAW)
+    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "scripts", "trade_goods.gd")
+    open(path, "w").write("\n".join(out))
+    print("wrote scripts/trade_goods.gd: %d goods, %d categories" % (len(goods), len(cats)))

hunks.title: The trade goods generator
hunks.note: Every economy in a category's makers makes its new goods; two of its users, picked from a hash of the good's id so they're the same every run, use each one. The output is GDScript constants plus draw_icon, which draws each good's shape in its two colours.

bubbles.text: Two users from a CRC32 of the id: stable between runs, and spread over the category's user economies.
Guards the tables: 126 new goods, which with the original fourteen makes 140.

bubbles.at: static func draw_icon(ci: CanvasItem, id: String, rect: Rect2, dim := false) -> void:
bubbles.text: Each icon is a few polygons, lines and circles in the good's two colours, by shape: amphora, sack, ingot, chip, crystal...
